tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam 'gyur med dga' bzhi'i dpa' bo mchog /spros bral gdod ma'i shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ / dpal chen he ru ka dpal yab yum gyis/ /srid 'dir mchog tu dge zhing shis par mdzod/ /yon tan 'phrin las nam yang zad mi mnga'/ /mtha' dag brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po'i tshul/ khyab bdag rang bzhin bde gshegs dpa' bo lnga/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor mar bcas rgyal gyur cig / bsam gyis mi khyab thugs rje'i mthu stobs kyis/ /sgrub la dngos grub ma lus myur stsol ba/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas gsum dpa' bo dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /mtshan tsam bsgrags pas bdud sde'i snying 'gas shing*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ /rdo rje khro tshogs rgya mtsho'i rol pa can/ /ye shes ma mo brgyad kyis 'gro 'di bsrungs/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus la/ /dad pas dmigs med ngang nas phyag bgyid na/ /zhing skyong la sogs dur khrod spyod yul can/ /de dag kun gyis bgegs rnams nyams par mdzod/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho lta bu ste/ /sgrub thabs rin chen dpag g.yas 'dzin mod kyang*/ /de las bla ma dam pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /gang blang de dag byi dor bya bar 'os/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nas 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs rnam pa mang po dag bshad par bya'o/ /de yang sgrub pa po dge ba bcu la goms shing dkon mchog gsum 'ba' zhig bla mar byed pa/ theg pa mchog la gzhol ba'i lhag bsam can/ rdo rje theg pa lhag par mos pa/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig shin tu bsrung ba/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu dgyes par bya ba'i bka' drin thob pa dag gis 'di bsgom par bya ste/

de las brtson 'grus dang ldan na 'dod pa'i dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par the tshom med cing*/ gang dag skye ba gzhan dang skye ba 'di nyid la sngon mi zad pa'i las byas pa dag kyang de lta bu'i rim pa las ma log par bsgrubs na/ tshe 'di'am skye ba bdun tshun chad kyi 'dod pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ 'on kyang dam pa'i chos kyi nang du zhugs nas/ mi dge ba bcu spyod bzhin pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pas ni sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por phyir zhing bying bar 'gyur gyi/ grub pa dang bde ba bla na med pa ga la zhig /de ltar yang*/ srog gcod pa yi sems can gang*/ /gzhan gyi nor la dga' ba dang*/ /rtag tu g.yem par spyod pa dang*/ /bshang gci zas su za ba ste/ /de dag sgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ sems can mtshams med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byed pa yang*/ /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di la 'grub/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa dag /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mthun pa'i rkyen ni 'di yin te/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas dang*/ dam tshig gi ril bu la sogs pa'i rdzas dang*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i zas gos sogs yo byad dang*/ rdo rje dril bu sogs mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dang*/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i sgrub g.yog sogs grogs de lnga po de dag sgrub pa po sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba rnams kyis sgrub pa'i dus na thams cad ma nyams shing tshang bar dgos la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs ni ci rigs pa tshang bas chog go /gal te nang la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin na ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su de dag yid kyi bya ba kho nas chog cing*/ sgrub pa'i tshe yang de dag las 'bad rtsol med par gang rnyed pa tsam zhig bzung bar bya ba yin no/ /da ni bsgom par bya ba'i sgrub thabs rnams las thog mar rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor dag brjod de/

༈ oṃ na mo badz+ra he ru ka tsa ra ṇā ya/ gang sku yid la dran pas srid pa'i 'ching ba lhod por byed/ /nyin re bsgom na gzung 'dzin snang ba yud kyi bzlog par 'gyur/ /bzlas brjod tsam gyis bye ba phrag brgya'i 'dod don 'phral tu 'grub/ sgrub thabs 'di la phun tshogs nus mthu mtha' yas mthong ba yin/ /'dir dpal sdom pa nyung ngu'i 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pas gang gsungs pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la brten pa'i sgrub thabs lag len bla ma'i man ngag bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems skyed yig brgya la sogs pa sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ dur khrod kyi sa gzh-i la dbugs bral gyi gdan steng du 'dug par gyur/ gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ / de dag ni phung khams kyi nga rgyal skyed pa ste/ rgyas par na lū yi pa ltar bsgom mo/ / sum+bha lan gnyis kyis tshams rngam bya/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i rā ba dang*/ steng du gur dang mda'i dra ba/ 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje kha bzhi pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

de'i 'og tu raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i me lce gcig tu gyur pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ gnas bsrung ba bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ rgyal po seṅge'i gdan can khyab 'jug sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ / de ni de dbus a yig las byung ba'i/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /steng 'og sbubs dang bcas par gyur/ /dbus dang rtsibs brgyad steng 'og tu/ /raṃ las nyi ma bcu gcig ste/ /de steng hūṃ yig bcu gcig las/ /dbus su hūṃ mdzad sngon po 'jigs/ /dbus na g.yas dmar g.yon dkar zhal/ /rdo rje gri gug rtse gsum g.yas/ /dril bu thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ g.yon/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed dang*/ /mi bskyod cod pan ral pa mdzes/ /thod skam thod rlon phyag rgya lnga/ /stag lpags sbrul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyi 'jigs dus mnan/ /spyan dgur rab khros me dpung 'bar/ /gshin rje mthar byed nag dkar dmar/ /dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /shes rab mthar byed dkar sngo dmar/ /ral gri rdo rje dbyug pa g.yas/ /zhags pa sogs g.yon gong ma de dang 'dra bar bsgom mo/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ £© /pad+ma mthar byed dmar sngo dkar/ / gtun shing rdo rje ral gri g.yas/ g.yon gong bzhin/ / £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ £© /bgegs mthar byed pa sngo dmar dkar/ /rgya gram 'khor lo gtun shing g.yas/ /dril bu zhags pa dgra sta g.yon/ /de rnams shar sogs g.yas skor te/ /phyogs kyi rgyal bas dbu la brgyan/ /shar lho mi g.yo sngo dmar dkar/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas/ /zhags pa dril bu dgra sta g.yon/ /lho nub 'dod rgyal sngo dmar dkar/ /dang pau gnyis ni hūṃ mdzad rgya/ /lhag ma rdo rje ral gri g.yas/

/g.yon rnams zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /nub byang dbyug sngon sngo dmar dkar/ /dbyug pa ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /zhags pa pad+ma nyi ma g.yon/ /byang shar stobs chen nag dmar dkar/ /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo g.yas/ /zhags pa rtse gsum dgra sta g.yon/ /rim bzhin rnam snang rin 'byung dang*/ /snang mtha'i don yod rgyas btab can/ /steng du gtsug tor ljang dmar dkar/ /dang po gtsug tor phyag rgya mdzad/ /g.yas gzhan rdo rje pad+ma dang*/ g.yon gzhan sdig mdzub ral gri'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes nag dkar dmar/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen g.yas/ /zhags pa ral gri pad+ma g.yon/ /de gnyis mi bskyod dbu rgyan te/ /kun kyang cha byad gtso bor mtshungs/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams zhabs kyis mnan/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ zhes bya'o/ /'dir zhags pa rnams sdig mdzub dang bcas thugs kar gtod pa yin la/ gshin rje mthar byed zhabs bzhi par yang bshad do/ / de nas 'khor lo drag tu bskor bas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ sum bha drag tu bzla/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo bcu rang gi lus la bsdu/ yaṃ dpung pa g.yon par gshin rje mthar byed/ praṃ g.yas par shes rab mthar byed/ paṃ lag pa g.yon pa la pad+ma mthar byed/ baṃ g.yas pa la bgegs mthar byed/ aṃ brla g.yon pa la mi g.yo ba/ ṭaṃ g.yas pa la 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ naṃ rkang pa g.yon pa la dbyug sngon can/ maṃ g.yas pa la stobs po che/ uṃ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ suṃ bshang laṃ du gnod mdzes rgyal po/ baṃ snying gar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /yang skad cig gis lus kyi khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu spros/ gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos te/ bgegs rnams thams cad la bgegs mthar byed phur bu'i gzugs can gyis phur bus btab/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nan/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag mtshan dang po tho bar gyur pa rnams kyis phur bu brdung bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra kī la ya a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya/ tiṣ+ta tiṣ+ta da sha di ka kī la yed duṣ+tan ts+tsha ta yed hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje me 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de dag ni gnas bsrung ba'o/ /bdud rtsi bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ kaṃ las ka pā la'i nang du li u ṛ i a las skyes pa'i bu mu ra ma shu rnams dang ā+-i ṝ u l̥̄ rnams las byung ba'i/ go ku da ha rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs sngags de nyid kyis lus la gtor de bdag bsrung ba'o/ /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms te/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ / rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtag pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun shags bya/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/

/dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum gnas dang bcas pa bsdus nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang yi ge gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūṃ la thim/ hūṃ lnga char rim gyis bsdus nas nā da'i bar du thim/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma sa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ las byung ba'i nam mkha'i khams chos 'byung ljang khu'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rtse mo brgyad pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i dbus hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /de'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las dus kyi me/ āḥlas dka' zlog ma/ oṃ las 'jigs byed chen po gdan du gnas pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la nyi gdan gyi steng du a ā aṃ a byung ba'i yi dwags kyi gdan rnams so/ /yang na aṃ saṃ maṃ taṃ rnams las skyes pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su zla ba'i gdan no/ /phyi rol me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la nyi gdan gyi steng du phyogs bzhir shuṃ shaṃ puṃ kleṃ/ dbang ldan la sogs pa rnams su/ baṃ soṃ goṃ oṃ rnams dang*/ bar gyi 'khor lo gsum la zla gdan te nam mkha'i 'khor lo pu dza o a go ra de ma/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ chu'i dkyil 'khor la pre gri so su/ na si ma ku ste/ yi ge sum cu so drug yongs su gyur pa las mi ro'i gdan rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi steng du a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'og tu ka kha ga gha nga*/

tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ nam mkha'i nā da las cha lnga'i rim pas hūṃ yig rdzogs/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs te kha sbyor gyi nang du gnas par gyur/ de las gdan rnams kyi steng du sa bon rnams spro bar bya ste/ ḍaṃ laṃ khaṃ ruṃ a ā aṃ aḥ kha uṃ shwaṃ suṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ/ praṃ tsaṃ praṃ muṃ suṃ khaṃ laṃ druṃ eṃ maṃ baṃ suṃ sh+yaṃ suṃ haṃ khaṃ tsaṃ khaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ suṃ maṃ tsaṃ maṃ/ dbus kyi hūṃ yongs su gyur pa la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin no/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros srid pa gsum po yongs su sbyangs nas/ snod thams cad gzhal med khang dang*/ bcud thams cad he ru ka'i lha tshogs su byas nas/ slar 'dus te zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas pa de dag thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ ri rab kyi lte ba rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ rwa bzhi'i phyogs kyi nam mkha' n-i thugs kyi 'khor lo/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ni gsung g-i 'khor lo/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor ni sku'i 'khor lo/ de phan chad sgos gnas dang phyi rol gyi khor yug ni me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa ste/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi'o/ /de yang phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu yangs pa'i nang rdo rje'i sa gzhi kha dog nag po la/ dur khrod chen po brgyad de/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ mdung gis 'bigs dang ro bsregs dang*/ rnag gi dri dang rul pa can/ dbang ldan nas g.yon bskor gyis/ byis pa shi dang sbrul gyis bzung*/ drag po'i g.yul dang lhag ma can/ yang na gtum grags la sogs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgom kyang rung ste/ bshad pa'i rgyud las gsung pa'i phyir ro/

/de dag tu phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang pa/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rin pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs/ nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum pa/ re re la'ang gdung dang*/ myos srung dang*/ ka thung gis bcad pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang*/ steng du har mi bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can la/ mchod pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ mtha' kha dog dmar pos bskor ba'o/ /yang na khyams dmar 'jam du byas kyang rung ngo*/ /nang gi lha snam shar nag lho dmar/ nub ser/ byang dkar ba sgo'i phyed kyi tshad dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i nang mtho bar sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang mtho bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can/ de'i nang mtho bar thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ dbu skra ser po steng du 'bar ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ klu chen po bcu'i rgyan dang*/

mgo bo'i do shal 'chang ba/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa stod g.yogs su brgyangs pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis ḍā ma ru dang*/ dgra sta dang*/ gri gug dang*/ rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon bzhis kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /

yang na zhabs g.yas brkyang du byas kyang rung ngo*/ / yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po 'am ljang khur yang bya la/ bcom ldan 'das dang sku mdog mtshungs par yang rung ste/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang lus bsam gyis sbyor ba can yin zhing*/ rlung dang me yang gsung gi phyogs la thabs shes su sbyor ba'i nges pas nag po dang dmar po sbyor ba dang*/ yang dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chung ba'i skabs su gsungs pa dang rigs pa mtshungs pas sngo ljang sbyor ba dang*/ dpal o rgyan pa sogs kyi bzhed pa dang mtshungs shing*/ mnyam nyid zung 'jug mtshon pa'i nges pa las yab yum kha dog 'dra ba yang ngo*/ /gang ltar yang / zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum drag mo chen mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdul dang ldan zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi zhabs dang lhan cig g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ lhor lā ma dmar mo/ nub tu dum skyes ma ser mo/ byang du gzugs can ma dkar mo/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ lho sgor 'ug gdong ma dmar mo/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma ser mo/ byang sgor phag gdong ma dkar mo/ byang shar gyi grwar gshin rje brtan ma dkar mo/ nub byang gi grwar gshin rje pho nya mo ser mo/ lho nub kyi grwar gshin rje mche ba ma dmar mo/ shar lho'i grwar gshin rje 'joms ma nag mo/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ gami mgo'i dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ drag mo chen mo lang tsho la bab pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pul+li ra ma la yar/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/ rab tu gtum mo/ lho phyogs dzā lan dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya ṇar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ byang phyogs ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/

byang shar go da wa rir su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ nub byang rasmi shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ lho nub de bī ko ṭir rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ shar lho ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /gsung 'khor gyi shar rtsibs kā ma ru par ang gu ri dang e ri wa ti/ lho rtsibs o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ byang shar ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ nub byang lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ lho nub kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ shar lho hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ lho phyogs gṛ ha de par rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub phyogs sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shauṇa ḍi ni/ byang phyogs su bar+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ byang shar na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ nub byang gi sin+dhur pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ lho nub ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ shar lhor ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste dpa' bo de thams cad phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams kyang*/ shar dang shar lho ba rnams nag po/ /lho dang bden bral ba rnams dmar po/ nub dang nub byang ba rnams ser po/ /byang dang byang shar ba rnams dkar po/ /thams cad shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ste/

rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mchan khung nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ / mgo bo skam po'i do shal can/ zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ skra grol ba/ drag mo chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams ni phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ lhan cig 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha byad thams cad 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dang phyogs mtshungs shing*/ g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'khor thams cad kyang mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs shing*/ dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ / 'dir thugs 'khor gyi lho'i phyag gi thod khrag ni/ bdud kyi thod khrag dang*/ gsung 'khor gyi ni lha'i dang*/ sku 'khor gyi rnams lha min gyi dang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo rnams mi'i thod khrag yin par gsungs so/ /de dag ni dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor rjes su rnal 'byor/ de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab par bya ste/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /snying kha'i 'khor lo'i dbus su mkha' 'gro ma/ mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dbus su lā ma/ lte ba'i chu skyes kyi dbus su khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ dpral pa'i 'dam skyes kyi dbus su gzugs can ma ste/ ri rab dang gling bzhi'i gnas rnam par dag pa'o/ /mdung gi 'bigs pa kha'i sgor khwa gdong ma/ ro bsregs pa sna bug g.yas kyi sgor 'ug gdong ma/ rnag gi dril bshang sgor khyi gdong ma/ rul pa can sna bug g.yon du phag gdong ma/ byis pa shi ba rna ba g.yon par gshin rje brtan ma/ sbrul gyis bzung ba rna ba g.yon par gshin rje pho nya ma/ drag po'i g.yul mig g.yas par gshin rje mche ba ma/ lhag ma can mig g.yon par gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /spyi bo pul+li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/

spyi gtsug dza lan+dha rar mahā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon go da ba rir su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /mchan khung gnyis ka ma ru par ang ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis oṃ ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen po/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ kha ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de bī/ mgrin par laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ snying ga kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'bras bu hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ brla gnyis sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shauṣ+ti ni/ byin pa gnyis su bar+ṇa dwi bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ rkang sor na gar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sin dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rkang pa'i mthe bong ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ / zhes brjod cing gsal btab/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ gong bzhin ro gdan dang*/ sa bon las lha rnams bskyed kyang legs par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas chos kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya ste/ rgyas par na sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin dag pa mtha' dag dran par bya la/

mdor bsdus na/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ / zhes sogs nas/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ / zhes pa'i bar ngag nas brjod cing bsams pa'o/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swābha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ de ltar skad cig rnam pa'i sngags kyis pho nya gsum bsre ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum byin gyis rlabs pa yin no/ /spyi bor oṃ las sku'i mkha' 'gro he ru ka dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung gi mkha' 'gro/ he ru ka dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ las thugs kyi mkha' 'gro he ru ka nag po/ lte bar hrīḥlas ye shes mkha' 'gro he ru ka ser po'o/ / 'di rnams kyang spro zhing nus na/ rim pa'i 'khor lo gsum dang ma mo bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba bsgom par bshad do/ / yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying kar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hriṃ hriṃ ser po skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsan+ṭi kā'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ / 'di dag kyang spro na lū yi pa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin zhal phyag rgyas par gsal gdab bo/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ka shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/

yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phaiṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñcan+tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā las dbang bskur/ sku lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rdo rje sems dpa'/ shar dang me'i lha la don yod grub pa/ lho dang bden bral pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub dang rlung mtshams pa la rnam par snang mdzad byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ yan na gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang sogs bde mchog gi sgrub thabs spyi dang mtshungs par rgyas btab byas kyang mi 'gal te/ khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa'i yum bka'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs pa dang yang 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /de nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ nang mchod slar yang byin gyis brlabs/ gtso bo brtsams te sngags rnams kyi mthar yi ge 'bru gsum sbyar bas myang bar bya la/ bod kyi lag len dang sbyar nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i thog mar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtshan nas smos te 'bul bar spro na/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag na rdo rje rigs ldan rgyal dka' dang*/ /grub thob bsod snyoms pa dang gnyis spangs zhabs/ /zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa'i blo gros dang*/ /sangs rgyas byed pa sangs rgyas 'od byed dang*/ /seng ha ke tu dpal gyi 'gram pa dang*/ /rnam grol lha dang badz+ra de ba dang*/ /ra ti gub+ta grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs/ /lha 'byung gang ba'i rdo rje la sogs pa/

/rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / yang na/ he ru ka dang ye shes bshes gnyen dang*/ /zhi ba'i zhabs dang lha yi 'byung ldan dang*/ /gang ba'i rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /nye brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / zhes brjod kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i rjes su phra thig gi rnal 'byor cung zad bsgoms te sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni 'khor lo'i bzlas pa gtso bor byed cing*/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ haṃ haṃ hrīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ / oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ haṃ hiṃ hūṃ heṃ haṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshon cha'i sngags so/ / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye swāhā/ yi ge bcu pa yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ baṃ yoṃ moṃ/ hraiṃ hrīṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ go cha'i sngags so/ / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha badz+ra ḍā ki ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la sogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags dang*/ oṃ na mo ga wa te bī ri shā ya/ badz+ra ka kā s+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la sogs pa sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags so/ / oṃ ka ra ka ra badz+ra pra tsiṇ+ḍe badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la sogs pa 'khor lo gsum gyi sngags rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzla bar bya'o/ /rjes dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ dag pa gsum dran pa'i thun mtshams su 'jug pa la sogs sdom pa'i sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ oṃ badz+ra krodhe shwa ri sarba dra bya ṇi bi shud+dhe hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags lan gsum la sogs pas sbyangs la/ gong nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ā kaḍ+ḍah+ya ka ā kaḍ+ḍah+ya pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki ni naṃ hri da yaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa'i sngags dang haṃ gi sgras spyan drangs/ oṃ sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis gtso bo la phul/ skabs der rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas btab bo/ /de nas 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bde mchog spyi dang mthun par btang*/ de'i mthar yul dang grong gi bdag po'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ k+ṣe tra pā la ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sa pa ri wa re bh+yo sarba sa twa nāṃ shin+taṃ tsit+te na ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣe tra pā la a hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab byas te/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol gyi mthar/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes dang*/ k+ṣaḥzha ེsa mang du brjod cing*/ lag pa'i rgyab tu se gol gtogs pas gshegs so/ /'di'i phyi rol mchod pa la sogs pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rgya nag byang phyogs lam gyi rim pa las shes par bya'o/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ phud phul te de'i 'og tu/ oṃ ha ri ta piṇ+ḍa ke pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la chang bu gnyis dang*/ oṃ dū ti ke a gra a gra sam pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

pho nya rnams la chang bu sbyin/ de nas 'bru gsum bzla zhing zos la/ lhag ma'i chang bu/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ta bha k+ṣa ka swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin no/ /de la 'di ni dus 'khor ye shes le'ur bshad pa'i sdom pa chung ba dang lha dang sngags 'dra yang*/ de ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dus 'khor kho na'i cho gas bsgrub dgos la/ 'dir ni phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi lugs de mchog nyung ngu'i rang lugs su sbyar ba/ sgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyi snying po las byung ba la/ kha 'gengs dgos rnams rig ldan gyis mdzad pa'i yum dka'i sgrub thabs las blangs shing*/ mi gsal ba cung zad yod pa rnams grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /'dir yang na dbyibs rdzogs pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog de man chad las rgyal mchog /de nas thig phra gnyis te yan chad bzhi'i chings byas kyang rung ngo*/ /tshul 'dis thun bzhir bsgoms te/ /zla ba drug la sogs pas sems cung zad tsam brtan pa na/ sems 'grel nyid las bshad pa ltar lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa byas nas thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams bsgrub par bya ba'am/ yang na rdzogs pa rim pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'di ni sgrub thabs kun gyi mchog gyur yin yang grags chung bas/ /sems 'grel shes par rlom pa'i chen po 'gas kyang 'di ma rtogs/ /grub pa'i man ngag 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung las 'di thob pa'ang*/ /kun las ches cher gyur pa'i bsod nams bgo skal yod pa'i rtags/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su bgrangs pa sems 'grel gyi lugs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bsdus rgyud rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan te/ dang po'o// //na ma sh+tsakra sam+bha rā ya/ dpal ldan sku ni thams cad pa/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems dpa' bo/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun 'joms pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/

/btud nas dpa' bo lū yi pa'i/ /bzhed don 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung*/ /ji bzhin sdom pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu nyung ngu'i tshig gis brjod/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi don nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lte bar ā li kā li g.yon bskor du 'khod pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ oṃ a āḥ nas/ ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ / zhes pa nas/ nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ oṃ sum+bha nas/ bha ga wān badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sngags rnams nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ de las 'og tu hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i dra ba rnams su gyur/ tsham rngam dang bcas pas sum+bha tshar gcig brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug hūṃ rwa ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ 'brub khung byung ba rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod tho bas brdungs oṃ badz+ra muṅgar= sogs bgegs rnams bde ba chen po'i dbyings su bsgral/ rwa ba la thims/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i rwa ba rim pa gsum gyis bskor zhing phyogs thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/

rang gi snying gar aṃ las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sogs brjod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs kyis rgyun sogs kyi rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i dbus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ du gyur/ oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūṃ la thim/ hūṃ cha lnga nā da'i bar du thim/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ nā da yang stong par thim/ cung zad mnyam par bzhagastong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las spros pa'i yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar g.yon bskor gyis a āḥ nas aṃ aḥnyis 'gyur dang*/ g.yas bskor gyis ka kha ga gha nga = nas ha k+ṣa ḍa ḍha da dha/ ya la nyis 'gyur du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ā li bcu drug dang kā li bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nam mkha'i nā da yongs su zhugs te de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hūṃ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/

de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad can spyan drangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra byed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta bab kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng pas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu 'khyud rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad po sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyung bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ / dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ /mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/

rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyang te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+waṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskyang bas dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyang ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang du ma ha kang ka la dang*/ gtum mig ma/ nub tu kang ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor su ra bī ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/

lho nub tu 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang du rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar du rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su ang ku ri dang e ra wa ri/ byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ru rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang po dang*/ sh+yā ma de bī/ lho nub tu rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang du 'jigs byed chen mo dang rta rna ma/ byang shar du mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su stobs po che dang 'khor lo'o shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hī/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sna rings ma/ lho nub nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo rnams phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa/ lhag ma dpal he ru ka dang mtshungs shing*/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /dpa' mo rnams rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa las/ g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/

byang shar du gshin rje 'joms pa g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi cod pan dang ldan pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan par gyur/ gtso bo thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ yang na snying gar hūṃ dang*/ lte bar ā li kā li'i 'du 'phro las/ ye shes sems dpa' bskyed ces gsungs pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ri yo gi nī kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ yab yum gnyis ka'i mig gnyis la oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa la/ dza las gzugs rdo rje ma me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rna ba la hūṃ la zhe sdang rdo rje nag po la/ hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo pi waṃ 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ sna la traṃ las ser sna rdo rje ser po la/ baṃ las dri rdo rje ma ser mo dung chos 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ lcer a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa la/ ho las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ dpral par haṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang ku la khaṃ las reg rdo rje ma ljang khu na bza' 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ snying gar hūṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po rdo rje dkar po 'dzin pa la raṃ las chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/

sgra rdo rje ma ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ gzhan de rnams yab yum mtshungs par rim pas rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ don grub/ rdor sems rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa/ yab rnams g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pa'o/ /gti mug rdo rje zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /lte bar laṃ las ltung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying khar baṃ las gsod byed ma sngon mo rdo rje/ mgrin par paṃ las 'gug byed ma dmar mo pad+ma/ spyi bor taṃ las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ljang khu ral gri/ thams cad kyang lhag ma gsum gyis gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ka 'dzin pa/ gsang bar khaṃ las pad+ma dra ba can dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum na gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum na thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rim pas bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ hriḥho aṃ rnams las skyes pa'i rnam snang*/ mi bskyod/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan rnams kyis yang dag par 'khyud pa/ de thams cad kyang zla ba la gnas pa/ mgo bor gzugs phung buṃ las rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon yum gyi dkur bsten pa/ ltung byed mas 'khyud pa/ lte bar tshor phung oṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'phyang ba/ gsod byed mas 'khyud pa/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi phung po hriḥlas pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma 'phyang ba/ 'gugs byed mas 'khyud pa/ long bur 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po sngo sangs sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyang ba/ pad+ma gar dbang mas 'khyud pa/ gsum char phyag g.yon thugs kar bsgyings pa/ snying gar rnam shes kyi phung po hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon dkur bsten pa/ dra ba can mas 'khyud pa/ phung po thams cad kyi spyi ni hi las he ru ka nag po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon can/

g.yon bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i dkur bsten pa la/ gsod byed mas 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /snying gar oṃ hā dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po las mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ lus thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu las rta mchog /lte bar oṃ laṃ dmar mo las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po las gshin rje ma/ khar hraṃ moṃ dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hriṃ hriṃ ser mo las bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsaṇ+ḍi kā rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis dang*/ rmongs byed ma zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /

'di dag spyi dang 'dra'o/ / yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje nag po/ byāṃ las nor bu byāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ d+yāṃ las ze'u 'bru d+yāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang snying gar/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang mgo bo la yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ de bzhin du yum gyi lte ba dang snying gar/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang spyi bor yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ phan tshun 'khyud pa dang btsum pas rjes su chags par byas/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gsung zhing*/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod rnams dril bu lus dkyil dang 'dra ba las/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /lo i dha ri ka dang dril bu pa/ /dza lan+dha ri pa dang dpe med dpal/ /sau ri pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas/ /legs spyod 'byung gnas mtha' yas 'byung gnas sbas/

/glo bo lo tsā 'phags pa ye rin dang*/ /ri khrod kun 'ong bag ston tshul rgyal dang*/ / 'jam ral blo brtan rin rgyal khrims khang ba/ /byams pa kun dga' pad+ma chos skyong dang*/ /bsod nams rgyal mchog rje btsun lha dbang grags/ / yang na dza lan+dha ra mi byed/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje byang chub bzang*/ /a bha ya dang tsa mi rga lo zhang*/ /brag nag ri khrod ras pa lha gong pa/ /dmar ston bsod 'phel bag ston man sngar bzhin nam/ yang na/ 'jigs med byung gnas nā ya ka pa dang*/ /bi khya ta dang shākya shrī dang*/ /dā na shī la g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ /ze dmar ba dang kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ /'chims chen blo bzang kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ /grub she gzhon nu dpal dang khrims khang pa/ / byas kyang rung la/ yang na zhang 'tshal pa'i rjes la/ shākya ye shes sangs rgyas snying po dang*/ /sangs rgyas gzhon nu gser khang stengs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rin chen shākya 'bum pa dang*/ /shākya bsod nams dbon po chos bzang dang*/ /grags pa don mchog bsod nams grub pa dang*/ /grags pa'i mtshan can bla ma rtogs ldan pa/ /lhun bde 'brug chen rnam rgyal bkra shis dang*/ /grol mchog rje dang lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs/ / zhes pa'ang byin rlabs dang ldan pa'o/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags gnyis kyis bstod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ rjes gzhig gi rim pas dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdus la/ slar yang rdzogs par ldang bar bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/ zhes sogs/ rnal 'byor pa kun spyod bzhin du brjod do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ lū yi pa spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ 'on kyang sngags bzla tshul/ kha sbyor gyi bzlas pa ni lugs 'di mi mdzad pas/ so sor bzlas pa bya'o// mthar yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor thim/

lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gsal bar gyur/ spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag pa dang*/ /rna g.yon smin dbus mig dang phrag pa dang*/ /mchan khung nu ma lte ba sna rtse mgrin/ kha dang snying ga 'bras bus mtshan ma dang*/ /bshang lam brla dang byin pa rkang sor bol/ /rkang mtheb pus mo yul chen nyi shur gyur/ /pu dza o a/ go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la hi/ pre gṛ sau su/ na si ma ku/ de dag tu gnas pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ mi phyed phra gzugs rtse ma g.yon/ /thung ngu rus sbal sgo ma dbang*/ /skyon ma 'jug ma ma mo mtshan/ /sil sbyin tsha ba gzhol ma rangs/ /gzugs can spyi ma rgyu sbyin ma/ /sbyor bral sdug gu grub ma 'tshed/ /yid bzang sum skor 'dod ma khyim/ /gtum mo rnams la rim bzhin du/ /rab gtum gti mug 'od ldan sna chen ma/ /brtan blo me'u thung las ka shing grib ma/ /sa srung 'jigs byed rlung shugs chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs shin bzang rta rna bya gdong ma/ /'khor shugs dum skyes chang tshong go cha ma/ /dpa' mo stobs chen 'khor bsgyur brtson chen ma/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ so son skra spu lpags pa dri ma sha /rus pa rgyus pa mkhal ma snying dang mchin/ /mig 'bras mkhris pa glo ba rgyu ma zhag /lte ba chu so 'dom par bad kan rnag khrag rngul tshil dang 'chil ma brnabs zhes te/ /rim bzhin thod dum keng rus chen po dang*/ /keng rus mche gtsigs lha dgra 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje'i sku dang ni/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje ral pa can/ /dpa' chen hūṃ mdzad rab bzang rdo rje bzang*/ /'jigs chen rta rna stobs chen rin rdor dang*/ /rta mgrin mkha' snying khrag 'thung gar dbang phyug /rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams su gyur/ kha dang rna g.yon gsang ba sna bug g.yas/ /rna ba g.yas g.yon mig rtsa g.yas g.yon la/ khwa gdong 'ug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong dang*/

/brtan ma pho nya mche gtsigs 'joms ma'o/ /snying mgrin lte ba dpral pa'i 'khor lo la/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /spyi bo gsang bar thig le dkar dmar ni/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mor gyur/ / de ltar lus dkyil la rgyun ring du sems gtad cing bsgom mo/ /de nas/ chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i lhag par mos te/ go cha gnyis bgos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /gtor chog ni/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhās sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa/ hūṃ buṃ aṃ hrīḥkhaṃ bh+ruṃ hūṃ hrīḥtāṃ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga gyur/ ha ho hriḥyig rnams kyis kha dog dang dri dang ro nus pa ngan pa sbyangs/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas/ kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ de'i rlangs pa las byung ba steng gi nam mkha' la hūṃ las kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ de zhu zhing thim pas dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las hūṃ āḥ.oṃ brtsegs pa oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems dang rgya mtsho'i bcud sogs snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ lan mang du brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bsrung ba bka'i 'khor lo khro bo bcu dang bcas pa phyi rol phyogs skyong ba bcu khams gsum gyi sems can mtha' dag dang bcas pa pheṭa ces ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ kak+ka dha na/ bab+bhan+dha na/ khakh+kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ta na hā na ha na/

gha gha ghā ta ya/ ma ma shīn+tiṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams bkug de thams cad 'od gsal du bcug skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ ā hrīḥpra wa ra sat+ka rāt+thaṃ añcha ma naṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod phul/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya staṃ/ hṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan lngas he ru ka yab yum mo bcu gnyis dang bcas pa la phul/ oṃ ka ra ka ra sogs lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum la phul/ oṃ kha badz+ra dhi ga badz+ra hūṃ kā ra badz+ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma shin+taṃ rak+ṣañca ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra= badz+ra na lārka= badz+ro ṣ+ṇi ṣa= badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li= badz+ra yak+sha= badz+ra kā la= badz+ra mahā bā la= badz+ra bhi ṣa ṇa/ badz+raṣ+ṇi ṣa warti= oṃ badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma shin+taṃ rak+ṣa ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ces khro bo bcu gcig la phul/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi nas pra yats+tshan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas 'jig rten pa la phul/ 'dod don gsol btab spyi dang 'dra/ he ru'i yig brgya'i mthar bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /gal te mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ phung khams skye mched kyi dag pa bor la/ ye shes tshogs bsogs yan sngar ltar bsgom/ bsrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab/ go cha gnyis bgo ba man chad sngar ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ /shin tu bsdus pa ni rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad par gyur 'di yang*/ phun tshogs yon tan tshad med de/ /grub pa'i dga' ston brgya phrag ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtag tu thob/ /'di dngos lū yi pa 'grel lugs ky-i sgrub thabs ma yin zhing yin par yang bzhed mod/ zur du dbang bskur ba'i rgyun ma nub par yod pa dang*/

phyis rgya bal rnams na 'di kho na ches cher dar bas mkhas grub dam pa mtha' yas pa'i thugs dam yin pas gal che ba dang*/ lū yi lugs rnying pa dang mi 'dra bar skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ lus dkyil gyi dkyil phral kyang chog pa sogs slob dpon 'jigs med nyid kyi rang bzhed kyang ci rigs yod pas logs su 'grub na legs par mthong ngo*/ /lugs 'di la lo tsā ba tre bo shes rab dpal gyis sgrub thabs dang 'phreng ba nas btus te dkyil chog sgyur sgrub thabs la gzhan yang dā na shrī la dang*/ zhang lo grub pa dpal dang*/ chag gi 'gyur yod bi bhu ti'i dkyil 'khor chog kyang 'di dang sbyor rgyu yin/ lar rga lo/ se lo/ kha che paṇa chen/ bi bhu ti/ zhang lo/ chag lo/ glo bo lo tsā/ g.yag sde lo tsā/ shud ge lo tsā/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag rin lugs sogs mang po'o/ /slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs 'khrul pa spong ba'i lugs ltar/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ste/ gnyis pa'o// //༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ sna tshogs sgeg pa'i nyams rgyas shing*/ /bcu gnyis yan lag ma dang rol/ /spros kun 'od gsal chen por sdom/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'dud/ /dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas byed tshul rnams spyi dang mthun la/ spro zhing nus na phyi rol mchod pa dang lag mchod skabs 'dir byed par gsungs shing*/ de dag byas na dkyus kyi tshogs zhing tshogs gsog mi dgos la de gnyis kyi byed tshul yang bde mchog lugs gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /'dir sgom pa gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te/ 'di ltar/ oṃ shrī he ru ka haṃ/ rang skad cig gis phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag btsal/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pad+yāṃ/ puṣ+pe= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas rgyun bshags ni/ byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yid rang zhing*/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ dra ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i dra ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/

oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa rā dza la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+ruṃ las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang gzungs ma dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā nas aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i bar/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyis ka kha ga nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/

lha bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar g.yas ser zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+waṃ ka bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭ+waṃ ka 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdig mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/

lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dbu la brgyan zh-ing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po ās mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab ky-i snying gar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ las/ rin chen 'byung ldan zer yang*/ pad ma gar dbang dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he las he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho las/ 'od dpag med zer yang*/ rdo rje nyi ma mthing kha/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog ljang khu rnams rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon po/ khar hriṃ mo las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral par hreṃ hriṃ las bskyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi kā dud kha rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gis 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/

slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma bzhi la don grub kyi dbu rgyan par gyur/

'dus pa zhabs lugs ltar mchod lha mkha' nang nas spros te/ gong bzhin ar+g+gaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha rnams kyi rang sngags kyi nang mchod myang*/ gsang mchod bya/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs= sogs la 'jug tu/ mgon po bde mchog dpal ldan dgyes pas bzhengs/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang*/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+bha ra swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /ma mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags ni spyi dang mtshungs so/ / rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis phog pa'i snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ dang*/ āḥlas zla ba dang*/ hūṃ las rdo rje āḥdang hūṃ gis mtshan pa rnams brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi babs/ oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/

rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dam tshig can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa phaiṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ a ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma s+t+waṃ ḍi sh+ya hoḥ lan bzhis dkyil 'khor la phul/ oṃ kha kha= sogs kyis 'jig rten pa la phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ lha yi tshogs rnams= sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzlas/ khyod kyis sems can= sogs dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras= sogs kyang spro na brjod la/ muḥ zhes gshegs/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis= sogs dang*/ sngags dman pa dang*/ sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma= sogs brjod/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ dkyil 'khor rang la thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang shā ba ri pa dang*/ /mai tri ti phu ba reg ras chung pa/ /lo sum gling ras < dga' ldan pa > rgya ras bsod nams dang*/ nges 'byung < 'gir bu pa > dar dang 'od zer rgya mtsho dang*/ /sangs rgyas ras pa skyes mchog smon lam pa/ /yon tan < lung mangs pa > bzang po kun dga' dpal 'byor dang*/ /ngag dbang chos rgyal rnam rgyal bkra shis dang*/ /grol mchog rje dang lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs/ /de rnams chos rgyud mang po'i dbang du byas/ /dbang brgyud tsam la rgyud tshul gzhan < seng ge dgu > yang yod/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis mdor bsdus nas/ /don zab don ni rgya che ba/ /blo dman rnams la gsal bar byas/ /'khor lo sdom pa mai tri bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs te gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni tsa rā ṇa ya/ mtha' dag rgyal ba kun gyis bde bskyed yum/ /li khri'i mdangs 'phrog 'jo sgeg lang tsho can/ /mtshar sdug 'od 'bar rab grags dpa' mo'i sku/

/rdo rje btsun mo'i bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ bde ba'i gdan la kha nub tu phyogs nas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang nas/ bā ra hi a haṃ/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ oṃ a ā nas aṃ aḥ ka kha= nas ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa lan gsum/ ā li kā li'i 'phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan/ lte bar lan gsum g.yon skor du 'khyil ba/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs rnams bcom ste slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ rang g-i mgo bo lte ba/ mgrin pa/ long bu snying kha/ spyi gtsug rnams su rim pas/ gzugs kyi phung po oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ tshor ba'i phung po aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ 'du shes kyis phung po hriḥlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ phung po lnga char gyi ngo bo he las he ru ka nag po/ mig 'bras/ rna ba'i khung*/ sna bugalce'i rtsa ba/ dpral pa/ snying ga rnams su rim pas/ mig oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ rna ba hūṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ sna traṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ lus khams las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu/ skye mched spyi hūṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dmar mo/ lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral pa/ gsang gnas rnams su rim pas/ sa khams laṃ las ltung byed ma ser mo/ chu khams laṃ las gsod byed ma nag mo/ me khams paṃ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ rlung khams taṃ las gar dbang ma ljang khu/ mkha' khams khaṃ las pad+ma dra ba can ma dud kha rnams su gyur/ 'di dag zhal phyag rgyas par sgom par 'dod na/

lū yi pa'i 'grel pa lā ba pa'i dang shes rab bsrung ba mdzad pa ltar shes par bya la/ bsdu na yab rnams rdo rje dril bu dang*/ yum rnams gri thod 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i 'od kyi nang gi rnyogs pa bsal te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nas/ oṃ dharmā dha tu badz+ra ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa ma lus rnams/ khyed rnams kun gyi mngon du so sor bshags par bgyi/ bla ma la sogs rnams kyis bsod nams bgyis pa gang*/ de rnams ma lus kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bya ba byas pa byed par 'gyur ba gang dag gi /dge ba'i des ni sems can ma lus rgyal bar smon/ /dkon mchog gsum la nges par yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba bde la 'god phyir chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi lam la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /mgon po bzhes shing bdag gis lus 'di dbul ba lags/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces sogs tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da'i rnam par langs nas nam mkhar gnas par bsams/

'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'o/ /sdigs mdzub bskor zhing se gol gdab pa'i mtshams rngam phyogs bzhir byed du/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nas/ bī d+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba/ gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ga ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ slar yang phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i/ oṃ sum+bha/ sogs/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags lan gnyis brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kha dog so sor nges pa can/ tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūṃ las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bcug/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha= sogs phur bu'i spyi bor tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra murka ra= sogs/ bgegs rnams phur bus btab pas 'od gsal tu thim par gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i bh+ruṃ las rnam par snang mdzad shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/

gser gyi snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang mda' yab dang gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar paṃ las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a ā= nas aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis la zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa ḍa ḍha/ da dha/ ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du baṃ las rdo rje'i lte bar baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te baṃ la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing*/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku can rjes chags bde ba'i nyams kyis myos pa'i sku can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar zhing bkra la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam rdo rje mthur du sdigs shing*/ sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad 'joms pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon par kha ṭ+waṃ ga thabs kyi rang bzhin can la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha dang*/ 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ dmar chen gyi btung bas myos shing*/ si h+la'i rgyun 'bab pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / snying po dang nye snying tshar gcig brjod/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams bzhir khu ba dang*/ khrag dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dza lan+dha rar gtum mig ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs arbu tar sna chen ma/ shar lho go dā ba rir dpa' blo ma/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de wi ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar shing grib ma ste/

thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma ru par sa bsrungs ma/ byang rtsibs o ṭer 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub lam+ba kar shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kiñcir rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gṛ hā hā de wa khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub rtsibs sau raṣ+tar sho na ṭi ni/ lho rtsibs su war+ṇa dwi par 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku li tar brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ / dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad shin tu drag mo'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma so drug po thams cad gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ mi mgo'i cod pan dang do shal can/
g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /

de lta bu'i sgrub thabs snye ma'i lugs yin la/ u ma pa ti dat+ta ltar na mngon byang lnga las/ rten brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ ma mo bcu gnyis phyag bzhi pa'i phyogs la legs pa'ang yin la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang ma mo bcu gnyis dang mtshungs par phyag bzhi ma mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'di ni 'khor lo gsum gyi lha yum rkyang du byed phyin yab dang phyag mtshan grangs mthun na legs par dgongs pa yin kyang de ltar na dang po gnyis kyang rdo dril 'dzin dgos par 'gyur ram ci/ spyir 'khor thams cad kyang phyag gnyis su byas na'ang legs pa yin no/ / oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ky-i bar rnams tshar gcig brjod par bya'o/ / rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal med khang gru bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dabs so gnyis pad+ma/ der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le/ dbyangs dang gsal byed ky-i ngo bo/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi la thod pa bzhi/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza o a/ go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su/ na si ma ku rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ spyi bor rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug tu gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas su 'od ldan ma/ ltag par sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon du dpa' bo'i blo ma/ smin mtshams su mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis su lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dpung pa gnyis su shing grib ma/ mchan khung gnyis su sa bsrung ma/ nu ma gnyis su 'jigs byed chen po lte bar rlung shugs ma/ sna rtser chang 'thung ma/ khar sngo sangs lha mo/ mgrin par shin tu bzang mo/ snying khar rta rna ma/ 'doms bar la bya gdong ma/

mtshan ma la 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ brla gnyis su shauṇ+ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ sor mo brgyad la shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su stobs chen ma/ mthe bong gnyis su 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis la brtson 'grus chen mo/ lce'i rtsa bar khwa gdong ma/ lte bar 'ug gdong ma/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgor phag gdong ma/ mdzod pur gshin rje brtan ma/ rna bar pho nya ma/ mig la mche ba ma/ sna bug tu 'joms ma'o/ / de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang = zhes pa nas/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod dgos pa las/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal rdo rje phag mo'o/ / zhes brjod/ rang gi mig tu bh+rūṃ/ rna bar hūṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la āḥ dpral par haṃ/ snying gar ha/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo= nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo'i bar dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying ga'i dbus su pad nyi'i steng du/ rdo rje'i lte bar baṃ/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni= zhes pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bkur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'dod dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don grub gyi dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rdor 'dzin phag mo in+t+ra bhu ti dang*/
