/dpal mo bi ru pa dang ḍo bhi pa/ /ngo mtshar rdo rje gar+bha ri pa dang*/ /gaṃ ga dha ra dga' ba'i rdo rje dang*/ /dpal 'dzin ye shes rdo rje dge 'byung sbas/ khrag 'thung rdo rje lhan skyes rdo rje dang*/ /chos dbang bdud las rgyal dang sa 'dzin zhabs/ /dpa' bo dpal gyi bshes gnyen chos grags dang*/ /rin chen grags pa nags rin byams gling pa/ /bsod nams tshe brtan rin chen chos dbang dang*/ /bstan bzang rin chen grags pa'i ba dan dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /'dir ye shes rdo rje zer ba ni a bha ya ka ra yin gsung la/ dge 'byung sbas pa dang shākya rak+ṣi ta gdam nga'o/ /yang na 'khrul spong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ltar ram/ 'phreng ba'i brgyud pa ltar byas kyang rung la/ yang na/ rdo rje phag mo grub thob si ro pa/ u ma pa ti dar ta ngag dbang sbas/ chos rab ye shes seṅge 'bum seng dang*/ /rga lo sher seng blo chen gnas drug pa/ /sa bzang paṇa chen sa bzang 'phags pa dang*/ /don bzang < don yod bzang po zer > rgyal mtshan 'od zer byams gling pa/ / de man chad gong bzhin no/ /snying po dang lha rnams sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ man ngag ltar rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa'am/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ u ma pa ti dat+ta ltar na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā rā hi/ zhes sogs dang*/ snye ma ltar na/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī pro taṅge= sogs rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags ci 'grub tu bzla zhing*/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa snying po ste/

de dag ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim pas baṃ yig la thim/ bam yig yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i rnam par langs te/ go chas rgyas btab thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na bzlas pa'i mthar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'khrul spong gi gtor chog kho na 'don pa bsgyur bas bya ba yin pas/ sgrub thabs snying po gong du bshad par shes par bya'o/ /lag mchod dang phyi rol mchod pa sogs kyang gzhan du rtogs par 'gyur bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /dpal mthu stobs kyi mgon po bi rā pa gang las mchog gi gnas brnyes pa'i lam yang 'di las gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /zhes tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dag gsung ngo*/ /rim pa 'di kho nas lha bcu gsum gyis dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha lnga dang*/ dpa' mo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyang 'dor len shes par sgrub thabs gnyis las gsungs pa ltar yin/ lha nyer lnga yang rgyud kyi rim pas 'byung la/ 'phreng ba las byung ba'i dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ser mo dang sngon mo'i dkyil 'khor la yang bskyed tshul cho ga 'dis sgrub cing gtso mo 'di la 'khor rnams de de bzhin du mos na'ang bsgoms su rung ba ste/ thams cad la dag pa'i rim pa ni 'di nyid kho nas so/ /grub mchog stong gis gshegs pa'i lam yangs por/ blo gros shing rtas nye bar 'tsho ba bdag /rdo rje btsun mos rtag tu rjes bzung nas/ /he ru ka dpal bdag po'i sar 'god shog /ces pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i thabs ste bzhi pa'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru we/ phun tshogs kun gyis gter chen po/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho

ste/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bri/ /da ni bshad rgyud rnams las thog mar dpal sdom pa 'byung ba rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bar byas la/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ rang bde mchog phyag gnyis par gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ 'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid shrī he ru ka'o/ /sa'i khams ltung byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod byed ma/ me'i khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can/ mig gnyis la gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba gnyis la zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna la phrag dog rdo rje/ lce la 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus la ser sna rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ / sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol phyogs bcur gdab cing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa grih+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha wan bid+yā rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gnyis brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'o/ /slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer las sgo mtshams ma brgyad thod pa dang phur bu thogs pa'i tshogs spros/ phyi rol tu hūṃ las byung ba'i 'brub khung rnams su bgegs rnams bcug spyi bor phur bus btab/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la/ badz+ra dha roḍa a dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān/ ka ya wāka tsit+ta kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bcom ste bde ba chen po dang ro gcig tu gyur/ rang gi snying khar paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du/ aṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thung bas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa yul du bsgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i gsung*/ dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mgon po mchog /bla ma mchog la mgo bos btud de rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la mi byed dran pa med/ / dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhrī pra wa ra sat+ka ra pro k+ṣa naṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ pro kā ṇaṃ gi gnas su añca ma naṃ dang*/ ar+ghaṃ dang*/ pād+yaṃ rnams bcug pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags byas/ spro na/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / zhes sogs sdom bzung rgyas pa yang bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/

de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che'i sna bzhi las grub pa de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i steng du/ a ā nas aṃ aḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba/ de'i steng du yang ka nas k+ṣa rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus su rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor tshur bsdus/ hūṃ gi nā da la thim/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ de'i phyi rol pad 'dab kyi khor yug dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/

/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gsum pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo rnam par snang mdzad ma/ sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la 'khyud cing g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyis do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de ltar sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni shin tu drag mo'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la gnas pa/

thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ka bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa dngos grub thams cad rtsol ba'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin gyi sems dpa' nyi ma la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba wī ra yo gi ni ka ya wak+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad=

zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod la/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ/ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mi gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsan+ḍi kā /rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ / spro na go cha chen mo yang bkod/ yum gyi mkha' a la pad 'dab ma gsum d+yāṃ las ze'u 'bru/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje byāṃ las nor bu/ yab kyi lte ba dang thugs kar yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang*/ dpral par yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ yum gyi lte ba dang snying gar yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin par dang dpral par yum gyi snying po dang nye snying yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang*/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes brjod dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/

zhes gsungs zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang*/ lā ma la rin 'byung*/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzhan rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang lū yi dha ri ka /dril bu rus sbal dpal zhabs dang dpe med dpal/ shān+ti pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas dang*/ /dge 'byung legs spyod rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ /chag lo go lung pa dang g.yung phug pa/ /shong ston blo brtan lo mchog dpal ldan pa/ /bu ston khyung lhas pa dang bkres rin pa/ /ngor chen rin chen bkra shis paṇa chen rje/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas 'od zer dang*/ /kun dga' grol mchog rje btsun bla ma ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /yang na/ bu ston thugs sras nor bzang rin chen dang*/ /rin rgyal mkhyen rab rje dang bkra shis dpal/ /dgon ston pa dang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang*/ /rtsa < dpal chos pa > ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ / zhes rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phul/ so so'i sngags kyis lha tshogs la phul rang gis myangs/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyis ngang du thim/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ phung po lnga dag he ru ka /zhal gsum rnam par thar pa gsum/ /pha rol phyin pa drug gis phyag /bden gnyis dbyer med yum dang sbyor/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa dang*/ /bcu gnyis sa yi ngo bo ni/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcu gnyis te/ /tshad med 'byung ba bsdu dngos bzhi'o/ /'dzag med thod pa'i snod bzhi ste/ /byang chub phyogs mthun khang brtsegs dang*/

/bdud bcom srung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ /rnam shes brgyad dag dur khrod do/ / de nas 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ / oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ lā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka kā s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu ka s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwā na s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka ra s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ḍā ḍhi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma du tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ti ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun mtshams la 'jug par 'dod na/ go cha bcings te dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na gtor ma gnyis bshams la/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa/ oṃ traṃ aṃ khaṃ hūṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ laṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ baṃ las sha lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar mo bdud rtsis rang bzhin can/ de zhu zhing thim pas/ dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ yang steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ āḥ.oṃ brtsegs pa/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu zhing 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ/

phaiṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ in+d+ra sa pa ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ya ma sa pa ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de bzhin du/ wa ru ṇa= ku we ra= ma hā bhu ta= ag+ni= rak+ṣa sā= ba yu de wa ta= tsan+d+ra sur+yā= brah+ma= a di de wa sa pa ri wa rā nā a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ be ma tsi tri pri thi bī de wa ta sa pā ri wa rā na a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ saṃ trip+ta sarba de wa ta/ sadha ka s+ya/ shin+taṃ ku ru/ sarba kār+yaṃ/ sab+bhir+bha wa ru ya thā su khaṃ/ mu khe/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ pad skor dang bcas te/ mkha' 'gro'i drwa ba/ dam pa'i bde ba/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gis/ / bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /oṃ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru nas dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtso bo yab yum la phul/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya ho/ dra sh+ya ho lan gsum mam lngas 'khor rnams la phul/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rlun sems la ni/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ces gsol ba btab/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa nas/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa'i tshogs la phul/ rkang ba brgyad pas bstod la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas mnyes par bsam/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod/

/ ces pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs blangs par bya'o/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bris pa las/ /byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /'gro kun he ru ka thob shog/ces pa sdom byung lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs te lnga pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la de wi bh+yaḥ gang zhig theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo yang*/ /bla med rdo rje theg par nges 'jug pa/ /'di las ngo mtshar ci yang skyes gyur pas/ /sgrub thabs 'di la bdag sems lhag par dga'/ /da ni bshad rgyud dpal a bhi dha na las dngos su 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor drug gi sgrub thabs bshad par bya ba las thog mar ni rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dngos grub mchog la nye bar gzhol ba rnams kyis nan tan du bya ba'i 'os ni 'di yang ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du 'gro bas/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs la myang ba'am/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar bcug la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas sems bskyed dang rdor sems sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun par bya/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis lus dag pas/ he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor shar phyogs kyi dur khrod kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog gi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/

lus 'di dag dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra bī ni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra waṃ se hūṃ/ de'i bzhin du sbyar te/ mu ra dze= mu kun de= ha s+ye= lā se= girti= nirti= puṣ+pe= dhu pe= dī pe= gan+dhe= a dar she= ra s+ya= spar she= oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ ma taṃ gi sogs lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos dges par bsam la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdag gi sdig pa thams cad bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing*/ slad nas kyang sdom par bgyid lags so/ /sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ so so skye bo'i dge thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bdag gi dge ba thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /bdag byang chub kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba'i ngo bo dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /des bstan pa'i gsang sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i ngo bo chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /sems can la phan pa dang bde ba dang mchog mthar phyin pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyis byang chub la 'god pa'i slad du/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/

/bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du rdo rje theg pa la brten par bgyi'o/ / zhes rgyun bshags rgyas pa'am/ mi nus na gur nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du hūṃ las rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ se gol gtogs zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha= nas bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dang*/ de'i 'od las grub pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad dmar mo g.yas tho ba dang*/ g.yon sku stod rang mtshungs kyi phur bu thogs pa/ dpag tu med pa spros nas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sngags las spros pa'i rwa ba dang*/ sa gzhi dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra bha wa ban+dhu hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bī ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi mdun du hūṃ las byung ba'i 'brub khung rnams su gyur/ 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis bgegs rnam bsregs shing*/ lhag ma rnams lcags kyus bkug nas 'brub khung du bcug pa la/ phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/ phur bu rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra badz+ra kī la a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pho nya ba rnams mda'i drwa ba la thim pas/ chu la chu thim pas zegs ma phyir 'phros pa ltar/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i rwa ba g.yon skor du 'bar ba'i me lce'i 'phreng ba can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ/ hūṃ pad+ma pra ka ra hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra pra ka ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ bdag nyid skad cig gis mi snang bar gyur/

srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ dkar po las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzung ma dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka ba'-i btegs pa'i rta bab kyis mdzes pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phubs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma la zla ba'i steng du bum thod bzhi/ phyogs kyis 'dab ma dang*/ gzhal med khang gi sgo mtshams brgyad du yang*/ mi ro'i snying gar zla ba/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa dang bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā=

nas aṃ āḥyongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ka kha= nas hak+ṣa/ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus su rang gi sems nyid hūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis mgrin pa bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan shing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭ+waṃ ga /thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyi glang lpags dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi nyis phrugs su bsnams shing 'phyar ba/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rnge'u chung 'khrol bas chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/ 'di'i stod g.yogs nyis phrugs ni/ bla gos dang snam sbyar mtshon pa yin/ khro bo'i sku la chags bral gyi gos ngur smrig mi 'tsham pa'i dbang du byas par mngon/ phyag mtshan kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang*/ thod pa mi byed par mkhar bsil dang lhung bzed dngos byas na'ang legs te/ 'khor rnams la rigs 'gre la/ phyag mtshan la mtha' ma bkag pas so/ / thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma la hūṃ/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa yang skad cig gis grub par gyur/ aṃ hūṃ oṃ haṃ 'khor lo'i lte ba bzhi la'o/ /a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥlte bar ro/ /bh+ruṃ traṃ aṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ snying khar ro/ /ā ī ū e/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai o au/ aṃ aḥ mgrin par ro/ /a ā nas aṃ āḥ yang a ā/ nas aṃ aḥ spyi bor ro/ /shar gyi 'dab mar ma taṃ gi ser mo/ byang du ḍom+bi ni sngon mo/ nub tu ra dza gi dmar mo/ lho puk+ka si dud kha rnams g.yas gnyis na rnge'u chung dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na 'khar bsil dang lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar ba la kī dkar sham/ lho nub tu sa ha tsa ri dmar mo/ nub byang du bud+dhi tsa ri ljang khu/ byang shar du sha ba ri dkar mo rnams dang po gnyis 'khar bsil dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis rnge'u chung dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ shar sgor he ru ka'i 'od ma/ byang du rdo rje gtum mo/ nub tu rdo rje srin mo/ lho rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rnams rim pas thal dkar dang*/ ljang khu dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngo ba'i mdog can/ g.yas chos kyi 'khor lo dang rnge'u chung*/ g.yon lhung bzed 'khar bsil/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang bcas pa/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang mi lpags kyi chos gos gsol ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ / bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /thabs dang shes rab ngo bo nyid/ /snying rje che dang stong pa nyid/ /tha mi dad pa'i bdag nyid do/ /bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum/ /phyis mi len dang tsog pu pa/ /gtan gcig pa dang bla gab med/ /shing drung pa dang bas mthar gnas/ /dur khrod pa dang phyag dar khrod/ /'phying ba can dag gzhi ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis te/ /de rnams rnal 'byor ma rnam dag /mdo yi sde dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad/ /lung du bstan dang tshigs su bcad/ /ched du brjod de gleng gzhi dang*/ /rtogs pa brjod dang de ltar byung*/ /skyes pa'i rabs dang shin tu rgyas/ /rmad du byung dang gtan la phab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang*/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ngo bo nyid/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ hūṃ zhes bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsi gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ phyi nang gi phyogs bzhi'i lha rnams la phyogs kyi rim pas rtag pa don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung rnams dang*/ grwa'i lha mo rnams la rim pas/ sangs rgyas rin chen pad+ma don yod rdo rje rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥbī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ/ zhes sogs lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/

mkha' gsang gnas bzhi byin rlabs yid kyis dran par byas te/ rjes chags snyoms 'jug gi bde ba sgom par bya zhing*/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa/ oṃ khaṃ aṃ traṃ hūṃ/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la hūṃ las kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du blta ba/ de zhu zhing thim pas/ dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ āḥ.oṃ brtsegs pa/ de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu zhing 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /lū yi ḍi ki lā ba pa/ /in+d+ra bhu ti dril bu zhabs/ / rus sbal lang ka ling pa dang*/ /spyod 'chang dge ba'i mgon po dang*/ /ti li nā ro yid can dpal/ /bha dan+ta pa mar do dang*/ /bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lho tshad lo mchog grags chen pa/ / 'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /bkra shis rin chen kun dga' bzang*/ /grags rgyal bsod nams lhun grub dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang bla ma rje/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas mchod/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa gtso bor byung ba'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams gsal btab la bzlas pa bya'o/ / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

lha'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lha mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ ma taṃ kī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā+om+bi nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dza kī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ puk+ka sī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ba dā ki hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa hā tsa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bu dhi tsa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shā wā ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ he ru ka bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa si hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra bī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpa' mo'i sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ /thun bsdu ba 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis hūṃ yig la thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par 'dod na yang*/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i mtha' de nyid du bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang*/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ phaiṃ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gtso bo'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod kyang phul/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ i mi ba liṃ bhu dza tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ma kār+ya sā dha ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ rkang brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yod na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas bsngos/ dngos grub blang pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ba nas/

bkra shis brjod pa'i bar bde mchog spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag gi go don dang*/ 'khor los sgyur drug gi dkyil 'khor la 'don pa spo ba'i tshul sogs zhib mor shes par 'dod na/ slob dpon nyid kyi gzhung dang yig snying sogs las shes par bya'o/ /mngon brjod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'khor los sgyur drug yin yang*/ dgongs 'grel rgya gzhung gi zin so che ba dang dkyil 'khor grags che ba'i dbang du byas te 'di thog mar bkod pa yin no/ /rgyud rgyal mthar thug mngon brjod las byung ba/ /bcu bzhi'i lha tshogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo grub pa'i gtsug gi brgyan/ /lwa ba'i zhabs kyi bzhed ltar sgrub thabs byas/ /'dir 'bad rnam dkar gang mchis des/ /bdag nyid he ru kar gyur nas/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro rnams sgral bar shog/ces pa lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa/ bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs te drug pa'o// //༈ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi gtso/ /bla ma mchog zhabs la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /kun la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /'dir 'khor los bsgyur drug gi mngon rtogs sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams bya/ shrī he ru ka haṃ/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ ces sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyi phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi= sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na rigs lnga'i sdom pa yang bzung*/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs par bsam/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/

mgo bor gzugs phung bh+ruṃ las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar tshor ba aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che/ /mgrin par 'du shes hri las pad+ma gar dbang dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ long bur 'du byed ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsum ka'ang g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ bzhi ka yang phyag g.yas 'phyar ba'i stabs so/ /snying gar rnam shes hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod pa/ spyi gtsug tu de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo hi las he ru ka nag po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon/ de gnyis ni g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ rna bar dz+riṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/ snar traṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po g.yas rin po che/ lce rtsar a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dpral par khaṃ las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ snying gar haṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje phyag g.yon dkur brten pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams dang kha dog rim bzhin rnam snang sogs dang mtshungs pa/ de thams cad kyang ral pa'i cod pan can/ lte bar sa khams laṃ las ltung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying gar chu khams māṃ las gsod byed ma nag po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mgrin par me khams pāṃ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral par rlung khams tāṃ las gar dbang ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas 'og mas gri gug g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su nam mkha'i khams khaṃ las pad ma drwa ba can ma dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug

g.yon gsum thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lha mo lnga skra grol ba/ lha bcu bdun po thams cad spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga ldan/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ pra kir ti pa ri shud+dha sarba dharma pra kri ti pa ri shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa/ sogs lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sa gzhir rwa ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/ me ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri= nas larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can/ de'i thugs ka nas hūṃ bcu spros te/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcur 'khod pa khro bo bcur gyur pa dang*/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag /nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lho ru rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po chen po nag po nag ser ljang ba/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/

mig g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi cang te'u dang*/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og nag po nag ser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu/ khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong ba bcu gnon pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ cher khros shing*/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sum+bha=

zhes sogs kyi bka' bsgos pas/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs rnams bkug spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha= sogs de rnams tho bas brdung*/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra= sogs bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du bcom ste/ de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ kha badz+ra dh+rika badz+ra hūṃ ka ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na larka badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇi ṣa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhi ṣa na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo nyid kyi rtsa sngags zhal bzhi pa gang 'grub bzla/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsdus pa'i tshul bkod pa yin gyi rgyas 'bring sogs sgom par 'dod na/ khro bo rnam rol du rgyas par bshad zin pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ / oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rnam pas nam mkhar gnas/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gzhi dkyil gyi dbus su rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor/ lho stod du rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor/ lho smad du snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor/ byang stod du mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor/ byang smad du don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang rta babs dang bral ba/ lhag ma gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang ka ba brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng thog mdzes par phub cing*/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor de rnams kyis dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi lte bar rim pas/ seng khri pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang*/ seng khri pad+ma zla ba tshangs pa dang*/ rta'i khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu nyi ma dang*/ rma bya'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug chen po dang*/ glang po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang chen dang*/ mkha' lding gi khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu zla ba ste/ gdan drug char gyi steng du a ā= nas/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ka kha= nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha rnams phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug /de rnams kyi dbus su rim pas/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ hriṃ khaṃ baṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/

rdo rje dkar po dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che dang*/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing thim pa las/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ yab yum rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang dbus ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ lho nub tu lā ma ljang khu/ nub byang du khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar mo/ byang shar du gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa thogs pa/ shar du khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum mo/ byang du ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen po ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo rdo rje thod khrag bsnams pa/ dkyil 'khor shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rtags pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po/ 'khor lo dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ 'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ shar du su ra ri bi dang*/ brtan pa'i blo can ma/ byang du 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub tu rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ga'i dbang phyug ma/ lhor rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang de'i yu ba byas pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ser mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor lho ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje nyi ma rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser po chen po che dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa shar du aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ byang du ral pa can dang*/ 'jig byed chen po nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste dpa' bo rnams so sor rin po che dang*/ de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum rnams ljang khu rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor lho nub ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma gar dbang dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin ma'i 'khyud pa/ shar du rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wi/ byang du rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub tu 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ lhor mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo pad+ma dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dkyil 'khor nub byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog nag po/ khro bo'i rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo khro bo'i rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog nag po khro bo'i rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ser mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal rta mchog sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang ser/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ byang du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub tu rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ lhor rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams sngo skya/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das drug ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ yum drug ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas phyag mtshan rnams 'phyar ba'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams g.yas brkyang bas bzhengs shing*/ dpa' bo rnams g.yon brkyang gi 'khyud pa/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ g.yas lcags sgrogs 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba g.yas me long 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas pas pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dri chab kyi dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba g.yas ro drug gi gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ de ltar sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i tshul can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na thod pa dang gru mo g.yon par kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mi ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi gnas pa/ yab thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas yum dang sbyor ba/ lha mo thams cad skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor drug char gyi pad+ma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ ka pā la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba re re'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'= nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab/ spro na gong du bshad pa'i phung khams kyi lha bcu bdun po yang bskyed/ bsdu na gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ / zhes sogs dag pa dran par bya/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rim pas hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ hriṃ hūṃ khaṃ/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba gdab pa'am/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse bas bdag la dbang bskur rtsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa'i/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rigs lnga la rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nyid la ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams sdom pa'i sgrub thabs gzhan dang mtshungs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dza lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*/ /dge mgon ti li nā ro ma ṇi ka /chos dbang bze pa yab sras rnam pa gsum/ /shaka rdor sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog pa/ /grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston byang rtse dang*/ /grags rgyal chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gyur pa/ /grags pa ye shes kun dga' grol mchog dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rtsa ba'i bla ma chod/ / ces 'don pa spo/ bstod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad dang de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lus dang tshor ba dang*/ zhes pa nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /phung po drug rnam par dag pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa drug khams drug rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje btsun mo drug go / dkyil 'khor drug ni sa drug ste/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i gnas ni sa lhag ma bzhi'o/ / bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī bu dha ḍā kā a la la la bh+ruṃ āḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī rat+na ḍā ka traṃ aḥ oṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ki hriḥ.āḥ oṃ ḍā ki dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka aḥphaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ri ḍā ka aḥhūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī bi shwa ḍā ka hoḥ khaṃ aḥhūṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nas oṃ yaṃ hūṃ phaṭa

gyi bar/ rang ming gi dang po'i yi ge nyid sngags kyi ngo bor gsungs so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur ba/ sogs byas nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul gzhan rnams dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gsum pa ltar bya ba las/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi rjes su/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs nges par brjod pa nyid yin no/ /shin tu zab cing gsang ba ste/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud rgyal las/ /kun gyi rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor mchog/dkyil 'khor gtso bor bsngags pa ste/ /'di yi sgrubs thabs byas pa yin/ /zhes pa 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi sgrub thabs te bdun pa'o// //༈ na ma shrī he ru ka mañju nā thā ya/ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa kun/ /dran pa tsam gyis zhi mdzad cing*/ /ye shes snang ba nyer stsol ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs he ru ka la 'dud/ /gang 'di'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /rab zab rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ rab tu gsal bar bshad par bya/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngag gi dbang phyug he ru ka lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams bya/

shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro= sogs kyis phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'i dra ba me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra= nas/ a nā lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gi bar sngags la tshan drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i lte bar rang nyid rdo rje khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing nag na gser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin zhing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bka' bsgos/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs rnams bkug oṃ gha gha= sogs/ de rnams tho bas brdungs/ oṃ muṅga ra= sogs/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa'am zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ci nus re bzla/ 'di ni shin tu bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ bsdus pa ni 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi skabs su bshad zin la/ rgyas 'bring ni khro bo rnam rol las shes par bya'o/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i tshe thun mong gi srung 'khor drug po tsam gyis chog go

/oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a ni hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ni hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bar do'i rnam shes maṃ dmar ser hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' rten pa/ de'i snang ba las chad pa'i yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gsum phyag gsum drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de zhu ba las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor te rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang drwa phyed dang shar bu dang mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser dbus sngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol tu snam bu dmar po'i khor yug la/ rdo rje gshin rje ro langs kyi tshogs rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa 'jigs su rung ba gar byed pa/ de'i phyir rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/me dang*/ chu dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol du srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/

/rtsig pa'i phyi 'og mtha' dang*/ stegs bu dang*/ sgo'i ya phubs kyi ka gdung la 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa/ nang gi lha snam gyi dbus su gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad ma dmar pos mtshan pa'i mu khyud dang rwa ba ka ba gdung thog phubs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ de'i nang thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa'i mu khyud dang rwa ba ka ba gdung thob phubs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ pad 'dab kyis khebs pa'i 'khor lo'i 'og nas mu khyud cung zad mngon pa'o/ /pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a ā nas aṃ ā/ ka kha nas ha k+ṣa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar skya/ de'i dbus su hūṃ dang baṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūṃ dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis cang te'u dang tshangs mgo g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ rang dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ lha'i gnas rnams su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa'i lha mo grangs med pa dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ bh+ruṃ aṃ hriḥhoḥhūṃ ha phung po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa drug gi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ a khaṃ haṃ/ skye mched drug

dpa' bo drug gi ngo bor gyur/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ khaṃ/ khams lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor gyur zhes yab yum ga nyis ka la bsam/ 'di shin tu bsdus pa ste yig 'bru de rnams brjod pas der gyur par mos pa yin la/ 'bring po ni sa bon lus la bkod pa yin/ rgyas pa ni lha bkod pa'o/ / yab yum gyi thugs kar zla ba la nam mkhar gnas pa'i bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge gsum babs/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo dang*/ gsang bar yang hoḥdamar pos mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ yi ge rnams yum gyi pad+mar babs pas yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi gong bur gyur/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams langs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang bcas thal mo sbyar zhing*/ rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang cang te'u'i sgras bskul ba/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi lugs/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi gsang*/ /e ma ho bde ba las byung ba/ /e ma ho kun tu bzang po'i don/ /e ma ho bde bas yang dag 'dus/ /e ma ho bde chen dag pa ste/ /e ma ho bde ba bde ba'i mchog/ e ma ho gsang sngags mnyam sbyor ba/ /e ma ho thugs kyi spyod pa ste/ /e ma ho mnyam nyid phyag rgya ldan/ /e ma ho sgrub pa rmad du byung*/ /e ma ho pha rol phyin pa'i sa/ /e ma ho rig pa rjes 'jug pa/ /e ma ho sna tshogs las chen po/ /e ma ho kha sbyor gsum dag pa/ /e ma ho rdo rje mnyam sbyor ba/ /e ma ho pad+ma rnal 'byor pa/ /e ma ho dbang gnyis snyoms 'jug pa/ /e ma ho rmad byung mnyam pa nyid/ /e ma ho dag pa'i gar chen te/ /e ma ho shin tu dri med glu/ /e ma ho glu yi legs sbyor ba/ /e ma ho pheg rdob mun sel ba/ /e ma ho me tog tshogs dga' ba/ /e ma ho bdug pa'i bum pa bzang*/ /e ma ho sgron ma gti mug sel/ /e ma ho dri mchog bsil ba ste/

/e ma ho rnal 'byor mnyam sbyor ba/ / e ma ho sgyu 'phrul mkha' lta bu/ /e ma ho gdod nas sangs rgyas gdod nas rdo rje ste/ /e ma ho gdod nas rin chen bde ba rab stsol ba/ /e ma ho pad+ma gdod nas bris pa ste/ /e ma ho sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul pa yin/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad sangs rgyas/ /e ma ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i sras/ /e ma ngo mtshar sems can rnams/ /e ma ngo mtshar lha mo'o/ / zhes so/ /glus bskul 'di ni/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa ste/ 'di'i cho ga sogs la nges par dgos pas tshig blo la yod nges bya/ dus rgyun gyis nyams len la de tsam mi lcogs na/ mngon spyod le'u dgu par 'byung ba'i glus bskul 'di nyid bya ste mngon spyod las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi spyi 'gro yang yin no/ /de yang*/ hoḥsrid pa gsum gyi de rnyed gtso/ a la la la ho/ rgyal ba bde chen dgyes pa'i tshogs/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje rol/ /a la la la ho/ phyogs bcur bde gshegs snying po spros/ /kun gyi snying po bdag por mdzod/ /srid pa gsum gyi snying po ni/ /bde ba chen po rtogs par mdzod/ /a la la la ho/ /bdag po dgyes pa grol bar mdzod/ /bde chen a la la la ho/ zhes pa'o/ / de ltar rab tu bskul nas/ bskul ba po rnams dzaḥdzaḥ zhes thig le la thim/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ maṃ las rdo rje dmar ser maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams dang gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad slar 'dus te maṃ yig la thim/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal he ru ka zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal gur gum gzhon nu ltar dmar ser/ g.yas zhal sngo ba dang ser ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu dang dmar po/

de rnams khros shing 'jigs pa'i nyams can/ steng zhal dkar po zhi ba'o/ /thams cad ban+dha ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ sangs rgyas lnga'i gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'i thod skam gyis dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis tshangs pa'i pags pa stod g.yogs su 'phyar ba/ gsum pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang ut+pal/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis kyis cang te'u dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ drug pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar po mnan pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing*/ ral ba'i cod pan la nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ thal ba dang mi mgo'i do shal gyis sku la spras pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gar dgus rol pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis cang te'u dang bdud kyi mgo bo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra grol zhing thod skam gyi do shal can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ / 'di la khyad par gzhan ni/ khro zhal rnams kyi dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa dang*/ 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pas stod g.yogs byed pa'ang yod la/ glang lpags dang stag lpags spyi dang mtshungs par byed pa'ang yod cing*/ zhabs bzhi rgyab ma gnyis gar gyi tshul du 'dod pa'ang snang ngo*/ /de bzhin du yum yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs ltar/ dkar mo'ang sngon mor 'dod pa dang*/ yab dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis par yang 'dod cing*/

rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar por 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /de dag kyang rgyud tshig 'don tshul dang man ngag gi khyad par so so las byung ba yin pa'i phyir thams cad kyang mi 'gal lo/ /rgyud las yum byin pa gnyis 'khyud du bshad pa la/ mnyam 'khyud dang gang rung gis ci bder 'khyud pa gang byas kyang chog la/ mngon brjod 'grel pa las/ rtsig pa la yi dwags phreng ba dang*/ stegs bu la lha mo'i 'khor du bshad na'ang mi legs so/ / thugs 'khor gyi shar phyogs pū li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dag rab gtum ma/ dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang phyogs dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum mig ma/ ser sngo ljang ba'i= nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ dmar sngo ljang = lho phyogs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ ljang ser sngo= shar lho gau dā wa rir su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ dmar ser ljang ba'i= lho nub rasma shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dkar ser ljang = nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ sngo skya ser ljang = byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ ljang ser sngo= de ltar thugs 'khor ba rnams phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū par ang ku ri dang e ra wa ti/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ byang phyogs o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ ljang ser sngo ba= nub phyogs tri sha ku nir dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje oṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ dmar ser ljang ba/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wī/ ljang ser sngo ba lho nub lam+ba kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ser sngo ljang ba nub byang kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dud ser ljang ba/

byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma/ sngo skya ser ljang ba/ de ltar gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar sgo pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba/ byang sgo gri ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ ser sngo ljang ba/ nub sgo sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ dmar ser ljang ba/ lho sgor su war+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo go cha ma/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ shar lho'i grwa na ga ra dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ sngo skya ser ljang ba/ lho nub kyi grwa sin+dhur/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ ser ljang ba/ nub byang gi grwa ma rur/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ dkar sngo ljang ba/ byang shar gyi grwa ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ dkar nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ de ltar sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang*/ de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas kyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang cangate'u/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod khrag dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa'o/ /yab rnams stag lpags kyi shams thabs can g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yum rnams gcer bu g.yon brkyang gi stabs can/ thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi rigs las byung ba'o/ /bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i thugs dam la gtso bor 'khor thams cad khro nyams che zhing cung zad sbom pa'i sku can du bris 'dug go /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba wī ra yo gi ni kā ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ
oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ bar 'dir lus dkyil sgom par 'dod na/ lte bar gtso bo yab yum dang*/ spyi bo la sogs par 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams bkod pa'i lha lnga bcu pa bsgom par bya'o/ /ci ste ma mo bcu gnyis 'god par 'dod na yang*/ mngon brjod le'u dgu par gsungs pa ltar phyag bcu gnyis la 'god dgos shing*/ de ltar na thod pa bzhi zhal bzhi la'o/ / 'on kyang de dag dkyil 'khor 'di'i lha ma yin pa'i phyir 'god mi dgos so/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ rgyu rdo rje'i 'dzin pa'i skabs bzhin no/ spyod pa bzhi byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ rang gi snying gar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar ser gyi lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ gyis mtshan pa'o/ /yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phaiṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā las dbang bskur/ sku lus gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ sngon po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ dkar po rnams la rnam snang ljang khu rnams dang dud kha la don grub/ dmar po rnams la snang mtha'/ ser po rnams la rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan/ de nas go cha bgo bar bya ste/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po= nas / rta mchog gi ngo bo/ dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lte bar oṃ baṃ= nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ / de nas 'dir yang spro na mchod bstod bya zhing*/

khyad par bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ sdom 'byung gi gtor mchog rnams su bshad pa ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlobs te/ oṃ sa ma ya shud+dha sarba dharma sa ma ya shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ/ ṭha ṭha s+t+waṃ a khaṃ hūṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ngo*/ / bla ma la 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jam dpal ngag dbang grags pa blo gros bzang*/ /bde chen rdo rje lha yi 'byung gnas dang*/ /mi 'jigs 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /bkas gnang bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / zhes so/ /bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa sogs bsgom par bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgyu mar shes par byas te/ de la mnyam par bzhag go /byang chub phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ byang phyogs dang po brgyad dang*/ tha lhag bzhi bor ba ste/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum ma/ nas yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ / zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang*/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid lha/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga bdag nyid/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal med khang bzang ste/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad dag pa/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du sprul/ /sdang dang sred pa rab 'joms pas/ /lha mo rnams dang yi dwags 'phreng*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dud gzhom ste/ /ye shes me 'od rnam par spro/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dag pas/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya/ /dam pa'i don du dpa' bo'i gzugs/ /ye shes kyis ni 'jam dpal nyid/ /skyon drug dag pas rigs drug nyid/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag pa yis/ /zhal dang phyag ni rnam dag pa/ /ma rig 'du byed zhabs kyis mnan/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam mo/ /de nas 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang*/ ngag bzlas yid bzlas rnams rim gyis bya ste/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ shrī mañju badz+ra dh+ri ka oṃ hūṃ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra wa ra hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ 'phreng ba'i sngags ni bde mchog spyi dang mthun pa yin na'ang*/ de gtso bor bzla bar ma gsungs so/ /'khor gyis sngags ni/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsan+ṭe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sogs sbyar te bzla'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi gtor bsngo byas te thun bsdu ba'am/ min yang rung ste/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyang bdag nyid la thim/ de yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i bar du bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal bar bsdus te stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag go /slar yang rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ spyod pa bzhi dang go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab ste thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma byin rlabs 'khrul spong gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ phaiṃ zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a ral+li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ zhes lan gsum gyis spyir phul/ yab yum gyi snying po'i hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi sngon du i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ ku ru ku ru zhes bcug pa lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ka ra ka ra nas/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum la phul/ hūṃ bcu gcig gi mthar a kā ro ba tags pas srung ba'i 'khor lo pa la phul/ yang ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta' ི bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/

rkang brgyad gnyis sam gong gi zhu ba glus bskul gyis bstod/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi nas sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis phyi rol 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams nas kun 'grub shog gis bstod cing gsol ba btab/ oṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ / zhes sogs dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang*/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ / zhes sogs smon lam btab/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ yig brgya bzod gsol gtor mgron gshegs gsol rnams byas la/ yo ga shud+dha 'i sngags kyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ slar yang bdag srung dang*/ smon lam bkra shis gang 'os re bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs ches mang yang*/ /rgyud sde kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa dang*/ /las tshogs tsam min mchog sgrub gtsor ston dang*/ /dag bya dag byed rab rgyas dkyil 'khor dang*/ /rgyud las shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /sgrub thabs 'di nyid kho na ches mchog ste/ /gsang ldan la sogs rgyu sde 'og mar mtshungs/ /gur las gsungs sogs las tshogs lha tsam yin/ / mtshan brjod sgrub thabs bla med lugs byas pa/ /phal cher dag bya dag byed shin tu bsdus/ /'dug pa'i 'jam rdor man ngag gtso che ste/ /rgyud las ha cang gsal ba gsung pa'ang med/ /ces ched du brjod pa'o/ /de ltar sgrub thabs rab bshad pas/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i sa thob cing*/ khyad par lam 'dir 'jug pa rnams/ /tshe 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs te brgyad pa'o// //༈ rab 'bar ye shes me lce yis/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rab gsal dkyil 'khor ri mo ni/ /ci yang 'char 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/

skyabs sems rdor sems sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ skabs 'dir spro na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ gang gi drin gyis= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma= sogs kyi phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra bī nī hūṃ/ nas oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mahā su khaṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi= sogs lan gsum/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da nam mkhar gnas/ tshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum+bha lan gnyis brjod/ sngags las spros pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri= sogs sngags tshan drug brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje de'i steng du bh+ruṃ dkar po las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyis snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung g-i 'khor lo dmar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar paṃ las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus su phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a ā= nas/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha= nas ha k+ṣa/ ḍa ḍha/ da dha ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te hūṃ la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'khor lo bde mchog che/ drag po chen po he ru ka /sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag /mi bzad sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i sku/

zhal dang phyag dang zhabs rnams ni/ /thams cad 'bum gyi grangs su bya/ /zhal ni ji snyed thams cad kyang*/ /mdun nag g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ /g.yas pa ser po shes par bya/ /dang po rdo rje dril bus khyud/ /de 'og lha mo'i nu ma mtshir/ /de 'og thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ bsnams/ /gnyis kyis glang lpags 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dgra sta dang*/ /mdung rtse gsum pa ngo bo nyid/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang*/ mda' dang gzhu yang de bzhin te/ /thod dbyug dang ni mdung thung dang*/ /sdig mdzub dang ni gtum shing dang*/ /'khor lo ral gri rin chen dang*/ /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /rdo rje mtshon pa'i dbyug tho dang*/ /ga da mdung ring mdung kha leb/ /dza ma be con chu gri dang*/ /dung dang rwa dung pa ṭa ha/ /pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga che/ /rdza rnga rnga zlum gru gsum 'khyog /sa chu me dang rlung dkyil 'khor/ /sgra can keṃ rus 'jigs byed che/ /lus lag rkang pa pags pa dang*/ /lcags sgrogs g.yas pa'i lhag na ste/ /g.yon pa'i lhag ma'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar phyag ni brgya phrag rnams/ /re re dang mtshungs stong phrag re'o/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /dus mtshan tshangs ma dbang mo dang*/ /dpal mo gaṃ ga dbyangs can ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang drug ldan ma/ /re ba tī dang dga' byed ma/ /tsa mun ṭi dang klu mo dang*/ /gnod sbyin mo dang zla ba mo/ /nyi ma mo dang dga' ma dang*/ /tshogs bdag mo yi snying gar mnan/ /g.yon rnams 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag khyab 'jug kun 'gyed gzhon nu dang*/ /nag chen dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ /gshin rje chu lha lus ngan dang*/ /zla ba nyi ma lus med dang*/ /tshogs bdag la sogs kha bub tu/ /bsgyel ba'i steng du rnam par gnon/ /lhag ma'i zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad mnan te bzhugs/ /zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ drag po chen po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pas 'jigs su rung ba/
