bzhad pa mi sdug pa rab tu 'jigs pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/ dam pa/ smin ma rnam par g.yo ba/ bsnyems pa/ zhi ba/ g.yo ba/ mi g.yo ba/ zhal rnam par gdangs pa/ rnam par rol ba/ ljags rnam par bskyod pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i nyams ltar bar mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bo'i gtsug tu rgyan byas pa/ zhal thams cad rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs rnams g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang shing*/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /

bla ma'i man ngag gis 'di la zhal gdong gi rnam pa la sogs pa mi 'dra ba gzhan yod pa ni yi ge gzhan du gsal lo/ / 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ba glang gi gdong pa can/ byang du lā ma ljang khu rta'i gdong pa can/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can/ thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/ rab tu gtum mo= nas byang shar ku lu ta rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ / zhes pa'i bar spyir dang 'dra/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po rnams rnam par gnon pa/ yab rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ zhal phyag sna tshogs pa/ yum rnams rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ma he'i gdong ma can/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba bong bu'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba rnga mong gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po rnams ni/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa/ dbu dang phyag dang zhabs mtha' yas pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub stsol ba'o/ / bdag nyid kyi lus la rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/

yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po= nas phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsan+ṭi kā'i ngo bo gnyis ka'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka abhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ka ha na til+li na ro tsa tra pa/ /bsod nams 'byung gnas rin chen 'byung gnas sbas/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas da sha ba la dang*/ / 'dren pa'i dpal dang shrī gup+ta dang*/ /blo gros 'byung gnas dkar min sprin gyi zhabs/ /dz+nyā na mi tra bde chen rdo rje dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ / rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa phul la/ yab yum gyis rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ nag po pa ltar dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gal te drag po'i las la mos na/ 'khor thams cad kha dog mthing khar bsgom zhing*/ gtso bo'i zhal yang rtsa zhal khro bo'i zhal la/ zhal lhag ma rnams gdong brnyan du bsgyur te/ khwa dang chu skyar bzhad dang ni/ ce spyang skye gnyis sngags chen po/ khrung khrung ri rkeg ka dam pa/ /zhes pa srog chags brgyad dang*/ bong bu dang*/ mi dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ khyi dang*/ rnga mong dang*/

rta la sogs pa'i phyugs sna tshogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bsgyur zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i phyag rgya phrag gcig dang*/ stong la sogs ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bzlas ba'i dmigs pa ni spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ bzlas bya ni/ oṃ shrī he he ru ru kaṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru nas dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha raṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra bī ra hi/ tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ gi ha na ha na= nas yo gi sho ri phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar yum gyi sngags so/ /yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyang bzla bar bya'o/ /cher khros pas/ ha ha hi hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces kyang bzlas so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod par bsams/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha lan gnyis su bzla/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang sum bha tshar gcig bzlas pas bka' bsgos/ de rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs rnams bkug /bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol du 'brub khung du bcug pa la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i phur bu rnams kyis btab/ oṃ gha gha= sogs lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra/ sogs/ tho bas brdung bas bgegs rnams ming yang med par byas par bsams/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin par bsgyur te/ oṃ gha gha= sogs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste/ rang gi sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ rang nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ phaṭa ces brjod/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las lha skur gyur/ swāhā oṃ zhes brjod/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab nas thun mtshams kyis bya ba la 'jug go

/'di'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la/ kha zas thams cad ling gar byas te bsgral nas bza'o/ / gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byung gi mngon rtogs su shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon gang ba'i rdo rje las thob pa'o/ /bdud dpung phye mar brlag byed cing*/ /grub pa brgyad sogs mngag gzhug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po sogs/ /tshul 'di sgom pa'i bran du 'gyur/ /mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa'i sgrub thabs te dgu pa'o// //༈ na mo garba ba mu kha he ru kā ya/ rdo rje'i mthon ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdud dpung lan brgyar bcom byas nas/ /sgrub la bde chen dngos grub stsol/ /rab 'jigs he ru ka la 'dud/ /'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi khyad par rab 'byams zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ sdom pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar rdo rje khrag 'thung bong bu'i zhal can bsgom par bya'o/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*/ /byang chub mchog tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/

/byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ / tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swabhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ mda'i drwa ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+ruṃ las gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/

de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bskor gyi a ā zhes pa nas/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa'i bar/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi ka kha nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ dkar po'o/ /nam mkha'i nā da yang hūṃ yig de nyid la thim/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yong su gyur pa las/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ka bong bu'i gdong pa can/ khrag chen gyis byugs shing shin tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba dang g.yon zhal dmar ba dag ni lha zhal khro chags kyi nyams can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mi lpags rlon pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pa na rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pa na thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga lhan cig par 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / 'dir zhal gsum phyag drug sdom 'byung dang 'dra rung mdzad pa ni slob dpon skal ldan bzang po'i man ngag yin yang*/ phyag gnyis par bsgom na'ang legs so/ / 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ de bzhi dang rdo rje phag mo yang bong bu'i zhal can/ zhal gyi grwa nas ma hā ru dhi ra'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi phyi rol dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can/ lho nub gshin rje pho nya mas g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba ri dwags kriṇ+ṣa'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba stag gi gdong pa can/

byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba dom gyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la byang phyogs dza lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar kaṃ ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ shar lho go da wa rir lha'i dgra/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med/ nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje 'od/ byang shar ma la war rdo rje'i sku ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon mo bya khyung gi gdong can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par aṃ gu ri/ byang phyogs o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po/ lho nub lam+pa ka ra rdo rje bzang po/ nub byang kañcir 'jigs byed chen po/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rma bya'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che/ byang phyogs gri ha de war rin chen rdo rje/ nub phyogs so raṣ+tar rta mgrin/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka lho nub sin dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa can/

phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum ma dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ rang snang gi shes rab ma dang bcas pa'ang thabs rkyang pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs kar rang 'dra ba'am phyag gnyis pa'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar hūṃ dang baṃ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ yab rnams kyi thugs kar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma la zla ba'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol la/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/

zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa rnams la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod phul/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma'i= skal ldan bzang po'i= skye dgu'i 'tsho ba bzang po'i= mahā bo dhi'i= bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer gyi= gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta'i= bsod nams lhun grub kyi= rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi= rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha thams cad kyi snying pos dkyil 'khor la phul/ a nu ra gas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bde stong du 'char bar byas te mnyam par bzhag /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir bsgom/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gsal btab nas/ bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags 'phreng rgyas par ni/ dpa' mo nyer bzhi bor nas gzhan lū yi pa dang mtshungs la/ bzlas pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bdun pa nyid la nan tan du 'bad par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i gzhi ni/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ dmar skya las/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gro ba dang bstun nas byed pa man ngag yin no/ /mthar bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ sa bcu dag gi rim pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /phyi dang nang gi chos rnams kun/ byang chub phyogs kyis rnam par dag /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs rtag /lha yi snying po'i sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ / yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /gdub 'khor gyis ni rna ba brgyan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin par mgur chus mdzes pa nyid/

/sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyi/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po ni/ /phyag rgya las ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams ni rnam par dag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' ba ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa yin/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ / zhes dag pa dran par byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du langs te/ go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sdom 'byung bcu gsum ma'i sgrubs thabs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo gsum dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la gdong brnyan du mdzad pa 'di ni/ bshad rgyud a bhi dha na las bshad pa'i lugs yin la/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gzhan las ni bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams bong zhal du sgyur ba tsam zhig gsungs so/ /gang zhig sgom par byed pa la/ /phun tshogs bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /'byung 'gyur de yi pha mtha' ni/ /bye ba'i gdong gis brjod nus sam/ /'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs te bcu pa'o// //༈ na mo badz+ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥ rmad byung mchog tu ngo mtshar ba'i/

/rdo rje btsun mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnyed pa 'di yang skal bzang ste/ /lha mos rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ /sgrub thabs kyi dmigs pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ gang gi drin gyis= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma= sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ shū n+ya ta sa stongs par sbyangs/ hūṃ sum+bha= lan gnyis/ oṃ gha gha= sogs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra= sogs/ oṃ mi dhi= nas/ larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gi bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ rnams las/ chos 'byung 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal med khang*/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad dang sgo mtshams rnams su nyi ma'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de'i bar du baṃ las rdo rje baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus/ gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje phag mo ban+dhu dang sin+dha ra'i mdog can nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa ltar na/ dmar ljang sngo ba'i zhal lam/ yang na zhal gsum ka yang dmar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas thabs he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lhan cig 'dzin pa/

thabs he ru ka ni dkar po dang dmar po dang mthing ka gdam nga'o/ /yang na rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po dang ljang khu/ g.yon zhal sngon po dang ser po/ steng gi zhal phag gdong dmar po phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang lpags/ g.yas lhag mas ḍā ma ru/ dgra sta/ gri gugartse gsum/ g.yon lhag mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin par byas kyang rung ngo*/ /gang ltar yang*/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/dbu skra phyed bcings shing*/ phyed grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rin po che dang me tog la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs drag mo'i tshul can bde ba rgyas ma'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du rdo rje gsang ba mchog ma/ byang du rdo rje dam tshig mchog ma/ nub tu rdo rje gzi brjid mchog ma/ lhor rdo rje rin chen mchog ma/ mer rdo rje ye shes mchog ma/ bden bral du rdo rje rig mchog ma/ rlung du rdo rje grub mchog ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje thal ba mchog ma thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal gsum ka'ang dmar zhing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud/ bar pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams gtso mo nyid dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje 'bar mchog ma/ byang sgor rdo rje bdud rtsi mchog ma/ nub sgor rdo rje khro bo mchog ma/ lho sgor rdo rje mche ba mchog ma rnams 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams dang 'dra ba las/ rdo rje gsor zhing zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub brkyang ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing cher khros pa'o/ /grwa bzhir lha mo mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ dkar ser dmar ljang*/

las kyi pho nya mo'i tshul du gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ba/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po sogs go chas rgyas btab/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ slar yang dbang gi lha rnams phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor lo rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas spro bsdus bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bā rā hi a baṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra gu h+ya ud ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sa mā ya ud ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra te dzod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rat+nod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dz+nyā nod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bi d+ya ud ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sid+dhot+ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra bhasmod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dz+ra lod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra a mṛ tod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dhod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra daṃṣ+tod ta me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ thun bsdu ba'i sngon du ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa rnams byas la/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi 'od zer gyis/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying khar bsdu/ go chas rgyas btab la/ dag pa gsum dran bzhin pas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go

/gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byung bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /gsang ba byin dang mchog gyur pa/ /grags pa ye shes grol mchog zhabs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhal las 'ongs/ rgyud sde'i dngos bstan zab mo'i gnad/ /'jigs bral nyid kyi khyad par chos/ /srog 'dzin gdams pa'i smin byed kyi/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni 'di kho na/ /deng dus de yi srog 'dzin du/ /grags shing rlom pa rnams kyis ni/ /gang 'di'i ming yang mi shes te/ kho bos bsod nams skal bas thob/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ bi rū pa/ go len nā thā/ shā ri bu tra/ grub chen kun blo/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ blo gros dpal 'byor/ zal mo brag pa zhes dbang rgyud ded kyang cho ga 'di la sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gi lung yang yod do/ /zhes pa mngon brjod le'u sum cu rtsa drug pa las byung ba/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gzigs shing*/ shin tu gsang bar gyur pa 'di ni/ bsod nams mchog gyur pa'i sgrub thabs tshig rgyal rgyas pa las/ snying po mtha' dag bsdus pa ste/ mchog gi rdo rje phag mo'i sgrubs thabs te bcu gcig pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā kā ya/ shes rab gsang ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen dngos/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa/ /bla ma mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab mo sbas pa gsang ba'i don/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam 'bri byed pa/ /'di ni 'gro ba'i don phyir te/ /de phyir 'phags rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /da ni bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor he ru ka drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob pas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ/ de las khro bo'i rdo rje nag por gyur pa'i lte ba la yang hūṃ gis mtshan pa/

de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid he ru kar gyur pa'i thugs kar/ zla ba dang rdo rje dkar po la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rje btsun mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen= sogs dang*/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs sho lo ka gnyis/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ / de nas/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi lnga dang rjes chags kyis mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang khu rngul gyi mchod pa ni mchod pa chen po ste/ de gnyis yid kyis dran tsam bya/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyi mthar/ brgal dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gis bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes bdag nyid phul/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun par bya/ de bzhin du tshad med bzhi yang spyi dang mthun/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar dbang*/ 'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sa'i khams ltung byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod byed ma/ me'i khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams pad ma gar dbang*/ nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can sgyu ma chen mo'o/ /mig gnyis gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba gnyis zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ lce 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/

oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las sgo mtshams ma brgyad dmar mo tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ oṃ sum+bha nas bid+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ lha mi lha min dang bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad bkug phyogs mtshams kyi sa gzhir phur bu btab ste tshar bcad/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ rdo rje me lce 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ sngags rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ / srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab/ de'i nang du chos 'byung shes rab kyi gsang ba/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/

sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa mu khyud la rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad bcas shing pad 'dab kyi khor yug srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod brten/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /

'dir bha ba bha dra'i 'grel pa las/ zhi khro dkyil 'khor tha dad du dgongs pas rgyu rdor 'dzin zhal phyag can logs pa med/ zla ba rdo rje nyid rgyu rdor sems kyi ngo bor 'dod la/ ka la kalpa'i sgrub thabs na rgyu rdo rje sems dpa' byed de rdo rje zhu ba'i thig le las rdor sems dkar sngo ser dmar ba'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi rdo rje/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga thod pa/ dril bu 'dzin/ gdan thod pa'i nang gi steng du phyed krung gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po 'od dmar po can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po'i spyod pa dang sprul pas sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad nas zhu ba dang glus bskul ba'i mdzad pa nag po pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /tshul 'di yang ches legs par mthong mod/ sngar srol bzhin dkyus su 'grel pa ltar bshad na/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang sems zla ba'i rnam pa can/ oṃ tsit+ta pra te bet+taṃ ka ro mi/ de la a ā= nas aṃ aḥs mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs te/ thim pa las zla ba gnyis par gyur/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ de la ka kha nas ha k+ṣas mtshan pa/ zla ba kha sbyor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ sangs rgyas rnams zhugs shing thim pa las/ rdo rje de nyid nyi ma stong gi 'od zer ltar 'bar ba'i thig le'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra at+ma ko3 haṃ/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs ma lus pa 'dus te/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes bskul bas/ de rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ka 'jigs pa yang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ drag po chen po zhal bzhi phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/

spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin mtshams nas hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags spro ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i gshor thod dang*/ thod khrag 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /sa 'og bskyod cing lha ma yin 'joms pa'i gar gyi stabs can/ zhabs gnyis g.yon bskums g.yas brkyang bas bdud bzhi chung ma dang bcas pa mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ ba spu'i khung bu nas sprul pa 'gyed pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sku mi 'gyur ba/ gsung ma skyes pa/ thugs nam mkha' rdo rje'i bdag nyid do/ /yum sgyu ma chen mo wa ra hi/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta thā a haṃ/ 'dir gar gyi stabs shes pa spyir gar gyi rol ba mdzad pa'i don yin gyi skyil krung phyed pas gar stabs kho na la go bar mi bya'o/ /yang 'di la gshor dang thod pa 'dzin pa gnyis bor ba'i phyag bzhi pa yang rung ngo/ /de bzhin du zhabs 'og tu 'jigs dus mnan par byed pa dang dkyil 'khor la bde chen 'khor lo le tshe dgu par byed pa dang*/ de ltar gyi tshe sgo ma dang mtshams ma go brje ba dang*/ sngon 'gro cung zad bsdus pa byed pa yang lugs gcig go

/de nas 'di ltar/ nga ni 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi mchog / sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs pa/ /nga nyid chos kyi sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po yin/ oṃ sum bha= sogs/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ ka la kalpas skabs 'dir go cha dang gnas gsum byin rlabs byed do/ / bde chen 'khor lo'i shar du ltung byed ma sngo ser/ g.yas rdo rje dang thod pa/ g.yon kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du gsod byed ma ljang ser/ g.yas rnge'u chung dang ral gri/ g.yon thod par bcas pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'gugs byed ma dmar ser/ g.yas mda' dang pad+ma/ g.yon gzhu dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gar dbang ma dkar ser g.yas ba dan dang thod pa/ g.yon rtse gsum dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ de dag gi thod pa bzhi ni/ rim pas glang po/ ce spyang*/ mi ba glang gi gzugs dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang nyi ma'i 'od skor can no/ / 'di dag la 'ga' zhig phyed gzugs byed pa ni mi legs shing*/ sngo ser zhes sogs phal cher 'dod pa ltar rgyud dang 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs 'gos 'gyur gyi dbang du byas te rin chen gyi rigs mtshon par 'dod pas dkyus su bshad pa yin yang*/ sngo skya/ ljang skya/ dmar skya/ ser skyar byas na'ang legs so/ / mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan pa'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi 'dab ma la pu li ra ma la yar rab tu gtum mo dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ byang phyogs dza lan dha rar gtum mig ma dang ma hā kaṃ ka la/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya rar 'od ldan ma dang kaṃ ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu tar sna chen ma dang mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ shar lho gau da ba rir/ dpa' bo blo gros ma dang lha'i dgra/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar mi'u thung ma dang 'od dpag med/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang rdo rje'i 'od/

byang shar ma la wār shing grib ma dang rdo rje'i sku rnams mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par e ra ba ti dang myu gu can/ byang phyogs o ṭar 'jigs byed chen mo dang rdo rje ral pa can/ nub phyogs tri sha ku nir rlung gi shugs can ma dang dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs go sa lar chang 'thung ma dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad/ shar lho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo dang rab tu bzang mo/ lho nub laṃ ba kar shin tu bzang mo dang rdo rje bzang po'o/ /nub byang kañcir rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed chen po/ byang shar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang rnams sku mdog dmar po'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang stobs po che/ byang phyogs grir ha de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang rin po che rdo rje/ nub phyogs sau raṣ+tar shaun+ṭi nī dang rta mgrin/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dwi par 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /shar lho nā ga rar shin tu dpa' mo dang dpal he ru ka lho nub sin+dhu stobs chen ma dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug nub byang ma rur 'khor los bsgyur ma dang rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tar brtson 'grus chen po dang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams sku mdog dkar po'o/ /de thams cad kyang shes rab ma gtso mor gyur pa ste/ dpa' mo thams cad phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug 'phyar bas bsdigs pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas thabs la 'khril bas bde chen sbyor ba la brtson pa/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ral pa'i cod pan can/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje brtan ma/

byang sgor gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub sgor gshin rje mche ba ma/ lho sgor gshin rje 'joms ma/ shar lhor khwa gdong ma/ lho nub tu 'ug gdong ma/ nub byang du khyi gdong ma/ byang shar du phag gdong ma ste/ de rnams thams cad sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa gru mor kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang bcas pa/ nyi ma dang ro la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ thams cad kyang skra mtshams la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang*/ rkang brgyan la dril bu g.yer khas mdzes pa'o/ /lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang = nas 'joms ma bzhi po'i bar/ dag pa dran par bya'o/ /rkang pa gnyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal med khang gru bzhi/ spyi bo pu li ra ma la yar rab gtum ma dang khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ spyi gtsug dza lan dha rar gtum mig ma dang mahā kaṃ ka la/ rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar 'od ldan ma dang kaṃ ka la/ ltag pa ar bu tar sna chen ma dang mche ba rnams par gtsigs pa/ rna ba g.yon pa gau da pa rir brtan pa'i blo can ma dang lha'i dgra/ smin mtshams rasmi shwa rar mi'u thung ma dang 'od dpag med/ mig de wī ko ṭar lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang rdo rje'i 'od/ phrag pa ma la bar shing grib ma dang rdo rje'i sku/ mchan khung ka ma rū par er ba ti dang aṃ gu ri/ nu ma o ṭer 'jigs byed chen mo dang rdo rje ral pa can/ lte ba tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma dang dpa' mo chen po/ sna rtse ko sa lar chang 'thung ma rdo rje hūṃ mdzad/ kha ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo dang rab tu bzang po/ mgrin pa lam+ba kar shin tu bzang mo dang rdo rje bzang po/

snying gar kañci rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed chen po/ 'dom bar hi ma la yar bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang*/ mtshan ma pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang stobs po che/ bshang lam gri ha de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang rin chen rdo rje/ brla gnyis sau raṣ+ta shoṇ+ḍi ni dang rta mgrin/ byin pa gser gling du 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang nam mkha'i snying po/ sor mo na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo dang he ru ka bol gong sin+dhur stobs chen ma dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug mthe bong ma rur 'khor los bsgyur ma dang rnam par snang mdzad/ pus mo ku lu tar brtson 'grus chen mo dang rdo rje sems dpa' 'o// oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ka ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ rang gi snying gar ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ snying gar hūṃ thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa gsung rdo rje/ dpral par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki dz+wā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ sku rdo rje/ gsum char yang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrī moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ dpral par phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ bai ro he re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

gsung rdo rje/ snying gar oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye swāhā/ /sku rdo rje'o/ /rang gi snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa ye shes sems dpa'/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ oṃ bī ni badz+ra ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa= nas oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ri ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pa dang*/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /brtse ba'i bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes kyang gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen 'khor lo pa la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'dod dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na/ yi ge nyer gnyis pa dang*/ bud+dha ḍā ki 'i sngags spel nas bzla ba'am/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru= nas ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ si li si li/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas/ sngags kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par rgyud 'grel du shes par bya'o/ / oṃ sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /bzlas pa'i gong du'am/ skabs 'dir mchod pa bya ste/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod pa ni phyi mchod do/ /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/

rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /lū yi ḍeṃ ki dha ri dril bu pa/ /lwa ba dza lan+dha ra nag po pa/ /dge mgon ti li nā ro pham ting mched/ /ma ṇi ka dang byang chub bzang po dang*/ /chos dbang bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan dang*/ /don grub ye shes shakya rdo rje dang*/ /sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog seng ge rgyal/ /g.yung ston rdor dpal grags tshul byang seng ba/ /gzhon blo kun bzang gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta//mkhan chen grol mchog zhabs dang bla ma rje/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang na/ rat+na shrī dge legs zhi ba'i blo/ /sa dbang bzang po sa dpal dri med dpal/ /shong ston blo brtan lo mchog seng ge rgyal/ / g.yung ston man chad gong bzhin no/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod myang*/ oṃ i nu ra ga na/ badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ thabs dang shes rab snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo'o/ / zhes pa gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// mkha' nang du gnas pa'i khu rngul myang bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni mchod pa chen po'o/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sbyangs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis hūṃ yig la thim/ hūṃ yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs

te go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod na/ bzlas pa'i sngon du'am/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i mthar bsgom mo/ /rgyun gyi gtor ma'i cho ga bsdus pa ni/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum skyed pa bor ba dang*/ bruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las rdzas bcu bskyed cing de rnams kyis mtshan pa bskyed pa ni khyad par ro// 'bring po ni ma rgyud spyi'i zhing skyong gi cho ga nyid yin zhing*/ rgyas par zhing skyong gi gtor ma'i cho ga chen po ni logs shig tu 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /go don rgyas par rgyud 'grel dang ka la kalpa'i sgrubs thabs dang bla ma snga ma rnams kyi yi ger blta bar bya'o/ /tshul 'di phyi ma'i dus 'dir nub mthong nas/ /blo dman rnams la mchog tu mkho ba'i phyir/ /don rgyas shin tu nyung ngu'i tshig tu sdebs/ /gang 'di'i dge ba 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs te bcu gnyis pa'o// //༈ na mash+shaṃ wa rā ya/ gsang ba mchog gi pho brang du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchogagacig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /lha mo de la'ang gus btud nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho 'dir 'jug bya/ /da ni 'dir dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pa la de bshad par bya ste/ de yang rgyud las/ sngon du phag mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bri bya de nas he ru ka'i 'o/ /rdo rje bu mo'am de nas gzhan/ /der ni shes rab gzhug par bya/ rgyud gzhan du ni dbang bskur la/ /tshul 'di bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mi g.yo bla med las kyang 'di dang 'dra bar bshad pa la phyis kha cig rang gi dbang ma thob na dbang gzhan thob kyang mi rung ba'i don tsam du 'chad mod tshig don la ma zhugs te/

rang gi dbang ma thob na ta ga la zhig /rang gi dbang thob kyang rgyud gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la 'di mi ston zhes pa'i don du 'dug pas/ mkhas pa rang tsho dang*/ mi mkhas kyang mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can ske 'khrang po rnams tshig 'di lta bu'i don gang yin da dung rtogs shig /skabs 'dir rgyud 'di'i dbang bskur thob pas de la dang por zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma byin te rang gnas su btang*/ oṃ hūṃ/ zhes stan byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā lan gnyis kyis kha dang lag pa byin gyis brlab/ g.yon pa'i mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams nas/ sor mo rnams kyi rtsa ba la/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i 'dzom dang*/ mthe bong la sogs pa'i sen mo la/ oṃ ha na ma hi/ swāhā hūṃ/ bo ṣa ṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ/ rnamasas 'khod/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod/ lag mthil g.yas su bzhag ste/ srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung bri/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod la/ yan lag lnga dang*/ mchod rdzas sogs la bsang gtor bya/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān ut+pa da ya hūṃ/ oṃ a badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ oṃ arka bu ma le swāhā/ oṃ tsan+t+ra bi ma le swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal bya/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ bhu ra bhu wa swaḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥs+thā naṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.at+ma na me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥyo gaṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ bar 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rdo rje phyag rgya gnas drug tu reg la/ oṃ hā sogs brjod pas go cha bcings/ spro na dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro= sogs sh+lo ka gnyis dang*/ srid pa'i rgya mtshor yongs bying ba/ /yang dag yongs su sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin gang gis/ /bdag la ye shes 'di bskyed 'dud/ / ces phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/

/mdor bsdu ba'i tshe/ nang mchod dang lag pa byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams bya/ gzhan de rnams ma grub kyang nyes pa med do/ / rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ nag po/ oṃ a ā= nas ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ gi nā da las yi ge'i 'phreng ba spros/ lus kyi stod bar smad rnams su/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i 'phreng bas g.yon skor du dkris/ de las khams gsum du gtogs pa thams cad du 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te srid pa gsum gyi bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo dang*/ dpral pa dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la/ rim pas shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi kha dog sngon po'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ rgyas par spro na/ shrī yig 'byung ba kun gyi don/ zhes sogs brjod cing don sgom par slob dpon dag gsung mod/ tshig de ma brjod kyang dgos nges pa'i tshig don chad pa med do/ / gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /phung po lnga po thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go

/nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ / dag pa gsum dang phung khams byin gyis rlabs pa de dag ni/ rten byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol gdab cing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha kā yi kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa wā tsī kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya tsa ra pi maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra dz+nyā ni kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags rnams nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rtse lnga pa ljang khu'i mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha tshar gnyis brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba/ gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang rang 'dra'i phur bu thogs pa spros/ oṃ bigh+nān a na ya dzaḥ zhes bskul bas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug hūṃ rwa ba'i phyi rol du 'brub khung mes gang ba byung ba rnams su bcug phur bus spyi bor gdab/ oṃ gha gha= sogs brjod/ tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra muta ga ra= sogs brjod/ bgegs rnams stong pa'i dbyings su sbyangs/ pho nya mo rnams ra ba la thim/ 'od zer gyi thig le phyir 'phros pas/ 'khor lo dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ me'i rwa ba zlum po rnams su gyur/ 'og gi hūṃ zhu bas rdo rje phra mo'i bar mtshams med par gtams/ bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kun nas bgegs dang bral ba'o/

/ de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sarba sun+da ri swāhā/ oṃ pri ya ud ta ma swāhā/ oṃ da ma gā tā rā swāhā/ oṃ bi wā sa badz+ra swāhā/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ne swāhā/ oṃ mā ma kī swāhā/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa ra wa si swāhā/ oṃ tā rā swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi me tog gi steng du/ lha tshogs rnams rang rang gi rnam pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rol pas bzhugs/ shar du kun mdzes ma sngon mo/ byang du dga' mchog ma ljang khu/ nub tu shin tu brtse ma dmar mo/ lho ru rol pa'i rdo rje ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang snyem pa rin po che dang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bkang nas/ gtso bo la bstod pa/ mer spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ bden bral du mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal/ bzhi char yang g.yas rang rtags dang*/ g.yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs can no/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis mgron la bsangs gtor bya/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+ka ra pā d+yāṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ= bar 'dir lha so so'i sngags kyis me tog 'bul bar bshad kyang*/ yun ring du thogs pa'i phyir deng sang lag len mi mdzad do/ / oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ snying ga'i hūṃ las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra wī ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa= nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i rkang pa re re'i 'go ru oṃ re dang*/ mjug tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa re sbyar bas bstod de/ oṃ na ma shrī badz+ra ḍā ka ma hā bī ra wī re shwa rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa nas/ oṃ grasta pā ta pra bā ta ma hā ma te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i bar ro/ /de la skabs 'dir rkang pa zhe brgyad pa/ oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa spel bas nang mchod 'bul zhing*/ ma spel bas bstod pa byed pa'i lugs ni mi legs par snang la/ ci ste nang mchod 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang sngags sam 'bru gsum gyi phul na legs so/ /spro na/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang shā bā ri pa dang*/ /mai tri pa dang rgya gar phyag na dang*/ /pad+ma rdo rje dza ya s+ya na dang*/ /sum lo grags rgyal sa paṇa skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang mang 'khar lo tsā dang*/ /bag ston tshul rgyal ngag dbang byang seng ba/ /sa bzang 'phags pa mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ /byams pa gling pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /rgya ston byang dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang*/ /byams pa lhun grub rnams la gus pas mchod/ / ces pa 'di rje btsun grol mchog gis gsan yig ltar bkod pa yin/ yang na srin po ri nas rgyud pa'am/ rgyal tsha chos dbang mang 'khar lo tsā ba/ /glo chen ye shes mgon dang dar ma bzang*/ /grags chen spang khang pa dang rin rtson pa/ /mkhan chen byang seng theg chen chos rje dang*/ /brag thog bsod bzang 'jigs med <rdo rje gdan pa >dpa' bo dang*/ rgya ston man gong bzhin/ yang na/ sum lo mkhas pa mu dra pa dang*/ seng ge rgyal mtshan yar klungs lo tsā ba/ rong ba sher sing kyi ston grags rgyal dang*/ kun mkhyen chen po slob dpon chos grags dpal/ byang seng sogs sum lo man chad sna tshogs su gyes pa'o/ /nye rgyud/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /shā bā ri pa sems kyi mdud <rje grol mchog go >grol dang*/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus lha dbang grags pa ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ ces so/ / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dir 'byung ba/

/ dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ / thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs rjes khro ba drag chen po/ / dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ / sdig pa ma lus skyon kun bcom pa yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa gzung bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsngags pa'i dge ba gang*/ /de dag kun la bdag gis rjes yi rang*/ /byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyid/ / rgyun bshags 'di dz+nyā dzā ya s+ya na'i gzhung*/ sum pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba ltar na/ rkang pa drug las med pa sogs 'gyur mi bde ba bag re snang bas gzhung gzhan 'gyur bde ba ltar bris so/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa gu ru pā de bh+yaḥsarba satwa u pa kā ra ṇā ya swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ tshogs zhing gi dkyil 'khor bcas rang la thim pa'am/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥhūṃ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/ bsod nams tshogs gsog go /oṃ sarba dharmāḥshū n+ya swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swā bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ 'di'i sngags gnyis pa des thams cad la 'dra min zhig yod pa ni/ rgya dpe'am thog ma'i bod dpe gang rung ma dag par gsal lo/ /de lta bu'i sngags kyi don sgom pa ni ye shes tshogs gsog go / stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las thig le/ de las zla phyed/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha/ de las ū yig grub pa'i tshul gyis/

hūṃ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de dang lhan cig grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ phyi rol 'khor lo dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ me'i rwa bas bskor ba thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo de'i nang 'og gi char/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po bzla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ kha dog bzhi dang zur bzhi pa/ rtse mo brgyad pa la sum gyis mtshan pa/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar nagabyang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba dkar ba/ 'byung ba rnams zhu zhing sla ba'i ngo bor gyur pas/ ri rab 'og gi cha la song la/ 'byung bzhi zhu ba rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal med khang chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi la gnas shing dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i nang du chud pa kho na phyi nang du rim pa bzhi las/ pho brang nang ma gsum zlum po/ phyi ma gru bzhi'o/ /pho brang dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i 'khor lo ni/ nag po dang sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur gsum pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur bzhi pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur lnga pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/

sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du chud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang po'i dbus su sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo/ pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa ste/ de'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan ma'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo sngo nag mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du snying po'i 'khor lo dmar ser rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du yon tan gyi 'khor lo dkar dmar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol skal ba bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du nam mkha'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar nas g.yon bskor gyis/ gtum drag /tshang tshing can/ 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i keng rus/ 'jigs sde/ dbang sde/ dbang ldan nas g.yon skor gyis/ ha ha rgod pa/ dpal gyi nags/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa rnams so/ /de dag na gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha a shwat+tha kaṃ ka la tsu ta/ n+ya gro dha/ ka rañja/ la ta par+sha bār+tha pa'o/ phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ dbang po/ gnod sbyin/ klu'i dbang po/ gshin rje'i bdag po/ 'byung po'i bdag po/ bsreg za'i bdag po/ srin po'i bdag po/ rlung gi bdag po/ klu chen po brgyad ni/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ hu lu hu lu/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong ngo*/ /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ sgra sgrogs/ 'ur sgrogs/ drag po 'khyil ba/ 'thug po/ gang ba/ char 'bebs gtum po'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dam skyes sngon po'i mdog can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du rlung gi 'khor lo sngo ljang ngam sna tshogs pa'i mdog can 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sa'i 'khor lo ser po ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/

de'i phyi rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du me'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ gsod byed/ kun tu skrag byed/ 'jigs chen/ /'jigs byed/ skrod byed/ sdang byed/ lkugs byed/ rengs byed do/ /shing brgyad ni/ gu yo/ star kā nā ri la/ se 'bru bil ba/ kyu ru ra/ bi dz+nyā/ rag sha'o/ /phyogs skyong ma brgyad ni/ dbang mo/ gnod sbyin mo/ chu lha mo/ gshin rje mo/ 'byung mo/ drang srong mo/ srin mo/ rlung gi chung ma'o/ / dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dbus su me'i 'khor lo dmar po sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyir rol du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi 'khor lo ljang khu'am khra bo mgo bo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du chu'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ byis pa shi ba/ lhag ma za ba/ mi bzad pa'i g.yul/ mche ba kun/ du ba mun nag nang gi me/ ha ha'i sgra/ sgra chen po'o/ /shing brgyad ni/ tsan dan/ ga bur/ dzā tī/ e la/ nā ga ge sar/ tsam pa ka hun tu ru/ lha'i shing ngo*/ /'jigs rten skyong ba brgyad ni/ nyi ma me 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ bsil pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ sa'i bu chu gri 'dzin pa/ ri bo can skyes mdung ring 'dzin pa/ bla ma spu'i gri 'dzin pa/ ngan spong brag ri 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i bu glog 'dzin pa/ lha min mgo bo mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa ste thams cad kyang bzhin shin tu khros pa'o/ /grub pa'i skyes bu brgyad ni/ ral gri mig sman ril bu rkang byug bcud len/ mchil lham/ dngul chu/ sa 'og thob pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po keng rus kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po zhags pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/

de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can/ mu khyud la lcags kyu'i 'phreng ba'i yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i phyir rol du skal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu rlung gi khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ tshig pa/ ma tshig pa/ dum bur gyur pa/ ma brtubs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ 'jigs par byed pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa/ steng nas btags pa'o/ /shing brgyad ni/ shal+ma li/ mya ngan med pa/ yongs 'du/ u dum+ba ra/ ḍom+ba ri/ gam+bha ri/ rgya shug /ba ru ra'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba ni/ dmyal srung chen po brgyad do/ /de la gzhal med khang rim pa re re'i nang du chud pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum gsum ste/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang so sor rtsibs sum cu rtsa drug dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang rnams kyang pha gu dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags kyi rtse mo brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus dkar ba/ steng thog rim par phub pas dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang gi grwa bzhir/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi po rnams kyang*/ re re bzhin zhing skyong ba dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten brgyad brgyad rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ ro dang ro langs dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi 'khor gyi yongs su gang ba/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang grub pa'i rdzas kyi nye bar brgyan pa/ phyi rol na rdo rje 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/

nang gi lha'i gnas rnams las/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma nyer bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i sgo mtshams rnams su ro'i gdan/ skal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /

'di dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā= nas aṃ aḥ nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du ka kha= nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i hūṃ yig zhugs/ de las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams spros te/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i bdag nyid du byas nas slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ yang 'od 'phros thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpal bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyogs bcu nas spyan drangs te hūṃ la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ dkar ljang dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis cang te'u/ gri gug dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ g.yon bzhis kha ṭ+waṃ ga thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan mo mnan pa/ lhag ma 'bras bu'i he ru ka dang mtshungs pa thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig go / de yan chad ni bsnyen pa'o/ / yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa byāṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i rtse mor byāṃ dmar ser gyis mtshan pa/

yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa d+yāṃ las byung ba'i ze 'bru'i rtse mor d+yāṃ dkar ser gyis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang*/ yum gyi mgrin par/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang*/ yum gyi dpral par/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sa ma wa raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sngags rnams phan tshun reg cing yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul te yab kyi zhal du zhugs lha mo'i pad mar son pa na/ yab yum gnyis ka bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi thig le'i gong bur zhu bar gyur/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin thig le las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo drug tshan bzhi/ rang rang gi gnas kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'dug nas bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ mnga' bdag nyi ma re rer 'gro ba mgron 'bod na/ khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid la bzhugs/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod/ /gson zhig gson zhig gzhan gyi dgongs pa nub/ /'jig rten phyugs gang shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi pad+ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun bder 'gyur bar byos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la rol zhig rol/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob/ /'jig rten sems can gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas/ /ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med 'gyur/

khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed po ste/ /ci'i phyir lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs/ /bdag la mchog gi don gyi 'dod pa mdzod/ /ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnams mthun bzhud/ /ces bskul nas/ lha mo rnams thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid hūṃ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar hūṃ ljang sngon gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ oṃ āḥkā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa hoḥ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sngags 'di 'don bzhin par bzhengs pa na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis rdzogs par blta'o/ /de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la/ nyi ma dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan mo'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba'i phyir gzugs la/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyi phung po can/ zhal bcu bdun/ phyag bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ rtsa zhal gyi steng gi zhal gsum dang*/ kun gyi steng gi zhal gcig ste bzhi ni bung ba ltar gnag cing ches khros pa/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ljang khu/ rgyab zhal brtsegs ma bzhi dmar po g.yas zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ser po/ zhal re re zhing dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ kun gyi mdun ma'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa thams cad kyi tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyi glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa ste rtsa ba'i phyag bzhi'o/ /lhag ma sprul phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dang po g.yas g.yon ral gri phub chen bsnams/ /gnyis pa dag gis mdung ring che ba 'dzin/

/gsum pa mdung rtse gsum dang gtun shing ngo*/ /bzhi pa dgra sta zhags pa ste/ /lnga pa gri gug thog khrag go /drug pa mda' bo che dang gzhu/ /bdun pa gsal shing kha ṭ+waṃ ga /brgyad pa tho ba po ti dang*/ /dgu pa 'khor lo phub chung dang*/ /bcu pa cang te'u sdigs mdzub can/ /bcu gcig chu gri g.yer kha'i 'phreng*/ /bcu gnyis dbyug gu rtse gcig lug gu rgyud//bcu gsum mtshon cha rtse gcig brag ri'o/ /bcu bzhi dung dkar dur khrod rdul/ /bco lnga zangs dung bho kaṃ dang*/ /bcu drug dbyug rtse gsum dang ḍha ka ste/ /bcu bdun rma bya'i mjug sgro pags rlon no/ /bco brgyad bya rog gshog sgro skra thag dang*/ /bcu dgu skra'i spir ro bsreg bskul ba'i shing*/ /nyi shu me thab ga da'i dbyug /nyer gcig ri bo phub rings dang*/ /nyer gnyis dbyug to mi mgo dang*/ /nyer gsum me long keng rus dang*/ /nyer bzhi pi waṃ zor ba'o/ /nyer lnga rkang pa'i mgo dang mig /nyer drug lag mgo mkhal ma ste/ /nyer bdun glo ba snye ma dang*/ /nyer brgyad rgyu ma spen pa dang*/ /nyer dgu sgra can phur bu'o/ /sum cu lcags sgrog bi dza pur/ /so gcig gdos dang sog le ste/ /so gnyis du bhu sa dang khab/ /so gsum nya dol pags pa rlud bu bshus/ /so bzhi mgo med ro dang char 'bebs sprin/ /so lnga 'bar ba'i mar nag ljon shing ste/ /so drug 'jigs byed che gzugs lcags kyu bsnams/ / de dag la phub rings ni zur bzhi nar thabs can/ phub chen bse phub lta bu zlum po/ phub chung lag phub thug mo nang na lag 'dzin gdong kag yod pa/ chu gri ni gri thung*/ lug gu rgyud ni nyag thag kha cig na lug rgyud med par sgrog 'dzin pa yod/ gdos ni/ gru rkya dang*/ tshong ge dang*/ srog chags 'dzin pa'i rnyi'i rigs gcig la 'dod pa sogs sna tshogs yod kyang phyi ma 'thad par sems/ bho gaṃ ni bla ma rnams mdung thung yin par 'chad pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya mod/

zangs dung gi nang sel yin par yang mi 'gal/ ḍha ka ni rnga pa ṭa ha/ du bhu sa ni nya skyogs su rlud bu bshus ni kha cig seng ge'i rlud bu bshus su bzhed do/ /skye gnas phyag rgya skabs 'dir yum gyi phyag yin pa yab kyi phyag tu 'khrul bas/ phyag tha ma'i 'jigs byed lcags kyu dang glang lpags lhan cig byed pa dang*/ dmar nag 'jigs byed lhan cig /ljon shing lcags kyu lhan cig byed pa sogs smra bas 'phongs pa dag byung zhes gzigs pa yangs po dag gsung pa ni shin tu mang ba'o/ /yang dkyus su 'jug ste/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan mo dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog spyi bor bcings ba'i rtse mor 'khor lo la gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang*/ ral ba'i mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag brgya'i do shal can/ phyag drug dang dpung rgyan dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ sku lus ba spu'i 'phreng ba can/ sku'i tshigs thams cad la bde bas rlan pa/ sprul pa'i he ru ka sna tshogs pa rnam par 'phro ba dang bcas pa'o/ / de ni sgrub pa'o/ / de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis zangs gri sta re ḍā ma rus tri shu la/

g.yon bzhis ka pā la/ 'ching byed mkhar dbyug /tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis spyi bo'i steng du skye gnas kyi phyag rgya yongs su bskor ba/ dmar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/ gcer bu ba spu langs shing rngul dang ldan pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ yan lag thams cad la lha rdzas kyi dris nye bar byugs shing lha rdzas kyi me tog 'phreng bas klubs/ dbu rgyan la zla phyed rdo rjes mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon skyang ba'i stabs kyis yab dpal he ru ka dang sbyor ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /'di dag tu rnam grangs kyi nges pa cung zad bshad na/ yab kyi zhabs gnyis su byed pa 'di bsdus pa'i lugs yin/ rgyud kyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis ston pa'i skabs kyi dgongs pa'ang yin par 'dod de/ le'u gnyis pa rdo rje phag mo phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skabs dang*/ le'u bco lnga pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs 'dir rgyu rdor 'dzin skabs su zhabs kyis 'jigs dus mnan pa tsam gsungs pa zhabs gnyis pa yin phyin 'bras bus rdor 'dzin skabs kyang 'jigs dus mnan par gsungs pas zhabs kyang sngar dang 'dra bar shugs la 'grub par bsams te/ rgyal sdes kyang zhabs gnyis par mdzad gda' ba lar nas 'gal ba ga la yod/ 'on kyang gdan 'jigs dus tsam gyis zhabs gnyis kho nar 'grub dka' zhing*/ skabs gzhan du byung bas kyang ma nges la 'di lta bu sku 'dra 'jim gzugs bzhengs pa sogs la ni cung zad mi bde yang 'byung ngo*/ /phag mo chen mo'i skabs su gsung pa ltar zhabs bco brgyad kyis lha chen bco brgyad mnan pa ni 'bring po dang*/ le'u lnga bcu pa las byung ba ltar/ zhal so bdun/ phyag stong phrag

/rtsa ba'i zhabs bco brgyad kyis lha chen bco brgyad chung mar bcas pa gnon pa ni rgyas pa'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen chen pos/ bstod pa mdzad pa na 'jigs dus mnan pa tsam zhig gsungs/ zhabs kyi grangs gsal ma mdzad/ sgrub thabs nyung ngu dang*/ thugs dam ri mor bris pa la/ zhabs bco brgyad pa/ 'og tu 'jigs dus che ba re byas de'i steng du lha bco brgyad mnan pa mdzad 'dug pa ltar na bris 'bur bzhengs pa dang*/ sgom pa sogs gang la yang bde bas 'dam kha rnams kyi nang nas 'di ngos bzung bar sem mo/ phag gdong chen mo'i skabs na/ lha bco brgyad la rlung lha sa lha chu lha/ gnod sbyin/ bdud/ 'khor sgyur rnams yod/ stong phrag phyag can gyi skabs su drug po de'i dod du thags bzang ris dang*/ dgra bcom dang*/ bla ma/ skyob pa/ bla ma gnyis pa log 'dren zhes pa yod la/ phyi ma lnga po de rnams rgyal ba dam pa dang*/ phur bu dang*/ mi sbyin dang*/ pa sangs dang*/ a sho ka rnams yin no/ /skabs 'dir phag gdong chen mo'i lugs bzhin byas na bde'o/ /yum gtso bo dang zhal phyag mtshungs pa rgyas pa/ dkyus su bkod pa ltar zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa 'bring po ste 'di ni 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyis skabs su gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsdus pa ste/ rgyas bsdus gnyis le'u lnga bcu par/ phag mo yis ni 'khyud pa ste/ /de gzugs can nam phyag gnyis skyes/ /zhes pas bstan la/ phyag gnyis kyi phyogs la skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa dang*/ gri thod 'dzin pa gnyis spyir gang byas kyang chog mod/ dza ya s+ya nas 'khrul pa cung zad mdzad pa'i nor ba rjes su 'brang ba'ang mang ngo*/ /rgyud las/ de yi mdun gnas lha mo che/ /rdo rje phag mo sngar dang mtshungs/ /zhes sngar le'u gnyis par phag mo phyag bcu gnyis pa gsungs pa la zhal 'phangs mdzad pa ste/ der 'jigs dus me lta bu'i 'od zer can/

zhes pas gzi brjid kyi dpe'am/ me dpung 'bar ba bstan par ma zad sku mdog kyang dmar mor bstan par bzhed pa yang legs shing*/ yab mig sman mdog tu bshad/ phag mo gtso bor gyur pa thabs kyis 'khyud pa'i skabs der ni/ phyag tha mas bdud kyi pags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /phag gdong chen mo lta bu'i yum rkyang la ni glang lpags so/ /der skye gnas phyag rgya gnyis kyis/ lhag ma rdo rje phag mo'o/ /gal te he ru ka gtso bo/ de tshe phag mo'i phyag gnyis su'o/ /glang po'i pags pa 'dzin pa po/ /zhes yab gtso bor gyur pa las/ yab kyis glang lpags dang*/ yum skye gnas kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa dang*/ yum gtso bor gyur pa la de go bzlog par bshad pas/ sgrub thabs dza ya s+ya nas mdzad pa las/ glang po'i pags pa phyag gnyis kyis/ skye gnas phyag rgya de bzhin gzhan/ /zhes rgyud tshig ji lta ba drangs nas/ slar yum phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin par byas pas 'gal ba 'dus te thams cad la 'khrul gzhi byung ba yin gyi/ rgyud tshig rang la 'khrul gzhi de med pas bshad par bla'o/ /de bzhin du mtshon cha bdun cu rtsa gnyis su bshad pa yang*/ rtsa phyag bzhi ma bgrangs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa kho na'o/ /zhes rig par bya'o/ /de yan chad kyi dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// // sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo'i pad ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad las/ bar bar du 'dab ma re re bor ba'i 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ shar nas byang gi bar la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang gzugs can nyid/ /'o byed ma dang gzhan sgyur ma/ /byis bcas ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /de rnams g.yon nag g.yas ljang khu/ /byang nas nub kyi bar la/ lā ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma/ /bzang mo thod pa can ma dang*/ /nag mo rgyal pos bskor ma rnams/ /g.yon ljang g.yas dmar rim pas so/ /nub nas lho'i bar la/ dum skyes mi dang dur khrod ma/ /rnam par zhu ma rigs byed ma/

/dur byed ma dang gar ma rnams/ /g.yon dmar g.yas ni ser ba'o/ /lho nas shar gyi bar la/ gzugs can ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gtsug phud ma dang thor tshugs ma/ /ral pa can ma drag mo rnams/ /g.yon ser g.yas ni sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /
