zhes dza ya s+ya na dang bod thams cad 'dod pa ltar rung ba'ang yin la/ 'on kyang rgyud las skabs 'dir gtso bo dang mtshungs par gsungs pas/ rdo rje phag mo yab dang mtshungs na nyer bzhi snying po'i lha mo yang dbu ma phyag mang/ bcom ldan 'das ma phyag bcu gnyis ma ltar na/ 'di dag kyang de dang 'dra ba/ yum phyag gnyis ma ltar na 'di dag kyang phyag gnyis pa'o zhes don yin kyang da lta'i lag len la dang po mi 'grub pa'i phyi ma gnyis gang bde yin la/ 'on kyang phyag bzhi ma g.yas gri gug ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga byas na'ang legs so/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa nyer bzhi'o/ / de'i phyir rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ mkha' 'gro ma gzhan lā ma gzhan/ / dum skyes ma gzhan gzugs can gzhan/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma mi'u thung ma/ laṅga'i bdag mo shing grib ma/ /sa srung 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ /rlung shugs ma dang chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs lha mo rab bzang ma/ /rta rna ma dang bya gdong ma/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma dum skyes ma/ /chang tshong 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /shin tu dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ /'khor los bsgyur ma brtson 'grus chen ma/ /gshin rje'i bu mo gshin rje ma/ /bskyod byed ma dang skrag byed ma/ /gtum mo dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /'dod grub ma dang 'bar chen mo/ /de thams cad kyang sngo nag byed pa'i gzugs can no/ /'di dag gi yab rnams mtshan tha dad pa la mos na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa kā pā la sogs pa nyer bzhi dang*/ stobs po che/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ blo brtan/ brtan pa thar ba/ ye shes thabs/ thugs kyi rdo rje zhes pa rnams su bshad la/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi skabs 'dir/

'og ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir mtshan tha dad pa ma smos kyang chog go /snying po'i 'khor lo pa shar nas g.yon skor gyi/ rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma/ /rin chen gtsug ma rnam snang ma/ /pad+ma dkar dbang ma dang don yod ma/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar mo sgrol ma/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma dang de bzhin tu/ /sgra dri ro reg chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sa snying mo dang nam mkha'i snying po ma/ /phyag rdor ma dang 'jig rten mgon mo dang*/ /sgrib kun sel ma kun tu bzang mo dang*/ /rin chen sgrol ma bdag med khro gnyer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can ma de bzhin du/ /gshin rje mthar med mo dang shes mthar ma/ /pad mthar ma dang bgegs mthar byed ma dang*//mi g.yo ma dang dbyug sngon 'dod rgyal ma/ / stobs chen ma dang gtsug tor gnod mdzes ma thams cad kyang dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /yon tan 'khor lo la/¿bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs mo/ /dmangs mo gtum mo khyi mchod ma/ /g.yung mo gar ma thod pa can/ /nya pa mo dang smig ma mkhan/ /dung bzod mkhan ma tha ga ma/ /'khur ba mkhan mo shing bzo ma/ /'phreng ba mkhan mo til mar mkhan/ /de bzhin chos mkhan mo dang ni/ /srin bal byed mo pho nya mo/ /bshang 'phyag mo dang brtses mkhan mo/ /chang tshong ldum ra'i gnyer pa mo/ /rgyal pos bkrabs ma gshan pa mo/ /so rtsi tshong par byed ma dang*/ /gser mgar mo dang lcags mgar mo/ /nor bu mkhan pa nag pa mo/ /kla klo o ṭi tshong pa mo/ /rdo bzo ma dang zhing las mo/ /ko lpags ma ste rnal 'byor ma'o/ /thams cad kyang dkar dmar byed pa'i gzugs can no/ de'i phyi rol skal ba bzang po'i snam bu la/ byams pa nas brtsams te glog gi tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgo khwa gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams so/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo la/ mi 'am ci mo dri za mo/ /hu ṭu ka ma pa pha ṭa ha/ /pi waṃ gling bu mu kun+da/ /rdza rnga gag+ga ri ma dang*/ /cha lang shes len+d+ri ka ma/ /klu ma ka ran+ḍa ma ta ma ḍa/ /gar ma sgeg ma dha ka ma dang ni/ /tā li sha ra ṇa mo rnga chen mo/ /mau dri rgyud can ma dang mā ru ma/ /na la bā mo ḍhaṃ ba ka ma dang*/ /ḍā ma ru dang ḍuṇa ḍu ka ma dang*/ /zangs dung ma dang rwa dung ma de bzhin/ /bhu ki dril bu ma dang dril chung ma// g.yer kha ma dang ko li ka ma dang*/ /dung dkar ma dang dbyangs ldan ma de bzhin/ /'khor ma zhes bya sum cu rtsa drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /yang na sna tshogs par bkra ba'o/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la/ mkha' lding dang mo bkra ba mo/ /bya rog bya dkar sreg pa mo/ /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/ /gu da bu li 'jam pa mo/ /phug ron bya rog chen mo dang*/ kha ṭi ni dang gong ma sreg /ne tso sngags ma gzhad ma dang*/ /bya rgod 'ug pa tsā ṭa ki /shing bye'u ma dang ngur ba ma/ /pri k+ṣi ra ni kak+ka si/ /so bya mo dang bi lā ṭi/ /lcug ma'i mgrin dang sha ri kī /bye'u khra gur bum lce ma dang*/ /ba ṭi ri kā dzaṃ ga mo/ /hor pa kaṃ ga mo de bzhin/ /da t+ta ri mo ri dwags dgra/ /thams cad kyang sngo ljang phyed pa'am sna tshogs pa'i kha dog bkra ba can no/ /sa'i 'khor lo la/ seng ge mo dang stag mo dang*/ /bhiṃ ba mo dang ri bong mo/ /glang chen ri dwags byi la mo/ /ba dang ma he mo rta mo/ /ce spyang mo dang bse mo 'bri/ /byi ba bong mo bhe ḍi ma/ ra mo lug mo rim pa bzhin/ khyi mo phag mo dom mo dang*/ /daṇ+ḍa ri ma mo dz+nyā kī/ /dred mo dang ni sgeg mo dang*/ /nags ma dang ni khyi chen mo/ /bya rog chen mo shardu lī/ /sbrul mo khra mo rnga mong dang*/ /sre mong rtsang mo phug pa mo/ /grong na gnas pa ma rnams so/

/thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ mchod pa dang dpal sbas nas brtsams te tshangs pa'i tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor tshangs ma/ byang sgor dbang phyug ma/ nub sgor gzhon nu ma/ lho sgor khyab 'jug ma/ mer phag mo/ bden bral du dbang mo/ /rlung du gtum mo/ dbang ldan du dpal chen mo rnams so/ /me'i 'khor lo la/ lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ 'byung mo ma dang chung ma sring*/ bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang*/ pha yi sring mo de bzhin du/ zhang po yi ni chung ma dang*/ /chung ma'i spun zla dang de'i ma/ /de nyid kyi ni pha yi ma/ /chung ma yi ni phyi mo dang*/ /ma yi ma dang gnyen mo dang*/ /ma'i spun spun zla'i bu mo dang*/ /rang gi phyi mo'i spun zla dang*/ /spun zla'i bu mo de'i bu mo/ /pha yi ma dang phyi mo dang*/ khu bo yi ni chung ma dang*/ /bu mo'i bu yi chung ma dang*/ /slar yang chung ma'i spun zla mo/ /pha yi sring dang de'i bu mo/ /de nyid kyi ni rang rigs skyes/ /spun zla'i chung ma su tī dang*/ /bu nyid kyi ni chung ma dang*/ /bu mo'i khyo yi ma yi ni/ /bu nyid kyi ni rgyug mo dang*/ /'jo byed mo dang pū tri'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /chu'i 'khor lo la/ ma ka ra mo kurmī ka /sral mo kats+tshi chu sram mo/ /sdig nag gag+ga rā ma shī li ma/ /chu yi phug ma srin bu'i gdong ma dang*/ /cha ga karka ṭa dang su ya mo/ /chu byi mo dang grog mo'i gdong ma dang*/ /chu yi mi mo dang ni ba ṭa bī/ /glang chen mo dang stag mo ce spyang mo/ /chu sbrul ma dang dud mo 'gron bu ma/ /mu tig ma ṇī mo dang dziṃ gu rī/ /li sa mo dang dung ngur ma kar+ṇo ṭi/ /pha ṭa ka ma dā wa ka ma kri ma mo/ /dzu ṣi dzu ṣa mo dang sha sbrang ka lā mo/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ thig le mchog ma shin tu

bde/ /lha yi bu mo dga' chen mo/ /dga' dang dga' grags pad+ma can/ /dung can sna tshogs glang chen ma/ /gzugs can ma dang gzugs mdzes ma/ /'dod chags rnam sgeg bde ba mo/ /me tog 'dod ma ku mu da/ /ut+pal ma dang mdzes ldan ma/ /'dod chags mo dang 'dod chags che/ /rol grags ma dang rol chen mo/ /myos ma dang ni myos chen ma/ /'dod pa mo dang 'dod chen ma/ /bde 'byung ma dang bde ldan ma/ /mthun mchog ma dang byams pa mo/ /skal bzang ldan ma skal bzang mo/ /dma' mo zhum ma skyes gzugs ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ zla ba'i gdugs nas mthu'i dpal gyi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /sgo mtshams brgyad la shar du gau rī/ byang du tsau rī/ nub tu be tā lī/ lho ru ghasma rī/ bsreg par pu ka sī/ srin por ri khrod ma/ rlung mtshams su tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ 'byung por ḍom+bhi nī rnams so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ klu mo gnod sbyin mo 'byung mo/ /yi dwags dmyal mo mnar med ma/ /ltung ba ma dang bar med ma/ /bum pa mo dang gshin rje mo/ /thig nag mo dang me mdag ma/ /tsha ba ma dang rab tsha ma/ /ngu 'bod ma dang ngu 'bod che/ /mar nag du mched ri gnyis 'tshor/ /sdang ma rmongs ma phrag dog ma/ /chags ma ser snas myos pa ma/ /skud pa ma dang grang ba mo/ /de bzhin ral gri'i nags ma nyid/ /du ma dang ni mu ge ma/ /nang dgon mtshon dgon chu'i dgon ma/ /ral gri'i so ma rab med ma/ /spu gri'i so ma 'khor lo can/ /grul bum ma ste so drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la/ le lo chos sems sgom pa mo/ /mchod sems bza' sems gnyid sems ma/ khyim sems bud med sems ma dang*/ /don sems ma dang sbyor bral ma/ /bu sems ma dang mya ngan ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang sngags zlos ma/ /ngo mtshar nga rgyal gdung ba mo/ /sems can don gyi rgyur brtson ma/

/rgyal po sems ma gzhan gnod ma/ /ye shes thob ma dka' thub ma/ /rgas ma 'chi ba sems ma dang*/ /bde ma sdug ma mi dge ma/ /yod ma med ma nyid dang ni/ /bla ma sems ma 'gro ba mo/ /bzod ma mi bzod dal ma dang*/ /ngal sos ma dang bkres sems ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ / 'di thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar sems pa ma zhes sbyor rgyu yin no/ / sku'i 'khor lo la 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs 'khor los bsgyur ma dang*/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'thab bral dga' ldan pa/ /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed tshangs ris pa/ /tshangs pa 'dun na 'don dang tshangs chen po/ /'od chung tshad med 'od dang 'od gsal ba/ /dge chung tshad med dge dang dge rgyas dang*/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che/ /mi che mi gdung shin tu mthong ba dang*/ /gya nom snang ba dang ni 'og min pa/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ /ci yang med dang 'du shes yod min zhing*/ /'du shes med min gyi ni skye mched dang*/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang ni mi/ /lha min zla ba nyi ma gshin rje dang*/ /dbang po'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ba'am/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i khro bo'o/ /'di thams cad kyi mthar 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma zhes sbyor ba yin no/ /de'i phyir rol gyi snam bu la/ 'phags dgyes nas snang mdzad kyi bar gyi sangs rgyas nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor chu skyes dkar mo/ byang sgor gan+dha ri/ nub sgor rdo rje gar ma/ lho sgor rta rgod ma'i kha ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'bar zhal ma/ mer rdo rje khro gnyer can ma/ bden bral du rdo rje dum bu ma/ rlung du rdo rje gtum mo rnams so/ /de rnams las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ma thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga lhag ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

drag mo chen mo mche ba gtsigs shing chags pas bzhad pa/ gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba sogs sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams la 'khyud pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni mtshan dang sku'i rnam pa yum dang 'dra ba las/ phyag rgya drug dang ral ba'i cod pan dang*/ mgo rlon gyi do shal dang*/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhi'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ sgrub thabs dang bod rnams ltar na/ shar dang byang shar ba rnams ni g.yon sngo g.yas ljang ba/ byang dang nub byang ba rnams g.yon ljang g.yas dmar ba/ nub dang lho nub pa rnams g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba/ lho dang shar lho ba rnams g.yon ser g.yas sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ / 'on kyang rgyud kyi le'u so so'i dkyil 'khor la/ mkha' 'gro ma nag mo phyag bzhi mar mdzad/ lā ma sogs kha dog ma gtogs de la zhal 'phangs/ gzhan rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i shugs la go bar dgongs pa yin pas 'dir de nas drangs pas phyag bzhi pa'ang legs so/ / skal bzang gis sangs rgyas rnams ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngon po/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang khu/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar po/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser po/ thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa chags bral rab 'byung gi cha lugs can bzhugs tshul dang phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ / zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsungs/ bdag gi bla ma rje btsun gyi bka' las gzugs phung gi rnam snang sogs dang 'dra ba khro chags nyams can yin yang yin la bla ma gong mas de ltar zhal gzigs pa'ang yin gsungs/ 'dir rgyas par ma bris so/ /rgyud las sprul skur bshad pa ni dkyil 'khor lha sde tshan so sos sku bzhi mtshon pa'i nang tshan nas sprul sku mtshon byed ni skal bzang 'di rnams yin zhes pa'i don yin la/

spyir yang sprul skur bshad pas chags bral gyi rnam par sgrub nus pa ga la yin/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir/ pi waṃ ma la sogs pas rnal 'byor ma rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi rang ming dang mthun pa'i rol mo 'dzin pa dang*/ mkha' lding ma la sogs pa'i srog chags kyis mtshan can rnams/ zhal ras srog chags de dag mthun pa'i kha dog dang gdong brnyan du byed pa'i lugs gdam ngar bshad la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi ni/ sgom par nus na gtso bo ltar phyag mangs sam/ rdo rje phag mo ltar zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par yang rung zhing*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar nges so/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa'o/ / gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ ljang sngon/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la/ oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i 'og gi cha la/ zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma la/ rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i hūṃ yig go /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gnyis kyi bar du/ raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ oṃ ha baṃ hā bāṃ/ haṃ biṃ hāṃ biṃ/ hu buṃ hū būṃ/ he baṃ hai baiṃ/ ho boṃ hau bauṃ/ haṃ baṃ haḥbaḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā swāhā/ dkar po dang dmar po g.yon skor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar gnas pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang phag mo'i rang bzhin no/ /go cha'i sngags drug char la 'gor oṃ dang*/ mjug tu hūṃ bzhi phaṭa bzhi swāhā gnyis rnams gong bzhin sbyor dgos te/ mgo bo'i nang du nyi ma la/ na haṃ nā hāṃ/ ni hi nī hī/ nu hūṃ nū hūṃ/ ne heṃ nai haiṃ/ no hoṃ nau hauṃ/ na haṃ naḥhāṃḥ ser po dang sngon po rnam par snang mdzad dang gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug gi nang du nyi ma la/ swa hraṃ swā hraṃ/ swi hri swī hrīṃ/ swu hruṃ swū hrūṃ/ swe hreṃ swai hrā+aiṃ/

swo hroṃ swau hrauṃ/ swa hraṃ swaḥhraḥ hūṃhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swāhā swāhā/ dmar po dang dkar po pad+ma gar dbang dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ dpung pa gnyis kyi nang du nyi ma la/ oṃ ba hraṃ ba hrāṃ/ bi hriṃ bī hrīṃ/ bu hruṃ bū hrūṃ/ be hreṃ bai hraiṃ/ bo hroṃ bau hrauṃ/ ba hraṃ baḥhraḥ nag po dang ser po he ru ka dang bskyod byed ma'i ngo bo/ mig gnyis kyi dbus su nyi ma la/ ha haṃ hā hāṃ/ hi hiṃ hī hīṃ/ hu huṃ hū hūṃ/ he heṃ hai haiṃ/ ho hoṃ hau hauṃ/ haṃ haṃ haḥhaḥ dmar ser dang ljang khu rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ mdzod spu'i thad ka'i nang du/ pha pha/ phā phā/ phi phi/ phī phī/ phu phu/ phū phū/ phe phe/ phai phai/ pho pho/ phau phau/ phaṃ phaṃ/ phaḥphaḥ ljang khu dang dud kha rta mchog dang tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ /'a

di la'ang pha phaṃ phā phāṃ sogs dgos par mngon yang sngar gyi dpe thams cad la med par mthun pas re zhig bzhag go/ 'di rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad sngags kyi rdul phra rab kyis gang*/ sku'i phyi rol du snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su/ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yum gyi lte bar/ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo'o/ /de rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros te lus kyi phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/ 'dir yang spro na go cha'i lha rnams zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom ste/ lū yi pa'i lugs bzhin no/ / snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra wī nī/ sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dam ye bsre/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ gong bzhin rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la khrus byed 'gyur/ /lha yi chus ni dag par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sbyor mtshams nas byung nas/ bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyun gyis lha thams cad kyi spyi bor nas blugs shing dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag rdo rje bzhi mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/ spyi bo'i steng du gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la 'od dpag med dam he ru ka rdo rje'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ thugs 'khor ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ snying po'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ me'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ yon tan gyi 'khor lo pa dang*/ chu'i 'khor lo pa dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ sa'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ rlung gi 'khor lo pa dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo pa dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs bya/ yid sprul tsam la byin rlabs mi dgos te/ gang ltar yang gong tshogs gsog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ chu gnyis/ nyer spyod lnga/ rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ / zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ /bde chen sogs dang bzang po dang*/ /gnyis kun rnam par spangs pa dang*/ /mchod pa khams gsum bdag nyid ni/ /dngos po kun 'byung rnams kyis mchod/ / de nas bstod pa ni/ sngags 'phreng yongs rdzogs kyis byed pa'ang yod mod kyi/

de ltar dgos pa'i shes byed 'thad ldan mi snang bas/ bde mchog spyi dang mthun par yab yum gyi rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas spro na cang te'u sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i mthar/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis myangs la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ma lus pa 'dus nas/ myos byed dang sha'i bye brag sna tshogs pa dang*/ dam tshig gi rdzas thams cad kyis mchod de thams cad kyang rang gi snying gar thim/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po sgom par gyis/ rnal 'byor bcu gnyis bsod nams sdig med pa/ /thams cad zag med rang bzhin myong bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ngan pa de ni bde bar shes par byos/ /dbang po 'khrul pa bde ba chen por myong bar gyis/ /skad cig de la rang dang gzhan gyi ngo bo med/ /gang dang gang gi rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs can gyi/ /sa gsum gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'ja' tshon lta bu snang stong gnyis su med pa la mnyam par bzhag go / de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po'i tshul lam du byed pa/ kun tu spyod pa la 'jug pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes par mos shing*/ phag mo mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su song la/ mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo'i gnas su 'ongs te dga' ba rtsoms pa dang*/ de lā ma'i gnas su song zhing*/ /lā ma gtso mo'i gnas su 'ong ba sogs rnal 'byor ma bzhi lan cig 'khod pa ni/ longs spyod pa zhes bya/ lan gnyis pa 'khor ba thim pa/ gsum pa 'khor ba bdag po/ bzhi pa 'khor ba khyab bdag

/de bzhin du/ thig le'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma/ lnga tshan bzhi po rnams la'ang sbyar zhing*/ sgo ma bzhi tshan bzhi dang*/ mtshams ma bzhi tshan bzhi la'ang sbyar ro/ /de nas 'khor lo bcu gnyis la kun tu spyod pa ni/ bdag nyid 'dren pa'i he ru ka nag po phyag bcu gnyis par gyur pa ni/ 'dren pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rang nyid chung ngu'i he ru ka dmar ser du gyur la/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ snying po'i 'khor lo'i gnas su song zhing*/ snying po'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i gnas su 'ongs pas/ 'khor lo kun gyi nang du gnas par gyur pa na/ chung ngu'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gyur ro/ /rim pa de nyid nas brtsams te/ rang nyid sku'i he ru ka sngo dmar dkar ba'i mdog can/ gsung gi 'khor lo sku'i 'khor lo'i gnas su song*/ 'khor lo thams cad kyi nang du sku 'khor song bas sku'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /tshul de nyid lan bcu gcig tu bskor bas/ rdo rje 'khor lo nang du 'ong gi bar skor nas/ slar yang rang nyid mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /'dis ni me tog gang la lhung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa yang bstan pa yin zhing*/ de'i rjes lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi sne la dkyil 'khor lha'i 'khor lo spros pas don gnyis byas te/ slar bsdu ba yang yang sgom pa ni las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas/ snying ga'i sa bon dang phyag mtshan las 'od zer spro bsdu'i rim pas/ thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor/ de yang 'od zer gyi spro bsdus thig ler zhu ste rdo rje nor bur 'ongs pa phyag mtshan du gyur/ de'i lte bar dkyil 'khor sgoms pa'i gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gsal bar bsam/ de la sems brtan pa thob pa'i tshe/

phra mo'i sa bon de'i 'od zer gyis drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag sa bon de'i nang du bsdu ba yang yang bsgom pas rtags lnga mthar phyin par 'gyur bar bshad de/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la las rgyal mchog dang phra thig gi rnal 'byor de dag mngon rtogs kyi ngag 'don la nam du yang mi dgos shing*/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub mchog sgrub pa la spyir nges par dgos pa'i gal po che yin yang*/ las dang po pas de dag go yul tsam ma gtogs yongs rdzogs sgom par mi spyod cing yi ge mang par 'gyur ba'i phyir rgyas par ma smos so/ /de dag nang nas gtso bo yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi dga' bzhi'i don sgoms shing*/ dkyil 'khor spro bsdus mos pa tsam byed pa'i las rgyal mchog de tsam sgom dgos te/ gzhan du na mngon rtogs kyi yan lag chad par 'gyur bas so/ /de nyid la thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor yang tshang bar rgyud kyi mthar thugs 'ga' zhig las gsung shing*/ gong du smos pa'i phra thig de dag ni gsang 'dus kyi man ngag las blang ba yin pas skabs 'di'i dkyus la ma bsgoms kyang lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyis yan lag chad par ni mi 'gro bar mngon la/ gal te las dang po pas bsgom na/ snying ga dang gsang ba'i thig le tsam la sems gzung zhing*/ de'i nang gi dkyil gyi 'khor lo ni mos pa tsam gyis chog go /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags bzla bar bya ste/ yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po ni/ gong du dril bu lus dkyil gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar te/ lū dril sogs dang 'dra la/ yum gyi 'phreng ba'i sngags rtsa sngags su grags pa ni/ lū yi pa'i man ngag gi lag len dang mthun te rgyud rgyal 'dir sngags btu yang gsungs so/ /yab kyi 'phreng ba'i sngags rtsa sngags su grags pa ni/ oṃ na maḥshrī badz+ra ḍā ka mahā bī ra bī re shwa rā ya/ tri bhu baṃ kam+pā ba ṇā ya/

daṃṣ+tot+ka ṭa bhi ṣa ṇa bhai ra bā ya/ sha ta sa ha sra ne trā ya/ bing yu dz+dzi hwā ya/ kaṃ kā la mā lā bha ra ṇo3 grā ya/ ko ṭi lak+ṣa bhu dzā ya/ dz+rā lā wa lī ḍa lag+nā ya/ pa ra shu pa sho d+ya ta shū lā/ kalpān+ta dh+rū mru gra wa bū ṣā ya/ bi ka ṭa mu kha hā hā rā bā ya/ mā tṛ ga ṇa pa ri pū ri ta man+t+ra ya/ sa ha dza sun+da rī bal+la bha ka rā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ kā rots+tsa ra ṇa mu khā ya/ mahā sh+ma sha na pri yā ya/ sarba bhū ta saṃ trā sa na ka rā ya/ mahā kalpān+tāg+ni te dzā ya/ dza ṭā ka lā pa mu ku ṭā ya/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la shu la bhin+na dha ri ṇe/ mahā sa mu dra me kha lā ya/ byā gh+ra tsirmāṃ ba ra dhā ri ṇe/ be tā la saṃ ghamar+dha ṇa ka rā ya/ mahā bigh+na ni bā ri ṇe/ sha tru ni sum+bha na ka rā ya/ tri sa ha sra mahā si hasre ka ro mā ba l+yān+ta warti ṇe/ sha ta sa ha sra mu khā ya/ dz+nyā na sā ga ra pra bhā ya/ mahā bi shi ta ru dhi ra ba swāhā ri ṇe/ sarba mā ra ba la bi dh+wan+si ne/ shrīṣ+ti saṃ hā ra ka ra kā ya/ sarba nā gā nāṃ sho ṣa ṇa stam+bha na bi dra ba ṇā ya/ an+t+ra ma la dhā ri ṇe/ su me ru kam+pi ta na dā ya/ kro dha bi gra ha dhā ra ṇā ya/ mahā sha ti la kāt+ma ne/ bud+dha ko ṭi sa ha sra k+ṣa ṇā niṣ+pā da nā ya/ dz+nyā na mṛ ta bar+ṣa pa ṇā ya/ sarba karma pra warta nā ya/ ban+dha ka rā ya/ sarba bi kalpa bhañja na ka rā ya/ muṇ+ḍā ba lī lag+na sha rī rā ya/ pa ra kri ta yan+t+ra man+t+ra nā sha nā ya/ mahā rak+ṣa ka rā ya/ duṣ+tā naṃ bi dā la ne/ dharmo da ya ka rā ya/ kro dha s+phā ra s+phā ra ṇa ya/ in+t+ra dzā la sarba sa twāt+ma ne/ grasta bā pra bā da mahā ma te/ oṃ a ka ā kha i ga ī gha u da ū tsa ṛ tsha ṝ dza l̥ dzha l̥̄ nya e ṭa ai ṭha o ṭa au ḍha aṃ ṇa aḥta/ aḥtha aṃ da auṃ dha oṃ na/ aiṃ pa eṃ pha l̥̄ṃ ba l̥ṃ bh-iṃ rā ma ṛṃ ya ūṃ ra uṃ la īṃ wa iṃ sha aṃ ṣa āṃ sa aḥha āḥk+ṣa haḥ ka kā kha khā ga gā gha ghā nga ngā*/

tsa tsā tsha tshā dza dzā dzha dzhā nya nyā/ ṭa ṭā ṭha ṭhā ḍa ḍā ḍha ḍhā ṇa ṇā/ ta tā tha thā da dā dha dhā na nā/ pa pā pha phā ba bā bha bhā ma mā/ ya yā ra rā la lā wa wā/ sha shā ṣa ṣā sa sā ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣa/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ haṃ hāṃ saṃ sāṃ ṣa ṣāṃ shaṃ shāṃ waṃ wāṃ laṃ lāṃ raṃ rāṃ yaṃ yāṃ/ maṃ māṃ bhaṃ bhā+eṃ baṃ bāṃ phaṃ phāṃ paṃ pāṃ/ naṃ nāṃ dhaṃ dhāṃ daṃ dāṃ thaṃ thāṃ taṃ tāṃ/ ṇaṃ ṇāṃ ḍhaṃ ḍhāṃ ḍaṃ ḍāṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhāṃ ṭaṃ ṭāṃ/ nyaṃ nyāṃ dzhaṃ dzhāṃ dzaṃ dzāṃ tshaṃ tshāṃ tsaṃ tsāṃ/ ngaṃ ngāṃ ghaṃ ghāṃ gaṃ gāṃ khaṃ khāṃ kaṃ kāṃ/ ka tsa kha tsha ga dza gha dzha nga nya/ ka ṭa kha ṭha ga ḍa gha ḍha nga ṇa/ ka ta kha ta tha ga da gha dha nga na/ ka pa kha pha ga ba gha bha nga ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa aḥ.aṃ/ ka ha ka ha/ ka sa ka sa/ ka ṣa ka ṣa/ ka sha ka sha ka wa ka wa/ ka la ka la/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ya ka ya/ ka ma ka ma/ ka bha ka bha/ ka ba ka ba/ ka pha ka pha/ ka pa ka pa/ ka na ka na/ ka dha ka dha/ ka da ka da/ ka tha ka tha/ ka ta ka ta/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ka ḍha ka ḍha/ ka ḍa ka ḍa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka nya ka nya/ ka dzha ka dzha/ ka dza ka dza/ ka tsha ka tsha/ ka tsa ka tsa/ ka nga ka nga*/ ka gha ka gha/ ka ga ka gaka kha ka kha/ ku hu ku hu/ ku su ku su/ ku ṣu ku ṣu/ ku shu ku shu/ ku wu ku wu/ ku lu ku lu/ ku ru ku ru/ ku yu ku yu/ ku mu ku mu/ ku bhu ku bhu/ ku bu ku bu/ ku phu ku phu/ ku pu ku pu/ ku nu ku nu/ ku dhu ku dhu/ ku du ku du/ ku thu ku thu/ ku tu ku tu/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ ku ḍhu ku ḍhu/ ku ḍu ku ḍu/ ku ṭhu ku ṭhu/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ku nyu ku nyu/ ku dzhu ku dzhu/ ku dzu ku dzu/ ku tshu ku tshu/ ku tsu ku tsu/ ku du ku du/ ku ghu ku ghu/ ku gu ku gu/ ku khu ku khu/ ban+dhā ya ban+dhā ya/ ban+dha pā ya ban+dha pā ya/ gar+dz+dza gar+dz+dza*/ gar+dz+dza ya gar+dz+dza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ bi dh+waṃ sa ya bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kaṃ bā wa ya kaṃ bā wa ya/ du ra du ra/ khu ra khu ra/

bha ra bha ra/ dza ra dza ra/ bi sha bi sha /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhañja bhañja/ marda ya marda ya/ hreṃ hreṃ/ tsa la tsa la/ mā tsa la mā tsa la/ kru ra tsetā ya phaṭa/ sha twū ni bā ra ya hūṃ/ me gha ni wā ra ya hriṃ/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ dur+sas pa ya dur+sas pa ya/ ghuḍhān tra mā lā ba la bi ne/ khe tsa rā ya hūṃ/ bhu tsa rā ya āḥ pā tā la tsa rā ya oṃ/ dza la tsa rā ya baṃ/ s+tha la tsa rā ya laṃ/ sarba ta ni bā sa ni hūṃ/ nā gā nāṃ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta gṛh+ṇa radz+nyā gṛh+ṇa radz+nyāṃ/ dz+nyaṃ dz+nyaṃ/ dz+nyau dz+nyau/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ kha ra kha ra/ khu ru khu ru/ ga ra ga ra/ gu ru gu ru/ gha ra gha ra/ ghu ru ghu ru/ nga ra nga ra*/ ngu ru ngu ru/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsha ra tsha ra/ tshu ru tshu ru/ dza ra dza ra/ dzu ru dzu ru/ dzha ra dzha ra/ dzhu ru dzhu ru/ nya ra nya ra/ nyu ru nyu ru/ ṭa ra ṭa ra/ ṭu ru ṭu ru/ ṭha ra ṭha ra/ ṭhu ru ṭhu ru/ ḍa ra ḍa ra/ ḍu ru ḍu ru/ ḍha ra ḍha ra/ ḍhu ru ḍhu ru/ ṇa ra ṇa ra/ ṇu ru ṇu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu ru/ tha ra tha ra/ thu ru thu ru/ da ra da ra/ du ru du ru/ dha ra dha ra/ dhu ru dhu ru/ na ra na ra/ nu ru nu ru/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ru pu ru/ pha ra pha ra/ phu ru phu ru/ ba ra ba ra/ bu ru bu ru/ bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mu ru mu ru/ ya ra ya ra/ yu ru yu ru/ ra ra ra ra/ ru ru ru ru/ la ra la ra/ lu ru lu ru/ wa ra wa ra/ wu ru wu ru/ sha ra sha ra/ shu ru shu ru/ ṣa ra ṣa ra/ ṣu ru ṣu ru/ sa ra sa ra/ su ru su ru/ ha ra ha ra/ hu ru hu ru/ k+ṣa ra k+ṣa ra/ k+ṣu ru k+ṣu ru/ haṃ hāṃ/ hiṃ hīṃ/ huṃ hūṃ/ heṃ haiṃ/ hoṃ hauṃ/ haṃ haḥ gar+bha gar+bha/ dzā ti dzā ti/ de wā nāṃ/ dā ma ya dā ma ya/ sarba sha rī rā ya hūṃ/ dza ya dza ya hūṃ/ bi dza ya bi dza ya hūṃ/ sa ra sa ra hūṃ/ bi sa ra bi ra sa hūṃ/ ag+na ye hūṃ/ ba ru ṇe hūṃ/ a na lā ya hūṃ/ bā ya we hūṃ/ ā kā shā ya hūṃ/ sarba ro go ba ha rā ya hūṃ/

bi ṣabhak+ṣa ṇā ya hūṃ/ yan+t+rabā ha nā ya hūṃ/ kā lā gha ye hūṃ/ de bā ya hūṃ/ ya mā ya hūṃ/ ku be rā ya hūṃ/ de t+yā ye hūṃ/ in+d+rā ya hūṃ/ bhū tā ya hūṃ/ sarba sa twā ya hūṃ/ brta tsakrā ya hūṃ/ dharma dhā ta we hūṃ/ mu khā ya hūṃ/ ne trā ya hūṃ/ ka pā la mā li ne hūṃ/ bhu dzā ya hūṃ/ as+t+ra ya hūṃ/ tsa ra ṇā ya hūṃ/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭā ya/ ma sa ma sa/ ga sa ga sa/ ra sa ra sa/ bha ra bha ra/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ muñca muñca/ gho rān dha kā ra bri yā ya/ phiṃ phiṃ/ phu da phu da/ ma ra ma ra/ pa ra mār+tha rū pi ṇe/ shān+ti ka rā ya/ buṣ+ti ba ra ḍa nā ya/ lo ka pā la rū pi ṇe/ sarba sha rī ra rū pā ya/ bṛk+ṣa gul+mo la tā ya/ sap+pa rū pī ṇe/ sarba bstu ne mā ra ṇā ya/ rū pā ya/ bha k+ṣā ya/ bha k+ṣa ṇa rū pā ya/ ni ro pā mā ya/ ni ro pā ma mu kha be/ ha sa ha sa/ bi lā sa bi lā sa/ nṛ t+yā ba ya nṛ t+yā pa ya/ dwīn+d+ri ya yo gā ya/ niḥswa bhā wa ma hāt+ma ne/ shās+t+radhā ra ṇi wa ra ṇā ya/ nā nā bhi tsa rats+tshe da ne/ tsum+ba tsum+ba/ hu lu hu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ hūṃ ha hūṃ hā/ hūṃ hi hūṃ hī/ hūṃ hu hūṃ hu/ hūṃ he hūṃ hai/ hūṃ ho hūṃ hau/ hūṃ haṃ hūṃ haḥ huṃ hūṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ dzuṃ dzūṃ/ kroṃ krauṃ/ phiṃ phīṃ/ phuṃ phūṃ/ pheṃ phaiṃ/ phoṃ phauṃ/ phaṃ phāṃ/ phaḥphaḥ ku tsa ku tsa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ ma ḍa ma ḍa/ ra ṭha ra ṭha/ da ṭha da ṭha/ dza ṭha dza ṭha/ ma da na ma da na/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūphaṭa swāhā/

zhes pa yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyid dang*/ yum gyi rtsa ba'i sngags te/ bzlas bya'i gtso bo ni 'di gnyis yin la/ de tsam bzla ba mi lcogs na rtsa sngags gnyis po tshar gcig bton nas/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gang mos pa zhig bzla bar bya'o/ /'khor gyi sngags rnams ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs bzla mi dgos la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgos mod kyi gzhan du bri bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad dam mtshan brgya gang rung gis bstod/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi me'i rwa ba nas brtsams bdag nyid kyi bar du phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la thim/ rang nyid kyang snying ga'i hūṃ ljang sngon la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te nā da yang dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las bdag dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ bar 'dir gtor ma gtong bar bshad kyang*/ da lta lag len du mi bde bas mi mdzad la/ de nas dag pa dran pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /dkyil 'khor pa dang gtso bo'o/ /khrag 'thung gnyis med dngos po ru/ /'di gsum gyi ni khams gsum mo/ /thams cad thig le'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /bden pa gnyis su gzung ba med/ /yod pa gzugs med bdag nyid de/ /rtog pa tsam du khyab bdag che/ /sbyin pa kun rdzob gzugs bdag nyid/ /pha rol yang ni don dam pa'o/ /dang po'i sbyor ba de'i 'grub bo/ /tshul khrims bsnyen pa sogs su 'dod/ /phar phyin rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ / bzod pa tshangs par spyod pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'byin pa yang ni de/ /rgyal po bde ba kun la gnas/ /mchog ni rang gis pha rol phyin/ /brtson 'grus dga' chen thams cad las/ /mdog dang bzhugs tshul bdag nyid kyis/

/pha rol phyin rnams rang bzhin du/ /ye shes rnam par kun tu 'gyur/ /ye shes sems sogs bsam gtan te/ /phar phyin 'od zer spro ba'o/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur/ /shes rab las kyi rgyal po mchog /rang rang mgo bor rigs kyis ni/ /rgyas btab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /stobs ni snying rje'i dpa' bo ste/ /stong pa nyid ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pha rol phyin ma gnyis med kun/ /g.yon par zhugs skyes gang bde ba/ /thabs ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ /pha rol phyin pa theg pa che/ /smon lam sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs/ /phar phyin phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /phag mo dang ni bsres pa las/ /bsdu ba pha rol phyin pa ste/ /'jig rten khams kyi rnam dag pa'o/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das gzugs bdag /sgyu ma snying rje las byung ba'o/ /thams cad bden min brdzun min pa'o/ /skye min mi skye min spangs pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing don bsam par dza ya s+ya nā'i sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las bshad do/ /thun bzhi'am thun tha ma'i thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong zhing*/ gzhan yang bza' ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang nan tan du bya dgos te/ de dag gi rim pa ni spyi dang 'dra la/ dag dran gyi rjes su spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ gong du bshad pa bzhin lus kyi phyi'i go cha rnams bkod nas snang ba thams cad lhar mos bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga la/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni dril bu lus dkyil gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ rdzas rnams bskyed pa'i skabs/ shar du bi dkar po las dri chen bis mtshan pa/ byang du mu ljang khu las dri chu mus mtshan pa/ nub tu ma dmar po las sha chen mas mtshan pa/ lhor rwa ser po las rang byung ras mtshan pa/ dbus su a dkar po las byang sems as mtshan pa/ mer go dkar po las ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/

srin por ku sngon po las khyi sha kus mtshan pa/ rlung du da dmar po las glang po'i sha das mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du ha ljang khu las rta sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su na sngon po las sha chen nas mtshan pa/ zhes 'don pa spo ba ni dza ya s+ya na'i khyad par gyi 'dod pa yin zhing 'gal ba med la thog ma kha ṭ+waṃ ga bskyed nas de rjes rdzas bcu bzhu ba dza ya s+ya na'i gzhung la snang yang*/ tshad ldan rnams dang ni mthun par go rim 'khrugs pa dang yi ge gsum las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs spro bsdu byed pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs su bsams nas ched kyis bcos par snang yang*/ lha thams cad rdo rje gsum du 'du bas 'chos mi dgos shing*/ de skabs thun mong ma yin pas khyad chos de don la gnas na/ yi ge yang bcu gnyis dgos pa la yi ge gsum las mi snang ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /des na gtor ma byin rlabs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gzhan mi dgos so/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs shing gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam pa thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing*/ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi chos 'byung gi nang du/ pad+ma'i gdan la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang dag par bzhugs shing*/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa phyi rol tu 'khod par gyur/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs de rnams skad cig gi 'od gsal du bcug nas/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rig ma bcu drug lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma dbus su hūṃ/ nyi zla hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa rdo rje thal mor gyur/

oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmāḥpa ra spa ra/ a nu pra pṛṣ+ta sarba dharmaḥ.at+yan+ta a nu pra pṛṣ+ta sarba dharmāḥhūṃ/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ nas rgyur gyur cig mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ka ni sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ dri sh+ya hoḥ zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gi shwa re hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan lngas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la phul/ oṃ badz+ra tam+pu lā ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra was s+ya swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi dang na bza' phul/ gong bzhin zhabs bsil kyang phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa= zhes pa nas/ bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ / gyi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta/ pi sha tsa un ma da/ a pasma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ a thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+taṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi bṛd+dha/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ zhing skyong rnams la khyad par gyi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ kak+ka ḍha naṃ/ ba bān+dha naṃ/ khakh+kha da naṃ/ sarba duṣ+taṃ/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ma ma kar+yaṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ ha hoḥhrī swāhā/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dril bu rgyun dkrol du byed cing*/ 'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas gyis/

/a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ /sham bu sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol bar byos/ /a re gang gi don dam la ni ma bsgoms pas/ /de yi sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no/ /a re nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ de nas yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ mig gi phyag rgya bstan la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba lte bar 'khyud rgya byas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ dkyil 'khor pa bdag gi smin mtshams su thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis smon lam gdab par bshad pa ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma lhan cig tu byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang ma 'brel bar/ gtor ma rkyang pa la ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sems can thams cad nad med par/ sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yin/ /lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par bgyi/ / zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab cing*/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi nyams len gyi gtor chog ste/ bsdus pa yin zhing*/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma chen po dang*/ zhing skyong gi gtor ma rnams ni/ lha'i bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pas 'dir ma bris te gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ / 'di las dge ba gang thob pa/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang de ring phan chad du/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa nyid du shog / de la dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs shin tu mang po rnams phalacher tshig tshogs che ba lhur blangs pas/

phan thogs chung bar mthong zhing*/ tshigs bcad du sdebs pas sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'ga' zung yang snang mod kyi/ go dka' zhing ngag 'don dang sgom don gyi dbye ba phyed dka' ba dang*/ yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig la dgos pas don chad pa yang snang bas/ 'dir nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ zhes pa'i tshul du byas pa yin la/ 'di la rgyud 'grel gyi don lag len du sdebs pa'i gzhung ni/ bar skabs su byung ba'i bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya s+ya nas mdzad pa 'di rnams las gzhan med la/ 'di la'ang 'di nyid kyi rgyud chen po'i dgongs par ma song ngam snyams pa dang*/ bde mchog gi slob dpon tshad ldan rnams kyi bzhed dgongs dang mi mthun pa ci rigs yod par mngon mod/ re zhig dgongs 'grel rten so gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'dir phal cher dza ya s+ya na'i/ gzhung nyid gtso bor byas te bshad pa yin no/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs te bcu gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru/ na mo badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ baṃ yig bde chen rtag 'char ba'i/ /e yig stong chen klong yangs la/ /gus pas btud de de'i sgrub thabs/ /brtse bas man ngag ji bzhin bshad/ /'dir mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag gdong ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dang spyi ni 'dra'o/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥser po/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid phag mo phyag gnyis par gyur nas / rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ lha rnams kyi nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol bsrung 'khor sna tshogs rdo rje rwa ba dang*/ me ri'i phyi rol du dur khrod dang*/ de'i mtha' bskor gri gug dang*/ mi mgo dang lag pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba dang*/

bde chen 'khor lo la rin chen phreng ba/ sgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /de'i rjes su bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma zla ba dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a ā= nas zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de gnyis kyi bar du hrīḥlas rdo rje hrīḥyis mtshan pa= nas dbus su dpal rdo rje phag mo phag gdong mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ser la dmar ba'i mdangs/ /cung zad sbom thung cher khros shing*/ /'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad 'jigs su rung*/ /mi zad zhal ni sum cu drug /bzhi lhag bdun cu gnyis kyi phyag /zhabs ni bco brgyad g.yon bskum zhing*/ g.yas brkyang pa yi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /gcer bu ba spu'i 'phreng ba can/ /'dod chags chen po'i bde bas myong*/ /bha ga nu ma mtho zhing rgyas//rtsa ba'i zhal gyis g.yas g.yon du/ /rab 'jigs zhal ni dgu dgu'o/ /de steng bdun dang slar yang bdun/ /de steng du yang zhal gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni phag gdong 'jigs/ khyi dang ce spyang byi la stag /seng ge 'jigs byed < 'di 'brug 'dra ba zhig > glang chen rta/ /bong gdong g.yas la rim pas so/ /g.yon du ba glang ma he dang*/ /spyang ku rus sbal bu shin dang*/ /ri bong bse dang g.yag muñja/ /steng du sbrul dang sre mong dang*/ /rtsangs pa sram dang byi ba dom/ /dbus su mkha' lding gdong ste bdun/ /de steng bya rgod bya rog dang*/ /'ug pa bya dkar bong khra dang*/ /srin bya ngur pa'i gdong ste bdun/ /kun gyi steng ma'i dbus rma bya/ /g.yas g.yon phug ron khyim bya'i gdong*/ /thams cad spyan gsum ldan pa la/ /rang rang kha dog 'jigs pa che/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin/ /mi snang rang gi thabs dang sbyor/ /g.yas pa'i lhag ma rim pa bzhin/ /ral gri mdung ring tri shu la/ /dgra sta gri gug mda' gsal shing*/ /tho ba 'khor lo cang te'u dang*/ /chu gri dbyug gu mtshon rtse gcig

/dung dang zangs dung dbyug gu gsum/ /rma bya'i mjug ma bya rog sgro/ /ro skra'i pir dang me thab ri/ /dbyug to me long pi waṃ dang*/ /rkang lag glo ba rgyu ma dang*/ /sgra gcan lcags sgrog gdos dang skogs/ /nya rgya dang ni mgo med lus/ /'bar ba'i mar nag 'jigs byed gzugs/ /g.yon pa'i lhag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /phub zlum mche ba gtun shing zhags pa dang*/ /thod pa gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /po ti phub chung yu ba can/ /sdigs mdzub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang*/ /lug rgyud brag dang dur khrod rdul/ /mdung thung rnga dang pags rlon dang*/ /lan bu bsregs shing gang da'i dbyug /phub reng mgo bo keng rus dang*/ /zor ba mig dang mkhal ma bzhag /spen pa phur bu bi dza pur/ /sog le khab dang rlung bu bshus/ /char sprin shing sdong lcags kyu bsnams/ /tha ma glang chen pags rlon rgyangs/ /zhabs rnams brkyang bskum dor stabs kyis/ /g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang*/ /tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni/ /dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang*/ gnod sbyin ji ltar rim pas so/ /g.yon pas gshin rje 'dod lha dang*/ /zla ba chu lha nor rgyas dang*/ /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /smin drug bu dang 'khor bsgyur rnams/ /gnon zhing 'jigs par mdzad pa yin/ /zhal kun thod pa'i cod pan can/ /mgo bo'i 'phreng ba'i do shal byas/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rnam par brgyan/ /rkang gdub rdo rje 'phreng bas mdzes/ /dbu skra grol zhing me dpung 'bar/ /gar gyi nyams ldan sdang ba dang*/ /gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad ma'o/ /

skabs 'dir rgyud gsum pa'i 'gyur gyi dpe na/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dri shul chad/ /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan la spen pa yi ni phur bu dang zhes gcig tu byas pa shin tu nor/ ga da'i tsha ba brag ri dang*/ /gtun shing dod du tho ba dang*/ /lcags kyu'i gnas su ral gri byung ba rnams zlos pa ste rgya dpe ma dag pa'am/ 'gyur skyon no/ /yang 'di phyag bdun cu rtsa bzhir byed na tha ma gnyis spangs pa yin yang zhal gyi 'god tshul rim pa gsum du bsdu ba'ang cung zad mi legs yang glang lpags bor ba kho nas phyag don gnyis yin na/ g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan sum cu so bdun yod don med pas phyag don gnyis dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs 'dra bar rig go / 'dab ma rnams la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu sogs spyi dang mthun pa'am/ yang na/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba/ byang du lā ma g.yon ljang g.yas dmar ba/ nub tu dum skyes ma g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba/ lhor gzugs can ma g.yon ser g.yas nag pa/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la yar khan+ṭa ka pā la dang rab gtum mo/ /byang phyogs dza lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /dpa' po thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dpa' mo thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gtso mo dang mtshungs shing g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa ste shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo= nas byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba'i bar spyi dang mtshungs ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/

'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug po thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs shing*/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po= nas bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid gyis dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ zhes pa nas dag pa dran pa rdzogs kyi bar du 'dra ba las/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rdo rje phag mo'o/ / zhes 'don pa sgyur brgyud rim ni bde mchog drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang 'dra'o/ /skabs 'dir rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ci nus su sgoms la/ bzlas pa la mos na/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ snying po dang nye ba'i snying po nyid kyang ngo*/ /mdun du srin po dang bcas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bsgom ste/ oṃ phaṭa che ge bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa k+ṣa phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas drag shul bsgrub bo/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ gzhan rnams bde mchog drag po chen po'i mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i hūṃ zhes pa la/ snying ga'i hrīḥ zhes 'don pa spo/ gtor ma'i chog mdor bsdus pa'i tshe sdom 'byung dang 'dra ba las/ rgyas pa la spro na dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chen bya'o/ /ma rung 'joms shing sgrub po la/ /mtha' dag bde ba'i mchog ster bar/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di sgom pa las/ /lta stangs brgyad po 'grub ces thos/ /rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo'i sgrub thabs te bcu bzhi pa'o// //༈ oṃ swa sti/ he yig rol pa ru brjod bral/ /ka yi byed pa shrī yig ni/ /zung 'jug ye shes skur gyur pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/

/da ni rgyud rtsa bshad kyi khog sdebs pa man ngag gtso bor gyur pa gsum las/ dang po rtsa rgyud las dngos su mi gsal yang*/ bshad rgyud sna tshogs khog sdebs pas rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs par 'gyur ba/ grub pa'i slob dpon dril bu pas dbang po dman pa la dgongs te mdzad pa'o/ /'dir lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad zin pa las 'don pa spos te/ dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga sgom par 'dod na/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas yan chad 'dra/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a ā= nas ha k+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las= nas/ dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a dar+ṣe hūṃ/ bī ni= gan+dhe= rā se= spar+ṣe= oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhi bdud rtsi mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ma hā su khaṃ nas/ 'jig byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad gyi phyogs bzhir mi ro'i snying gar zla ba/ mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum thod/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i mu khyud la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol= zhes pa nas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing kha/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba zhal rnam par 'gyur ba spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa 'dzin zhing rlung gis 'phyar ba/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/

lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma la hūṃ/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying gar oṃ/ ha dkar po= nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ kha cig gtso 'khor rnams g.yas brkyang ba'i brkyang bskum stabs su 'dod pa ni mun sprul lo/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/

la ma'o/ / chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dran sogs byang chub yan lag drug phag mo'o/ /yang dag spong ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang dad sogs bcu 'phags lam rnams ni bum pa bzhi'o/ / thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo= zhes pa nas/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ lha mo bzhi la ni rim pas/ rtag pa/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar lha mo drug dang*/ mahā su khaṃ gyi bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā nas/ ha ho hriḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu lwa ba 'bar 'dzin dang*/ /spyod pa ba dang dge ba'i mgon/ /ti li na ro phaṃ thing pa/ / bha dan+ta pa mar do dang*/ /bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lho tshad dbang phyug brtson 'grus dang*/ /'phags pa lo mchog grags chen pa/ /'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /nor bzang ka bzhi rin rgyal dang*/ /mkhyen rab chos rje lha bo pa/ /mkhas pa kun dga' don grub dang*/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor byang gling pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang pu rangs lo chung nas brgyud pa ltar na/ bha dan+ta pa lo chung dang*/ /sa chen bsod rtse grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa pan bo dong rin po che/ /sems dpa' che dang yang rtse ba/ /bu ston rje dang khyung lhas pa/ /man chad gong bzhin/ rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lha rnams mchod/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i bar du sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dra ba las/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/

rang gi snying ga'i zhes sogs dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ lā ba bcu gsum ma bzhin du bya'o/ /dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs 'grel du/ lwa ba'i zhabs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bus mdzad par grags te/ yan lag phra mo 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ cho ga'i sgros gcig pa yin pas/ 'dir yang bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la 'don pa spos pas/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dag cing gtsang bar 'byung ngo*/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyi bskyed pa'i gzhung*/ mkhas pa kun la cher grags kyang*/ /gzhan 'gas ming yang ma thos pa/ /de don rtogs par bsla phyir sbyar/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrubs thabs ste bco lnga pa'o// //༈ gdul dka' 'dul ba gang gis mtshan tsam zhig/dran pa'i mod la phun tshogs kun thob pa/ /rdo rje khro rgyal tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /bdud bzhi g.yul ngo ma lus bzlog par mdzod/ /'dir 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rim pas/ khro bo rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na/ thog mar dpal 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi mngon rtogs legs par byang bar bslab bo/ /de nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di dag bslabs pas tshegs med par shes par 'gyur ro/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ dag pa gsum/ tshogs bsag phung khams byin rlabs/ srung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ ye shes tshogs bsag bar srid sbyong byed/ 'byung bzhi ri rab/ gzhi dkyil gyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa'i bar du sgom tshul rnams 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi skabs bzhin no/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhal yas khang gzhi dkyil gyi dbus su/ slar yang gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bral ba/ lhag ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ grwa bzhir thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa 'khor lo'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/

pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la/ pad+ma dang nyi ma/ sgo bzhir mi ro'i gdan/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i lha snam la mi ro'i gdan phyogs bzhir bzhi bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir re re/ sgo mtshams brgyad du yang ro gdan re re'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyis bar du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ thod pa'i cod pan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis nam mkha'i nā da yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul gyis yum gyi mkha' nang du son pas/ yab yum byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ thig le las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ ho srid pa gsum gyi bde snyed gtso/ /a la la la ho/ rgyal po'i bde chen dgyes pa'i tshogs/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje rol/ /a la la la ho/ phyogs bcu bde gshegs snying po spros/ /kun gyi snying po bdag por mdzad/ /srid pa gsum po'i snying po ni/ /bde ba chen po rtogs par mdzod/ /a la la la ho/ bdag po dgyes pa grol bar mdzod/ bde chen a la la la ho/ /zhes bskul/ lha mo rnams thig le la thim/ de nyid hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las yongs su gyur pa ni/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha/ nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/

phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcag kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /oṃ bha dharma dhā tu swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bsnyen pa'o/ /snying gar oṃ ha= sogs go cha gnyis dgod de/ nyer bsgrub bo/ /de nas gnas gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs pa dang ye shes dgug gzhug sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab bsgrub chen rnams bde chen rnams bde mchog gzhan gyi cho ga bzhin du bya ste/ dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i he ru ka/ zhes mtshan brje ba tsam khyad par ro/ /yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon mo/ lte bar swa ser po/ gsang bar a dmar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ shes rab kyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ thabs kyi gsang ba hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse gcig pa/ gnyis po'i bu gar byāṃ dang d+yāṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras bcas dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i thig ler gyur/ de rnams hūṃ bcu gcig /maṃ taṃ baṃ laṃ/ oṃ swā āḥhā/ phuṃ phraiṃ phroṃ phriṃ/ he nyi shu rtsa bzhi dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho rnams su gyur/ de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur/ oṃ sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ bdud bzhi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad bcom/ sems can thams cad rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim pas/ rang dpal bde mchog khro bo rdo rje sems dpa' khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i skur gyur pa ni/

rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa/ g.yas zhal gsum dkar sngo ser ba/ g.yon zhal gsum sngo dkar ser ba/ steng gis zhal dmar po/ phyag bcu drug gis dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing thugs kar 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa/ lhag ma g.yas pas thod pa ral gri/ 'khor lo tho ba/ cang te'u rnams dang*/ g.yon rnams kyis kha ṭ+waṃ ga lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rin po che/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo lhan cig tu 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis/ mi'i pags pa dang glang po che'i pags pa lhan cig tu sbyar ba stod g.yogs su bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan zhing*/ yum rdo rje phag mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhal gsum phyag drug pa snga ma lta bus 'khyud pa'o/ /hūṃ

lan bcu/ mkha' nang gi khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bcom/ stobs bcu dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la bkod/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la 'khod pa ni/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po che nag po nag ser ljang ba/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum ka mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyis cang te'u dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og nag po nag ser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong bcu gnon zhing*/ rtsa phyag gnyis rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing mi bzad pa'i gad rgyang drag po sgrog pa/ cher khros shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ oṃ swā āḥhā/ mkha' nang gi rnal 'byor ma brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ 'byung ba bzhi dang chu bo bzhi sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi dang rnam thar bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te nang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'khod pa ni/

shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mer sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar sngo/ bden bral du rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser ljang*/ rlung du pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser/ dbang ldan du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma khra mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi gri gug dang thod pa/ ḍa ma ru kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ cher khros pa'o/ /phuṃ phreṃ phroṃ phriṃ/ nang gi sgo ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma rgyal dbang ma dkar mo lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu 'jigs byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lho ru g.yon ldan ma sngon mo gtun shing dang sdigs mdzub can/ thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar po sil bur grol ba'o/ /he/ lan nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod/ mkha' 'gro ma nyer bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ shes pa bcu dang rnam thar brgyad dang*/ mngon shes drug la bkod/ slar 'dus te/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam rim pa gnyis la 'khod/ de yang shar du/ rta gdong ma dang drag mo'i gdong*/ /rdo rje sna ma snyan grags ma/ byang du/ /zla ba'i spyi gtsug ma de bzhin/ khro gnyer can ma sna tshogs gzugs/ /rdo rje ka ta'i bu mo'o/ /nub tu/ ro langs ma dang rdo rje zla/ dri ldan ma dang 'jigs byed zhal/ lho ru/ rdo rje pho nya rdo rje sen/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma de bzhin/ rdo rje kam+po dza rnams so/ /mtshams rnams la me nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyi/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dang*/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul drag byed ma/ /rdo rje me ltar 'bar ma'o/ /phyi'i grwa bzhi la/ sna tshogs gzugs can gzugs bzang ma/ /rdo rje mchu dang 'od byed ma'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnal 'byor ma lhag ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/

mi 'jigs pa bzhi la bkod/ phyi'i sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar nas brtsams te/ g.yon bskor gyis rdo rje ser skya ma dang ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ma rdo rje 'khyil/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ma rnams so/ /de la shar phyogs pa rnams dkar ba/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang ba/ nub phyogs pa rnams dang dmar ba/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser ba/ mtshams ma rnams phyed kyi dbang phyugs ma ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol ba/ zhags pa dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i zhal gsum pa/ gcer bu rus pa dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ drag mo chen mo dbu skra gyen du 'bar ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes kyi lha de rnams grub pa na/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ ma mo brgyad dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa rdo rje'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po tshogs mtha' dag kyang 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī= sogs/ skad cig rnam pa'i sngags brjod pa nas/ dbang bskur ba'am mthar thug pa 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa re res dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ 'di skabs brgyud pa ni drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang 'dra'o/ / a nu rā ga sa gsang mchod/ he ru ka yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa rnams phul/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ sngags bzla bar bya ste/ de la gtso bo'i sngags ni/ oṃ sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang*/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa yang bzla bar bya ba yin la/ snying po ni/ oṃ kha badz+ra dh+rika badz+ra hūṃ ka rā badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pa'o/ /khro bo bcu la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mar oṃ badz+ra zhes pa dang*/ mthar badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces pa khro bo bcu kun la sbyar/ dz+wa la a na lārka/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ kuṇ+ḍa li/ yak+ṣa/ kā lī/ mahā bā la/ bhi ṣa ṇa/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakrā warti rnams dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā tā la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar ro/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la/ oṃ shrī ḍā ki ni ḍaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lā me laṃ/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he khaṃ/ ru bi ni rū/ zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin/ oṃ shrī bud+dha ḍā ki nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de ltar sbyar te/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ bi shwā ḍā ki nī/ zhes so/ /mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi/ thog ma nyer bzhi la/ mtshan sngags kyi dang po oṃ dang*/ mthar mar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba kho na dang*/ tha ma bzhi po la mtshan gyi mthar sa bon yang sbyar ro/ /de yang*/ oṃ wa ḍa wa mu khī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ gho ri mu khi/ badz+ra gh+ra ṇi/ ya shi swi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa shi kha re/ bhṛ ku ṭi/ bi shwarū pe/ badz+ra ka t+yā ya nī/ badz+ra bai tā li/ badz+ra sa yi ki badz+ra ghan+dha li/ badz+ra bhi ma lā da ni/ badz+ra dhū ti/ badz+ra na kī badz+ra kau ma rī/ kam+po dzī/ bā hu/ rū pe/ su dū pe/ badz+ra tun+di/ pra bha ka ri zhes so/ / oṃ shrī badz+ra piṃ ka le dzaḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍi baṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra we hoḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rnams so/ /thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang*/ [ dkyil 'khor bya ba dang*/ ] dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu sogs spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni 'khrul spong gi sgrub thabs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar las/ ye shes kyi lha la 'bul ba'i spyi sngags song ba'i rjes su lha so so'i snying po'i hūṃ phaṭa gyi gong du/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sarba sid+dha pra yats+tshan+tu zhes pa bcug nas/

so sor 'bul bar bya ste/ oṃ kha badz+ra dhi ka badz+ra hūṃ ka ra badz+ra i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sarba sid+dhi meṃ pra yats+tshan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /rgyas par byed na 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la'ang*/ de bzhin du sbyor ba las/ sarba sid+dhi sogs kyi dod du/ ma mā shan+teṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa lta bu rang 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa'i las sngags sbyar ro/ /'dod don gsol ba'i gzhug tu/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blang bar bya ste/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ / bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pas brten par bya'o/ /bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad ma'i bde/ /a la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a īḥ.a āḥr li ho/ rab dgyes mgon po'i rab bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ / dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /'phrin las thams cad ston par mdzod/ / ces so/ /'di la dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang la lha gong bzhin 'god pa dang*/ khro bo bcu gcig kho na'i dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na'ang*/ de dang de'i 'dor len shes par bya'o/ /'di ni mngon brjod bla ma'i le'u yar mar gyi khog don sdebs pa bla ma'i man ngag go /rab zab sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/

/drag shul sgrub la mchog tu bsngags/ /rgyud don shes pa rnams la ni/ /dga' bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas byed yin/ /dpal bde mchog khro bo rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs te bcu drug pa'o// //༈ bde chen rdo rje phag mo ni/ /spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /srid gsum sgyu ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /de la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /'dir grub pa'i slob dpon bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'am/ zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brang nas/ rdo rje btsun mo'i sgrub thabs sgom par 'dod pas/ spro na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang*/ lag mchod dang gtor ma rnams sngon du 'gro bar byas te/ rnal 'byor gyi bya ba la 'jug pa yin la/ de tsam ma lcogs na nang mchod byin gyis rlabs te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya waka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ṇa badz+ra ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis me tog phul la/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ rab tu grub par mdzod/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig hoḥ me tog 'bul ba'i gzungs kyis me tog phul kyang rung ngo*/ /chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+ri ka hūṃ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bla ma la nang mchod phul/ lha so so'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor pa la nang mchod phul/ cang ta'u la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas te/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags dang*/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams zhes sogs kyis sdom pa bzung*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes mi dmigs par bsam mo/ /de dag ni bsod nams tshogs kyi rim pa'o/

/de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ / gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ / zhes sogs phung khams kyi lha bcu bdun mos pa tsam mam/ dngos su sgom pa ni bdag bsrung bya'o/ / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra bha bā= nas/ a na lārka hūṃ/ gi bar sngags tshan drug brjod/ de'i nang du bh+ruṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser bo rtsibs bcu pa/ der hūṃ gi sa bon 'ba' zhig las byung ba'i lha rnams te/ 'khor lo'i lte bar khro bo chen po 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ zhal bzhi nag ljang dmar ser ba/ phyag dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje phag mo phyag gnyis ma la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang gtun shing*/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis kyis dgra s+t+wa dang rtse gsum/ drug pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su 'phyar pa dang lhan cig thod khrag dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ rtsibs bcu la shar du khwa gdong ma la gshin rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ byang du 'ug gdong ma la bgegs mthar byed ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ nub tu khyi gdong ma la pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ lho ru phag gdong ma la shes rab mthar byed ser po be con 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ lhor gshin rje brtan ma la 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ bden bral du gshin rje pho nya mo dbyug sngon can nag po dbyug pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams su gshin rje mche ba ma la stobs po che dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/

byang shar du/ gshin rje 'joms ma la mi g.yo ba sngo sangs ral gri 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ steng du mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ 'og tu sa spyod ma kha dog sna tshogs pa la gnod 'dzes rgyal po nag po gtun shing 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ khro bo thams cad phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i sbrul zhag can/ 'khor rnams shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu rgyan can no/ / phyir bzlog byed na bar 'dir mngon brjod las byung ba'i uṣ+ṇi ṣa bzla zhing*/ phyir bzlog gi dmigs pa dgos pa yin no/ /de nas sum+bha lan gnyis brjod pas/ dur khrod ma brgyad kyis thugs ka nas dur khrod ma brgyad dmar mo/ tho ba phur bu lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa spro ba/ yang sum+bhas/ bka' bsgos pa na bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūṃ las byung ba'i 'brub khang bcu'i nang du rdo rje mo'i sa gzhi la bzhag /oṃ gha gha

sogs/ phur bus btab/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogasakyis/ tho bas brdung te/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ pho nya mo rnams slar bsdu/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis brtan par byas te/ gnas srung ba'o/ /de ltar bsrung ba gsum ni tshul khrims kyi tshogs so/ / oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥnī bhi sang ska ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing sngags don bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs gsag pa'o/ /de dag gis sngon 'gro rdzogs so// // snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang rdo rje phag mor gsal ba la thim/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang nyid oṃ la thim de āḥl= de hūṃ la= de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus/ nā da yang mi dmigs par bsam mo/ / de ni 'chi bdag byed do/ / stong pa'i ngang las nā da ho gnyis kyi mtha' brten par nam mkhar gnas/ de ni bar do dag byed do/ /skad cig gis 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su sku'i 'khor lo ni dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi khor yug go /de'i nang du pad+ma'i nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa'i gzhi la gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dkar/ lho ser ba ni gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /dbus kyi gzhi dmar po la/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i mu khyud zlum po'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa ni/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i gdan/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje'i gdan/

sgo mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i gdan/ dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo dkar po dang ro'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du nam mkha'i nā da ho gnyis dang bcas pa zhugs/ de nyid baṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha hūṃ brgyad dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thams cad zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo drag mo chen mo nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid 'bar ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po'am gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ phrag pa g.yon gyi phyogs su nye bar brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin can 'chang ba/ drag mo chen mo mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba la me tog sil mas mdzes pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ mi snang ba'i thabs dang gnyis su med par 'dus shing*/ ma lus pa'i sprul pa spro ba dang bsdud ba'i lus can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i byang shar gyi grwar mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ nub byang gi grwar lā ma ljang khu/ lho nub kyi grwar dum skyes ma dkar mo/ shar lho'i grwar gzugs can ma ser mo rnams g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ zur gsum du dga' ba 'khyil ba gsum dang*/ gru chad gsum la bum pa rnams gnas par gyur/ shar sgor gau rī ser mo/ byang sgor tsau rī dmar mo/

nub sgor phra mo ha sngon mo/ lhor sgor ro lang ma dkar mo/ shar lho'i grwar puk+ka si khra mo/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa li ljang khu/ nub byang du ghasma ri dud kha/ byang shar du he ru ka'i 'od ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang g.yas kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi gdan rnams la/ shar du khwa gdong ma/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub tu khyi gdong ma/ lhor phag gdong ma rnams g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu shin rje pho nya mo/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams g.yas gri gugadang*/ g.yon mi'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ brgyad po thams cad sku mdog ljang khu'o/ /'khor rnams bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa las zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs can no/ / 'dir lha'i rnam pa gdam nga ni/ gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dmar ljang nag ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag mtshan gzhan rnams lū dril gyis he ru ka dang 'dra ba la/ glang lpags kyi dod bdud kyi pags pa 'dzin pa/ he ru ka nag po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ glang lpags kyi dod du 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pas 'khyud pa'o/ /yang na gtso mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar ba/ zhabs g.yas brgyang gi gar stabs kyi 'jigs dus brtsegs pa mnan pa/ zhal g.yas gnyis sngon po dang ser po/ g.yon gnyis dkar po dang ljang khu ste zhal phag gdong dmar po/ phyag dang po gnyis rdor dril pad+ma'i skor bas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dbu thog tu 'jog pa/ gsum pas mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ bzhi pas ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lnga pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang thod khrag go /yang phyag mtshan de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ sku mdog phyed gzugs g.yon dkar g.yas dmar ba/ zhal bzhi/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa/

g.yon ljang*/ rgyab ser/ g.yas sngo ba'o/ /gtso mo zhal drug pa'i skabs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi yang*/ glang po la sogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bya la/ gtso mo phyed gzugs su byed pa'i tshe/ de dag kyang phyed gzugs su bya zhing*/ gtso mo phyag mang gi lugs gsum po 'di la sku la phyag drug gis brgyan pa dang*/ gau rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad kyang mngon brjod bla ma nas 'byung ba bzhin zhal gsum phyag drug par mdzad de rgya gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni skye ba'i srid pa las lus dag byed do/ / rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba la baṃ yig dmar po dag go /dam tshig sems dpa' phyag mang sgoms kyang*/ ye shes pa phyag gnyis par nges so/ /de nas lus dkyil skad cig gis gsal 'debs te/ lte bar gzugs can ma dang dga' 'khyil gcig lhag ma 'khor lo gsum la/ bum pa gsum dang rnal 'byor ma gsum/ gtsug tor tu he ru ka gsang ba'i 'khor lo phyi ma gnyis la dga' 'khyil gnyis/ ze'u 'bru'i 'khor lo la rdo rje phag mo/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la gau rī la sogs pa lha mo brgyad/ bu ga brgyad la khwa gdong ma la sogs pa brgyad/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ bde mchog gi lus dkyil spyi dang mthun par 'god pa las/ 'dir shes rab ma rnams gtso bor gyur pa yin zhing*/ sku mdog kyang*/ thugs kyi rnal 'byor ma dkar mo la dpa' bo nag po'i 'khyud pa/ gsung gi sngon mo la dmar pos 'khyud pa dang sku'i dmar mo la ser skyas 'khyud pa/ phyag mtshan nag po dang 'dra ste lus dkyil rgyas pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha bzhi bcu zhe brgyad sgom pa ni 'bring po yin la/ rtsa 'khor lo brgyad kyi lte ba'i lha tsam 'god pa ni bsdus pa yin zhing*/ dang por snying gar he ru ka dang lte bar rdo rje phag mo bsgoms te/
