slar lte bar zhal sbyor du bsam pa ni shin tu bsdus pa'o/ / de dag ni ngag dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa dang skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ go cha dgod pa dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams phag mo lha so bdun ma'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ phyi dkyil 'khor la gtso mo la rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo mo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ lus dkyil la ni rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mi dgos so/ /de dag ni yid dag par byed pa'o/ /bar 'dir dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa cung zad bsgom ste ye shes dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ nang mchod la bod lugs ltar brgyud pa'i mtshan brjod 'dod na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob ye shes bshes gnyen grub chen zhi ba sbas pa/ slob dpon go pi pa/ slob dpon ni rbā ṇa shrī rnams so/ /de dag ni dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ man ngag spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ bzla bya'i sngags kyis gtso bo ni rkang brgyad sngon du 'gro ba'i rtsa sngags nyid yin/ snying po ni yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /nye ba'i snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra bā ra hi/ a ā/ i ī/ a ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /'khor gyi sngags ni so so'i mtshan sngags dang sgo mtshams brgyad la/ kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i 'phreng sngags bzla bar bshad cing*/ phyir bzlog ma'i tshe sgrub kyi sngags dang*/ ye shes 'bebs pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'bebs pa'i sngags kyang bzla ste gzhung du blta'o/ /bzlas pa'i rjes su gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom zhing*/ de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ thun mtshams la 'jug tshul ni/ spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ gtor ma'i cho ga yang 'khrul spong gis skabs su bshad pa bzhin 'don pa spos pa ste/

cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ 'jig rten 'das gtor skabs lha so so'i snying po'i sngags la/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ sā dha ya zhes pa spel nas 'bul lo/ /'di ni phag mo'i rtog pa nyung ngu gcig dang*/ rtsa bshad kyi khog sdebs nas grub chen zhi bas mdzad pa'i man ngag go /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /spyaud dang grol ba'i 'bras rtsol ba/ /shin tu rnyed dka' tshegs med pa/ /lag tu 'ong ba'ang skal pa bzang*/ /rdo rje phag mo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //༈ oṃ na mo badz+ra sa twa ya/ dpal ldan lhan skyes bde ba yis/ /'od kyis zhing kun rab bkang nas/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ni/ kha spyor thig le las gsungs bzhin/ /'dus gsal go bder brjod bgyi bas/ /'di las dge mtshan ci yang spel/ /da ni 'dir dpal kha sbyor thig le'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bde mchog zhi ba rdor sems sam/ rdo rje dbyings sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du btang*/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs/ spro na gtor chog gis gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma lcogs na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dran par byas la/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems par gyur/ snying gar a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ wī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sogs brjod/ gang gi drin gyis= sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang sogs sh+loka gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal/ bdag nyid kyi sdig pa thams cad 'chags shing slar mi bgyid

do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa dang*/ so so skye bo thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bdag nyid dang 'gro ba'i dge ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ched du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi bar du sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i chos dkon mchog dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o/ /e ma ma la bdag bla na med pa yang dag par byang chub par bgyi'o/ /de'i lam sgrub pas bde ba chen po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba/ nam mkha' ji srid bar rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ba de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig pa la sems can rnams 'god par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa'i bar rnams lan gsum brjod/ rang gi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūṃ la thim/ hūṃ nā da'i bar du bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal du thim/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rnam pa nam mkhar bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma la gnas shing raṃ las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ bar 'dir sgom par spro zhing nus na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor rgyas pa bsgom par bya ste/ de'i dbus su pad nyi la bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ lte bar bdag nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' shes rab dang bcas par gyur/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa khro bo bcus bskor ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/

zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas mtsho skyes su byon pa/ hūṃ zhes mi bskyod pa spros nas rang la thim/ rang nyid khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ mdzad du gyur pa ni/ gong du lan gnyis bshad pa ltar ro/ / hūṃ/ lan bcu/ khro bo bcu po pad+ma nas spros rtsibs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum lcags kyu 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon zhags pa dril bu dgra sta'o/ / lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas zhags pa rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum zhags pa dril bu dgra sta'o/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum lcags sgrog pad+ma ral gri/ g.yon gsum dril bu dgra sta zhags pa/ byang du bgegs dgra sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum dril bu sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum zhags pa gtun shing dgra sta/ byang shar du gtum po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon gsum sdigs 'dzub sta re zhags pa'o/ /shar lhor 'dod rgyal nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rang gi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas lcags kyu ral gri/ g.yon rdo rje zhags pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum zhags pa pad+ma dgra sta/ nub byang du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal g.yas gsum rtse gsum ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum zhags pa pad+ma dgra sta/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo can ser po ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs 'dzub ral gri/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon gsum zhags pa pad+ma ral gri/ thams cad rang 'dra'i yum dang sbyor ba phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/
khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /

de rjes phur gdab bya ste man ngag snye mar gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bsdu na/ bdag nyid khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal du gyur/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyi pho nya spro/ bgegs rnams la phur bas btab par bsam te/ oṃ gha gha= sogs/ oṃ badz+ra mud+ga ra= sogs lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis chog go / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du hūṃ suṃ hūṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'o/ /khro bo chen po'i gzugs yongs su gyur pa las de'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa'i chos 'byung gi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ de'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad de zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phub can/ nang gi lha snam gru bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ de'i nang du zlum skor 'khor los mtshan pa nang du lha mo'i gnas kyi sa gzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i yang nang du zlum skor pad+mas mtshan pa nang du ma mo'i sa gzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i nang du 'od kyi 'phreng ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gdung zlum po nang le tshe dgur gyur pa/ de'i dbus kyi gzhi sngon po/ lhag ma sa gzhi thams cad phyogs kyi mdog can no/

/lha snam gyi phyogs rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma la zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan so so dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ de'i phyi rol pad 'dab kyi khor yug gi phyi rol du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /'di zhi ba gtso che ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pas/ dur khrod ma sgoms kyang rung la/ rdo rje drag mo la sogs pa ma mo 'dus pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir sgoms kyang mi 'gal lo/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa khyab cing byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ger gyur pa khang brtsegs kyi nang na gnas pa'i nā da la yongs su bcug cing*/ slar yang dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ a ā nas aṃ aḥphrag gnyis rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba dkar po/ oṃ tsi ta pra ti bai dhaṃ ka ro mi/ ka kha= nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha phrag gnyis rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dmar po/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa dā ya mi/ de'i dbus su bar srid nā da yongs su zhugs te nā da las thig le dang*/ zla phyed dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ ha dang*/ ū'i rim pas rdzogs pa'i hūṃ las rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra at+ma ko3 haṃ/ de las spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'gro ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs su byas/ de thams cad tshur 'dus te thim/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra sa twa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes nang gi sgras yongs su bskul/ de las bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi gzugs su gyur/ oṃ ya thā sarba thā ga ta ta thā a haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas lnga'i cod paṇa can 'dzum zhing sgeg pa/ dkar la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/

spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ pad+ma thod pa zla ba rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba dang dar gyi na bza' can gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje phag mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin mas 'khyud pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum phyag gnyis pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rin po che'i rgyan can/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po/ bar 'dir sems can rnams la snying rje'i dbang bskur ba byed na/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs nas bshad pa bzhin du bya la mdor bsdus pa'i tshe ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /mig tu oṃ dzaḥlas gti mug rdo rje dang gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar hūṃ hūṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje dang sgra rdo rje ma/ sna bug tu traṃ baṃ las ser sna rdo rje dang dri rdo rje ma/ lcer āḥho las 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ dpral par haṃ khaṃ las phrag dog rdo rje dang reg bya rdo rje ma/ snying gar hūṃ raṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rnams dang*/ mgo bo maiṃ las byams pa/ dbang shes kyi gnas thams cad du maṃ las 'jam dpal/ de gnyis dpa' bo kho na'o/ /lte bar spyan ma dang rnam snang*/ snying gar mā ma kī dang mi bskyod pa/ mgrin par gos dkar mo dang 'od dpag med/ spyi bor sgrol ma dang don yod grub pa/

gsang bar pad+ma drwa ba ma dang rdo rje sems dpa'/ spyi bor sku rdo rje/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje rnams su gyur/ lha de rnams rang gi phung khams skye mched dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyugaphrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po las he ru ka mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ hoḥdamar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu las rta mchog gi ngo bo lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo las gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral par hreṃ hriṃ ser mo las bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsaṇ+ḍi ka /yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ thugs kar hūṃ nag po/ lte bar swa ser po/ gsang bar āḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis sku gang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu hūṃ dang oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' hriḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru hrīḥdang bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ta ga a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyi bor bzhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba shes rab kyi mkha' nang du byin te yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ hrī khaṃ/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ hriḥtaṃ/ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ aṃ āḥ laṃ ṝṃ laṃ dzhaṃ/ l̥ṃ ghaṃ baṃ lī dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams las mi bskyod pa sku mdog nag po rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun du gyur/

hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ hrī khaṃ/ mkha' nang gi rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dug lnga rnam par sbyong*/ ye shes lnga la bkod/ slar 'dus te mi bskyod pa rang nyid la thim zhing*/ rigs lhag ma bzhi phyogs bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar du rnam snang dkar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po phyag g.yas gnyis kyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis na mda' dang pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhugs pa 'dzin pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /bh+ruṃ hūṃ hrīḥtaṃ/ yum bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te nang gi grwa bzhir 'khod pa ni/ byang shar du spyan ma dkar mo phyag g.yas bzhis 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri mda'/ g.yon bzhis thod pa dril bu zhags pa gzhu/ shar lhor mā ma kī sngon mo phyag g.yas drug mda' ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma/ g.yon drug gis gzhu lcags kyu dril bu zhags pa thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lho nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo phyag g.yas bzhis mda' pad+ma rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon bzhis gzhu thod pa zhags pa dril bu/ nub byang du sgrol ma ljang khu phyag g.yas bzhis ut+mal dmar po ral gri lcags kyu mda'/ g.yon bzhisa'akhor lo zhags pa thod pa gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ de dag ni rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyi yongs su brgyan pa'o/ /aṃ āṃ īṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ aṃ āḥ

rnal 'byor ma brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i 'phar ma la 'khod pa ni/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rol pa'i khro mo'i tshul can te/ shar du rdo rje drag mo dkar mo mda' lcags kyu gzhu byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje gzugs ma ser mo rdo rje mdung zhags pa rdul gyis gang ba'i thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo ral gri rdo rje dri chus gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang khu phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul ba dan rtse gsum pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser dbyug pa ut+pal thod pa cang te'u rnams 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser dmar pad+ma me long tshil gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma dmar sngo shak+ti dung 'khor lo thod pa khrag gang rnams 'dzin pa/ nub byang du sa rdo rje ma ljang dkar bum pa rdo rje sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /laṃ ṛṃ/ laṃ dzhaṃ liṃ ghaṃ baṃ liṃ/ lha mo brgyad dpag tu med pa spros 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi dri ma rnams sbyangs/ ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/ slar yang 'dus te phyi rol du 'khod pa ni/ phyi rol gru chad ky-i dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo/ me mtshams su pi waṃ ma ser mo/ bden bral du rnga mu kun+da ma dkar mo/ rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can/ lha rnams kyi shar lho'i grwar/ me tog ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu bdug spos ma sngon mo rin po che dang spos snod 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mar me ma ser mo pad+ma dmar po dang mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/

byang shar du dri chab ma dmar mo ral gri dang dri bzang gi dung chos 'dzin pa/ rnam snang la sogs pa de thams cad lha'i gos dang skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs can no/ /meṃ k+ṣiṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ gaṃ maṃ skaṃ saṃ/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang po rnam par dag par byas/ rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang po rnams la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gsum pa'i 'phar ma la 'khod pa ni/ shar gyi g.yas su byams pa ser po nā ga ge sar dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du sa'i snying po dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lho'i g.yas su phyag rdor nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can ral pa'i zur phud gsum pa ut+mal dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang gi g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po dkar po rdo rje dkar po dang dril bu 'dzin pa thams cad kyang phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba g.yas brkyang gi stabs can no/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sgo ma bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/ bdud bzhi bcom/ stobs bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus te sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma sngo sangs sngo nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis lcags kyu ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum gyis zhags pa sdigs 'dzub dril bu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis zhags pa rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo dril bu sdigs mdzub/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis lcags sgrog rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo dril bu lcags kyu rnams 'dzin pa/

byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas gsum gyis dril bu rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gsum gyis 'khor lo lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ de ltar sgo ma bzhi ni dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha gzhan rnams thams cad pad+ma thod pa zla ba la gnas pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyang gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /gal te lha nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la mos na/ lha snam gyi dbus su zlum skor gcig dang*/ de'i dbus su le tshe dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad bkod pa'i snam bu dor ba'o/ /de dag kyang rgyud phyi ma dang*/ rtsa rgyud so so'i dgongs pa yin la/ rtsa rgyud la rgyud gzhan gyis kha bskang ba lha mo bcu drug dgod par mdzad pa yang shin tu legs pa ste/ de'i tshe rim pa gsum pa'i 'phar ma la phyogs bzhir sgeg mo sogs dang*/ mtshams bzhir pi waṃ ma la sogs pa dgod cing*/ lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir me long ma la sogs pa bzhi 'god pa ni khyad par ro/ /gang dag rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni sgo gsum sgra kho na'o zhes smra ba de dag ni rgyud la mngon sum du bsnyon par zad la/ rgyud las/ 'phar ma'i rim gsum mam bzhi par gsungs pa'i phyir na sgo rkyang kho na ste bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phar ma gnyis par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i rjes su yan lag lhag ma rnams la bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ= hūṃ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dh-i pa ti hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ baṃ hoḥ

zhes pa dam ye bsres/ mig tu oṃ dza= nas dpa' bo kho na'o/ / spyi bor sku rdo rje= dang nas/ rnams su gyur/ gyi bar gong bzhin/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zhes pa'i bar sdom 'byung gi skabs bzhin/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang*/ mā ma kī/ sgra rdo rje ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma drag mo sa rdo rje ma/ gling bu ma/ me tog ma/ byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ lcags kyu ma rnams la rnam snang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ gzugs ma/ bdug spos ma/ pi waṃ ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ zhags pa ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ gos dkar mo/ 'dod chags ma/ mar me ma/ dri ma/ mu kun+da ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyuga'ajam dpal lcags sgrog ma rnams la/ 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma/ zhi ba mo/ gnod sbyin mo/ rdza rnga ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dril bu ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i 'dod yon rnams byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ shes rab kyi pad+mar mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa grangs med par gyur te/ lha mo'i ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod par gyur/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rkang brgyad dang*/ spro na/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs kyis kyang bstod la/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smos nas nang mchod 'bul ba'i srol ltar na/

rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /nag po spyod pa pa dang dha ma pa/ /laṅga li pa til+lo nā ro dang*/ /a wa dhu tī pa dang sau ri pa/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas stobs bcu rdo rje dpal/ /dge mtshan dpal dang mi dbang dpal bzang po/ /rā wi mi tra ra ti gup+ta dang*/ /shān+ti gup+ta bi pu la gar+bha/ /gang ba'i rdo rje rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes bya la/ brgyud pa rnying pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ birba ḍom+bhi ngo mtshar rdo rje dang*/ /nags khrod gar+bha ri dang rgyal ba dpal/ /mi thub zla ba dpa' bo'i rdo rje dang*/ /'brog mi gsal snying sgye cu sa chen dang*/ /rje btsun sku mched sa skya paṇa chen dang*/ /tshogs sgom snyeg ston zhang ston bkra shis dpal/ /spang khang grags dpal ma ti pan chen dang*/ /thig chen chos rje brag thog chos rje dang*/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal yangs pa can pa gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la zhes sam/ yang ngor lugs ltar na ma ti'i rjes su/ gzhon blo ngor chen dpal ldan pa dang ni/ /bsod nams lhun grub rje btsun grol mchog dang*/ / byams pa'i mtshan can rnams la= zhes 'don/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas nas tsa mi sogs la brgyud pa'ang byung ngo*/ /bar 'dir dag pa dran par byed pa spro na man ngag snye mar gsungs pa ltar shes dgos la 'on kyang ngag tu mi brjod do/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i sgo nas las rgyal mchog dang*/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang bsgom mo/ / bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta mahā su kha haṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na nī ye bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa spyi dang mtshungs so/ /thun 'jog par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ stong pa la mnyam pa bzhag /slar yang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur langs te/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ spyi bor sku rdo rje= sogs £©gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'bring po ni/ tsan+dan dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal gru gsum gyi dbus su/ gur gum gyis zlum por bskor ba la/ le tshe dgur byas/ ma 'byor na rdul tshon nam/ nang mchod kyis de dang dbyibs mthun tsam bri/ gtor ma mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'khrul spong gi skabs dang 'dra/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor khro bo chen po bcu phyogs skyong ba 'khor bcas srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad phaṭa/ ces 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ ku ru sogs kyis spyan drangs/ oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam bzhi yi/ khyad par du ni khang stong dang*/ /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang*/ khyad par gdol pa'i khyim gnas pa/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang*/ /nag po brtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*/ /dga' ba las 'das bgegs rgyal po/ /rgan byad ma dang drag mo dang*/ /'jigs byed ma dang u mas bstod/ /rgyal ma rnam par rgyal dbang mo/ /thub med gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /nag po sdang ba lam pa ki /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed yul gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen ma/

/thod 'phreng 'phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu lag dang*/ /lha yi dbang phyug ma rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi bdag nyid dang*/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen po/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen po/ /gos med sbyor ba bskyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang phyug ma bka' yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'dir spyon cig /oṃ kak+ka ta na bab+bhan+dha na/ khakh+kha da na/ sarba duṣ+tān/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ a mu kas+ya i daṃ kār+ya sādhā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥswāhā/ dbus kyi re mig gi gnas la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing*/ re mig gzhan rnams la phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ lha mo bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa 'khod pa ni/ ha ri ke lar a ru ra drung shar/ /zhing skyong nag po drag po 'khor bcas bzhugs/ /koṅka nar ni so ma bal+li byang*/ zhing skyong drag po chen po/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya ṇar a sho ka /zhing skyong lha byin mnyam brten= lho phyogs rdul bral tsu ta'i shing gi drung*/ /zhing skyong nag mo'i ming can= mer ni ka rañja te tsa ri trar/ /zhing skyong rtsigs byed chen po= bde bral de bi ko ṭar bha ṭa ste/ /zhing skyong 'jigs byed mi sdug= rlung mtshams 'bar ba 'dzin par gser shing te/ /zhing skyong dga' ba las 'das= dbang ldan aṭ+ṭa ha sar ka daṃ shing*/ zhing skyong bgegs kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs/ zhes bya ste/ sa mū ṭar zhing brgyad bshad pa zhing skyong brgyad dang spyod brgyud kyi dgongs par nges la/ phyogs mtshams ji ltar yin tshul ga ya dha ra dang*/ nā ro pa gnyis kyi man ngag ltar bkod pa'o/ / dbang po'i g.yas su tshangs pa dang zla ba dang nyi ma khyab 'jug rnams dang*/ nor bdag gi g.yon du tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ chu lha'i g.yas su thabs bzang ris dang sa'i lha mo rnams rang rang gis 'khor tshogs dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/

chu bzhi dang nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya staṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis dkyil 'khor la phul/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi nas/ pra yats+tshan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis sngags bsdus pas 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad la lan gsum du phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ / sogs kyi 'dod don gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā ra hūṃ añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ hasta pungatshi ye swāhā/ oṃ taṃ bu la ye swāhā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya'i mthar/ hūṃ phaṭa btags pa lan gsum bzla zhing dril bu dkrol/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid du grub gyur cig / ces smon lam btab/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ pad skor 'khyud rgya lag g.yas re mig gis sa la bzhag cing*/ g.yon khu tshur snying gar reg pa rnams bya ste/ oṃ at+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ swāhā/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbugs dang lhan cig rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba duṣ+taṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa gāts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gzhan rnams ni/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i sgrub thabs nyams su len tshul yang 'di kho na ste/ 'khor lo'i bdag po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /kun tu ngo mtshar rmad byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab rdzogs nyung ngu'i tshig gis bris/ /'di las rdo rje 'dzin thob shogakha sbyor rdor sems kyi sgrub pa'i thabs te bco brgyad pa'o//

//༈ de ltar na de dag rnams la rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ snang ba thams cad sku gsung thugs su lhag par mos pas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya zhing*/ bza' btung bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs nas/ lte ba'i gtum mo rab tu 'bar ba'i me'i dbus/ snying gar ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ lte bar phyogs skyong la sogs pa gsal bar dmigs te/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis longs spyod pa dang*/ gong bu bsdu ba'i rim pas 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas gnyid lam du 'khyer ba dang slar yang ldang ba dang*/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa nas brtsams te/ sgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sna tshogs bsam pa dang mtshungs cho ga sna tshogs tha dad pa/ /rgyud rgyal rnams su bstan pa de kun nam yang don med min/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chu klung lam rnams sna tshogs tha dad las/ /rgya mtshor ro gcig gzhol bzhin thabs tshul kun kyang chos kyi dbyings su'o/ /nges par zab bo sbyang bya sbyong byed legs par 'byongs pa'i bskyed rim mo/ /yid ches ldan no rgyud dang 'phags yul mkhas dang grub pa'i gsungs bzhin te/ /byin rlabs che'o rdzogs sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar du rgyun ma chad/ /skal ba bzang ngo dkon cing rnyed dka' 'bad med legs par thob 'di ko /de ltar sgrub thabs thabs tshul dpag yas rnams/ tshig tshogs ha cang ches na 'bri dka' zhing*/ /klog dka' 'dzin dka' 'don yang khong chud dka'/ /thun bzhir sgom pa sogs kyang lhag par dka'/ /bdag blo dman no skye bo phal cher yang*/ /blo dman nyid pas nyung ngus phan par sems/ /bdag nyid sgom dang gzhan la mi phan na/ /tshigs tshogs che ba'i nga rgyal de yis ci/ /theg mchog nyams len man ngag rgya mtsho 'di/ /'bad brtsol grub chen zhugs pa de las kyang*/ /skal bzang don mthun skye bo bgrang yas rnams/

/zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du phyin par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug 'khor lo sdom pa 'dir/ /gus pas cung zad brtsol ba'i dge ba las/ /bdag kyang 'khor lo'i mgon de thob par shog /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can ji snyed pa/ /ma lus bla na med pa'i byang chub la/ /myur ba nyid du 'god par byed gyur cig /de srid bdag kyang 'gro ba'i don byed shog /bde chen lam mchog zab yangs pad tshal du/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bung ba'i rgyal po ni/ /bye ba phrag brgyar lhan cig zab don gyis/ /sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston spyod pa nyid du gyur/ /bskyed rim pho nyas rab tu bskul te rtags bral dbang po thams cad pa yi ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po gang*/ /'gyur med bde ba'i 'od brgya 'bar bas gzung 'dzin tshang tshing stug po bsregs nas phung po khams dang skye mched gzhan/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings rgyal ba rnams kyi snying po zung 'jug dpa' bo dpyid dang phag mo mnyam sbyor zhes bya ba/ /bla med bla ma'i drin las dus 'di nyid du mngon du 'gyur zhing srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun gyi gzhir gyur cig /sgrub thabs nges par brjod pa'i tshig 'di yang rgyal gsungs yan lag rgya mtsho dang 'grogs te/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /skye bo kun la phan bde'i rgyun byed shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ yab bka'i dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi dang*/ yum bka'i dkyil 'khor bzhi'i sgrub thabs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa ste/ de yang dang por bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po'i 'grel pa'i lugs dang*/ de nas slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi lugs dang*/ mai tri bcu gsum ma dang*/ yum bka'i lha sum cu so bdun ma dang*/ sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum ma dang*/

lwa ba bcu gsum mar grags pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug dang*/ 'jam rdor lha nyer lnga ma dang*/ drag po chen po phyag 'bum pa dang*/ bong bu'i zhal can lha so bdun ma dang*/ mchog gi rdo rje phag mo lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro drag po'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dril bu lha lnga dang*/ khro bo rdor sems dang*/ phag mo 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ kha sbyor las 'byung ba zhi ba rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bka' la/ /lū dril nag gsum grags che bas logs su gsal/ yi ge bdun pa sgrub thabs ni dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yin yang slob ma rjes 'dzin byin rlabs kyi cho ga tsam dang bcas pa yin pa gzhan du bshad zin no// //bod yul 'di na dngos su rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi khungs la ma rten pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba yang mang du yod cing*/ 'ga' zhig thob mod kyang 'dir ma bkod la/ gong du smos pa de rnams las gzhan pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung bod du 'gyur pa'ang mang mod kyang*/ kho bos legs par thob pa ni 'di tsam yin la/ de yang kha ba can gyi phyogs de dag las gzhan zur bka' grags pa khungs rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i dbang bka' grags che ba cher med pa 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor gcig nyid la 'dod tshul tha dad pa mang po 'byung ba ni su zhig gis bgrang bar spyod/ de la 'di'i sdom 'byung gi sgrub thabs ni dge bshes dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin gyis bskul nas thog mar sbyar ba yin la/ des spro ba 'phel nas sgrub thabs bdun tsam zhig de'i rjes thogs su bris nas bar skabs su lo 'ga' zhig le lo'i dbang gis 'phro bor ba las/

slar yang 'phros rnams bris pa ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so drug pa la nags rgyal gyis dben gnas dpal jo mo nang du tshang bar bsgrigs pa'o// //'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing sangs rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig gcig zhus maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 154--PAGE 153--PAGE 1-
